jobs.title: Procurement Process Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR128179

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make.

Our key initiatives include:

• Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our Procure to Pay processes, enhancing efficiency optimization and user experience.
• Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities.
• Digitalizing end-to-end procurement

About the Role:

As a Procurement Process Manager in Richemont's Group Procurement Excellence team, you'll drive operational efficiency and digital transformation of our global end to end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You will own the end-to-end design, optimization, and governance of P2P workflows, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and a seamless user experience across the Group.

You will drive complex P2P process and system transformations, from strategic analysis and design to implementation and continuous improvement. This involves collaborating with executive stakeholders, cross-functional teams (IT, Finance, Legal, Maisons), and external partners, leveraging technology, and aligning with Group Procurement and Finance strategies.

We seek a visionary expert with deep P2P process knowledge, strategic thinking, and a proven ability to drive large-scale change. You will architect user-centric solutions, use advanced data analytics, and implement sophisticated process optimization to deliver measurable improvements, acting as the primary P2P process design expert

An agile and inspiring leader, a true ambassador for the Maison, you will be the driving force behind an emblematic boutique with international resonance, which you will also be responsible for promoting internally as an incubator for our best talents, professions and operating models of tomorrow.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Working in collaboration with the various Cartier Switzerland departments, you will be responsible for the boutique's commercial and operational performance by improving the main retail efficiency indicators, developing the team's skills and optimising operational costs.

As an experienced and exemplary manager, you will create a positive and motivating environment that encourages performance, learning and personal development. Managing, training and developing your team gives you a sense of fulfilment and gives everyone the opportunity to contribute to our collective success. Developing your employees’ skills and optimising the organisation of the boutique life in an agile way are key to achieving and surpassing the objectives set.

Creative and proactive, you will translate the boutique's strategy and ambitions into individual and collective priorities and objectives on a daily basis.

As an ambassador for the boutique and the Maison, you will be an exemplary embodiment of the image and values of the Maison, which you will represent to all its internal and external audiences, both in and out of the boutique. You will be approachable, engaging and professional at all times, and demonstrate an excellent level of self-awareness.

Working closely with the sales and communications teams, you will ensure that the customer is constantly at the heart of your actions at all levels of the organisation, in strict compliance with the Maison's image and strategy. Guaranteeing the perfect orchestration of the customer experience, you will bring to bear at the highest level our expertise in terms of hospitality, personalised experiences and event programming.

Attentive to the smallest detail, uncompromisingly demanding but agile at all times, you will ensure the quality and enrichment of our database and its strategic and tactical activation in the service of our stated ambition: to engage and surprise our customers of yesterday, today and tomorrow.

You will be responsible for ensuring that the customer strategy, the customer action plan and the boutique's annual events programme are fully deployed to enhance its appeal and influence.

In compliance with the policies, procedures and directives of our Maison, you will supervise operations and be responsible for promoting a culture of efficiency and continuous improvement at all levels of the organisation.

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

VOTRE MISSION :
Procéder aux réglages du balancier et à sa mise en train, assurer et garantir la production de pièces en termes de qualité, de quantité et de délais pour les différentes lignes de production.
Vos missions

Réglage des machines

• En adéquation avec l’ordonnancement, préparer le moyen de production.
• Réaliser le réglage du balancier.
• Procéder à la validation des nouveaux outillages.
• Assurer les réglages et la mise en train avec le contrôle des premiers composants.

Maintenance des outils de production

• Garantir la production et le suivi qualité des pièces produites (contrôles statistiques).
• Suivre le bon fonctionnement de la machine et participer à sa maintenance préventive.
• Gérer le bon soin des étampes.

Exécuter les opérations de fabrications

• Atteindre les objectifs de cadence définis.
• Respecter les critères qualités.
• Suivre les instructions de postes et méthodologies de travail.
• Alerter en cas d’anomalie process ou de rebuts excessifs.
• Etre autonome en fabrication et en réglage sur les métiers concernés.
• Effectuer les opérations d'autocontrôle sur sa production selon les normes qualité en vigueur.

Résolution de problèmes

• Alerter le spécialiste métier.
• Etre capable d’apporter les premières étapes d’analyses devant un problème avant d’alerter le responsable (30’ maximum).
• Participer aux résolutions de problème si demandé.

Amélioration continue

• Animer des réflexions avec les spécialistes techniques.
• Proposer des améliorations pour optimiser la performance.
• Travailler et participer à des projets en collaboration avec les partenaires internes.

Sécurité & Santé au Travail - Sûreté - Environnement

• Respecter les règles de son activité et de l’entreprise en termes de sécurité, sûreté et respect de l’environnement.
• S’impliquer dans la prévention des accidents, la sûreté et le respect de l’environnement.
• Ne mettre en danger ni ses collègues, ni soi-même par son comportement.

jobs.title: Finance Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR128927

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

“Do you enjoy orchestrating evolutions towards operational efficiency and future-ready employee experiences? Are you eager to use the latest technologies and participate in the build of constantly improving solutions? If yes, then apply and join us. A team aiming at accelerating business through technology is waiting for you to step up and have an impact on our Group transformation.”

YOUR MISSION:

As part of Group Platforms' department, Richemont is looking to further strengthen its dynamic Product Management team structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons' value chain strategy.

In this context, we are hiring a Finance Senior Product Owner to strategically lead and transform Finance Products with strong interdependencies across various Product Areas. The focus area will be strategic oversight and continuous enhancement of integrated and performing Finance and Accounting solutions across Richemont entities.

The Finance Senior Product Owner will ensure full alignment with Group Finance business priorities, complying with business rules and processes defined by the Business Process Owners (BPOs). The Finance Senior Product Owner plays a pivotal role in supporting and driving the Group Finance strategy by leading the development of valuable products and fostering product transformation.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

•

You will lead Product transformation, drive strategic initiatives and foster innovation for the Finance & Accounting Product. This includes strategic topics such as finance simplification, e-invoicing, accounting capabilities, M&A integration, and managing critical interdependencies with other business areas.

You will act as the strategic interface between the Group Product Office and the Finance Function, ensuring deep understanding and alignment of strategic objectives for the Product

You will build and maintain comprehensive roadmaps

You will implement consistent Product ways of working (e.g., ceremonies, demand management, fixed capacity models), fostering a mature and efficient product development culture

You will proactively steer risks, issues, and related mitigation plans in close collaboration with the Finance function

You will regularly communicate and articulate the strategic evolution and impact of the Finance & Accounting Product, demonstrating their contribution to the overarching business vision, particularly to senior stakeholders.

You will strategically partner with relevant stakeholders to proactively discover and understand their needs, translating these into strategic product initiatives and requirements for Finance & Accounting Product

You will lead the prioritization of demands in close collaboration with the Group Finance organization (Business Process Owners, Center of Excellence, Working Group), ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and resource capacity.

You will oversee the strategic maintenance and refinement of the product backlog, ensuring it reflects evolving business needs, maximizes business value and ROI, and aligns with available capacity.

You will lead and guide the technical team working on Finance & Accounting solutions, ensuring the strategic product vision is translated effectively into implementation and delivered with high quality.

You will proactively facilitate and manage interdependencies with cross-functional teams across Product Areas, ensuring seamless integration and alignment

You will champion change management initiatives, fostering adoption and dissemination of comprehensive product training, support tools, and documentation

You will drive continuous product improvement initiatives, leveraging user feedback, benefits realization, adoption rates, and key metrics/KPIs to ensure optimal business outcomes and strategic alignment.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Excellence is a top priority for our teams. In this role you have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in major global strategic initiatives for the Richemont Group and its Maisons.

Your passion for moving forward, achieving and leading change will find the perfect context within the team.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to latest trends and technologies.

DIMENSIONS

10-15 years’ experience in projects/products management, including multinational and innovative environments, in the operational finance or consulting area.

B.Sc. or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a Master’s degree in Business Administration.

Experience of SAP Financial solutions.

Practical experience in operational finance roles (e.g., controlling, accounting) is required

Audit / consulting experience in a Big4 or similar firms is a plus.

Excellent Business acumen, strong customer orientation.

Successful experience in facilitation, change management, and cross-business areas problem solving.

Knowledge of collaborative solutions for product management and Agile frameworks/methodologies is a plus.

Experience in implementing PO techniques (e.g. customer journeys, personas, discovery, agile ceremonies) is a plus.

Ability to anticipate change through technologies.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and organizational skills.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, good listener.

Ability to present ideas in a user-friendly or executive language at different management levels up to C-Level, motivate and inspire teams with client vision.

Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.

Proficiency in English is mandatory.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Procurement Excellence Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129217

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXT

The Richemont Procurement department is responsible for sourcing and purchasing the goods and services that enable our group's operations. We're committed to driving efficiency, sustainability, and innovation in every purchase we make.

Our key initiatives include:

• Strengthening indirect procurement across the group through our P2P Project, ensuring seamless and efficient processes.
• Embracing data-driven decision-making to optimize every purchase and unlock new opportunities.
• Digitalizing end-to-end procurement with our eSHOP platform.

You will have the opportunity to make a real difference by contributing to the future of procurement, gain valuable experience in data and process management, and discover the world of luxury by working within a leading luxury group.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

This is a unique opportunity to explore the worlds of data and process within our dynamic Procurement Excellence team.

As Procurement Excellence Intern, you will:

• Work closely with Procurement and Technology experts to build the future of digital Procurement at Richemont, contributing to a valuable experience.
• Contribute to the implementation of digital applications. You will participate in tool selection, design, testing, training and communication.
• Promote the use of our dashboards and data visualization tools, helping to communicate insights and drive informed decision-making.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• You're currently pursuing a Master's degree in Commerce or Engineering.
• You're analytical and enjoy finding innovative solutions to technical and business challenges.
• You are a technology enthusiast and are curious about the world of data and digital tools.
• You can collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating strong communication skills throughout.
• You thrive in dynamic environments, adapting your skills across diverse business and technical landscapes.
• You're proficient in English. Proficiency in French is appreciated.
• You’re ready to join our team starting September 2026.
• You have an internship agreement with your school/university

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.
- We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory interview.

2. The next step from there would be a second interview with the Procurement Data Project Manager.

3. As a final step, you will have a last interview with the Procurement Senior Process Manager.

At the end, hopefully, we can deliver some good news and greet you as our new colleague!

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR129217

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

CONTESTO

Il dipartimento di appalti Richemont è responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'acquisto dei beni e dei servizi che consentono le operazioni del nostro gruppo. Siamo impegnati a guidare l'efficienza, la sostenibilità e l'innovazione in ogni acquisto che facciamo.

Le nostre iniziative chiave includono:

• Rafforzare gli appalti indiretti attraverso il nostro progetto P2P, garantendo processi senza soluzione di continuità ed efficienti.
• Abbracciare il processo decisionale basato sui dati per ottimizzare ogni acquisto e sbloccare nuove opportunità.
• Digitalizzare gli appalti end-to-end con la nostra piattaforma eSHOP.

Avrete l'opportunità di fare una vera e propria differenza, contribuendo al futuro degli appalti, acquisendo preziosa esperienza nella gestione dei dati e dei processi, e scoprire il mondo del lusso lavorando all'interno di un gruppo di lusso leader.

Come fai a fare un'infezione?

Questa è un'opportunità unica per esplorare i mondi dei dati e del processo all'interno del nostro team di Procurement Excellence dinamico.

Come Procurement Excellence Intern, Lei sarà:

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli esperti di Procurement and Technology per costruire il futuro del digital Procurement a Richemont, contribuendo a una preziosa esperienza.
• Contribuisci all'implementazione delle applicazioni digitali. Parteciperai alla selezione degli strumenti, progettazione, test, formazione e comunicazione.
• Promuovere l'uso dei nostri cruscotti e strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati, contribuendo a comunicare intuizioni e guidare il processo decisionale informato.

Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi?

• Attualmente stai perseguendo un Master in Commercio o Ingegneria.
• Sei analitico e goditi di trovare soluzioni innovative per le sfide tecniche e aziendali.
• Sei un appassionato di tecnologia e sei curioso del mondo dei dati e degli strumenti digitali.
• È possibile collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e stakeholder, dimostrando forti capacità di comunicazione in tutto.
• Si prospera in ambienti dinamici, adattando le vostre competenze in diversi paesaggi aziendali e tecnici.
• Sei abile in inglese. La competenza in francese è apprezzata.
• Siete pronti ad unirsi alla nostra squadra a partire dal settembre 2026.
• Hai un accordo di stage con la tua scuola/università

Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo?

Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato.

- Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà.
- Adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità.
- Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo.

Il tuo viaggio con noi

1. Se la tua applicazione è selezionata, ti raggiungiamo al più presto per un colloquio informale introduttivo.

2. Il prossimo passo da lì sarebbe una seconda intervista con il Procurement Data Project Manager.

3. Come ultimo passo, si avrà un'ultima intervista con il Procurement Senior Process Manager.

Alla fine, speriamo, possiamo dare qualche buona notizia e salutarvi come nostro nuovo collega!

#Richemont # WeCraftTheFuture #

Zu unseren wichtigsten Initiativen gehören:

• Stärkung der indirekten Beschaffung in der gesamten Gruppe durch unser P2P-Projekt und Gewährleistung nahtloser und effizienter Prozesse.
• Datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, um jeden Einkauf zu optimieren und neue Möglichkeiten zu erschließen.
• Digitalisierung der End-to-End-Beschaffung mit unserer eSHOP-Plattform.

Sie haben die Möglichkeit, einen echten Unterschied zu machen, indem Sie einen Beitrag zur Zukunft der Beschaffung leisten, wertvolle Erfahrungen im Daten- und Prozessmanagement sammeln und die Welt des Luxus entdecken, indem Sie in einer führenden Luxusgruppe arbeiten.

WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND?

Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Welt der Daten und Prozesse in unserem dynamischen Procurement Excellence-Team zu erkunden.

Als Procurement Excellence Intern werden Sie:

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Experten für Beschaffung und Technologie zusammen, um die Zukunft der digitalen Beschaffung in Richemont zu gestalten und zu einer wertvollen Erfahrung beizutragen.
• Tragen Sie zur Implementierung digitaler Anwendungen bei. Sie werden an der Werkzeugauswahl, dem Design, dem Testen, der Schulung und der Kommunikation teilnehmen.
• Fördern Sie die Verwendung unserer Dashboards und Datenvisualisierungstools, um Einblicke zu vermitteln und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS?

• Sie verfolgen derzeit einen Master-Abschluss in Commerce oder Engineering.
• Sie sind analytisch und finden gerne innovative Lösungen für technische und geschäftliche Herausforderungen.
• Sie sind ein Technologie-Enthusiast und neugierig auf die Welt der Daten und digitalen Tools.
• Sie können effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten und dabei starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten nachweisen.
• Sie gedeihen in dynamischen Umgebungen und passen Ihre Fähigkeiten in verschiedenen Geschäfts- und technischen Landschaften an.
• Sie beherrschen Englisch. Französischkenntnisse werden geschätzt.
• Sie sind bereit, unserem Team ab September 2026 beizutreten.
• Sie haben einen Praktikumsvertrag mit Ihrer Schule / Universität

Was macht unsere Gruppe anders?

Unsere wahre Macht liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutztes Potenzial zu fördern.

- Wir schätzen Freiheit, Kollegialität, Loyalität und Solidarität.
- Wir fördern Empathie, Neugier, Mut, Demut und Integrität.
- Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben.

Deine Reise mit uns

1. Wenn ihre bewerbung ausgewählt ist, werden wir sie so schnell wie möglich für ein informelles einführungsgespräch kontaktieren.

2. Der nächste Schritt wäre ein zweites Interview mit dem Procurement Data Project Manager.

3. Als letzten Schritt haben Sie ein letztes Interview mit dem Procurement Senior Process Manager.

Am Ende können wir hoffentlich einige gute Nachrichten überbringen und Sie als unseren neuen Kollegen begrüßen!

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Code de référence: JR129217

Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue.

CONTEXTE

Le service d'approvisionnement Richemont est responsable de l'approvisionnement et de l'achat des biens et services qui permettent les activités de notre groupe. Nous nous engageons à stimuler l'efficacité, la durabilité et l'innovation dans chaque achat que nous faisons.

Nos principales initiatives comprennent :

• Renforcer l'approvisionnement indirect dans l'ensemble du groupe grâce à notre projet P2P, en assurant des processus transparents et efficaces.
• Faire place à la prise de décision axée sur les données pour optimiser chaque achat et débloquer de nouvelles opportunités.
• Digitaliser les achats de bout en bout avec notre plateforme eSHOP.

Vous aurez l'occasion de faire une vraie différence en contribuant à l'avenir de l'approvisionnement, d'acquérir une expérience précieuse dans la gestion des données et des processus, et de découvrir le monde du luxe en travaillant au sein d'un groupe de luxe de premier plan.

Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ?

C'est une occasion unique d'explorer le monde des données et des processus au sein de notre équipe dynamique d'excellence en approvisionnement.

En tant que stagiaire en excellence en approvisionnement, vous devrez :

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des experts en approvisionnement et technologie pour bâtir l'avenir de l'approvisionnement numérique à Richemont, contribuant ainsi à une expérience précieuse.
• Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des applications numériques. Vous participerez à la sélection des outils, à la conception, aux essais, à la formation et à la communication.
• Promouvoir l'utilisation de nos tableaux de bord et de nos outils de visualisation des données, en aidant à communiquer des idées et en favorisant la prise de décisions éclairées.

Comment allez-vous nous convaincre?

• Vous êtes actuellement titulaire d'une maîtrise en commerce ou en génie.
• Vous êtes analytique et aimez trouver des solutions innovantes aux défis techniques et commerciaux.
• Vous êtes un passionné de technologie et vous êtes curieux du monde des données et des outils numériques.
• Vous pouvez collaborer efficacement avec diverses équipes et parties prenantes, démontrant ainsi de solides compétences en communication.
• Vous prospèrez dans des environnements dynamiques, en adaptant vos compétences à divers paysages commerciaux et techniques.
• Vous maîtrisez l'anglais. La compétence en français est appréciée.
• Vous êtes prêt à rejoindre notre équipe dès septembre 2026.
• Vous avez un accord de stage avec votre école/université

Qu'est-ce qui fait que notre groupe est différent?

Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique de favoriser un potentiel inexploité.

- Nous apprécions la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité.
- Nous favorisons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité.
- Nous nous soucions du monde dans lequel nous vivons.

Votre journée avec nous

1. Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous vous contacterons dès que possible pour une entrevue d'introduction informelle.

2. La prochaine étape serait une deuxième entrevue avec le gestionnaire de projet des données d'approvisionnement.

3. Enfin, vous aurez une dernière entrevue avec le gestionnaire principal des processus d'approvisionnement.

À la fin, nous espérons pouvoir vous annoncer de bonnes nouvelles et vous saluer comme notre nouveau collègue!

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129325
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CONTEXTE

Au sein de l’atelier de Prototypes, vous réalisez les prototypes et les éléments de test des composants habillage et procédez aux ajustements nécessaires, en amont de la fabrication.

COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ?

• Vous collaborez étroitement avec le bureau d'études pour évaluer les plans et la faisabilité des dossiers techniques
• Vous définissez l’outillage nécessaire et préparez les postes
• Vous gérez la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commande numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles
• Vous prenez en charge le contrôle dimensionnel des pièces
• Vous collaborez avec d’autres départements internes et vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue du département

QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ?

Au bénéfice d’un CFC de micro-mécanicien avec une orientation faiseur d’étampes, ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie dans la fabrication des prototypes à l’aide de machines à commandes numériques 5 axes et de machines conventionnelles. Des compétences en décolletage sont un atout.

Vous maîtrisez le logiciel CREO et êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. Vous avez également des connaissances dans la lecture de plans et dans la manipulation des instruments de mesure et de contrôle (calibre, micromètre, comparateur, projecteur, etc.).

Des connaissances en bijouterie-joaillerie sont un plus, ainsi que la maîtrise du soudage au chalumeau et laser.

Vous êtes une personne motivée, dynamique, polyvalente, ayant un bon esprit d’équipe et appréciez travailler dans un environnement de travail agile.

QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ?

Nous créons un environnement positif où nous sommes fiers d'employer des talents issus de différents milieux, expériences et identités. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité et l'inclusion sont pleinement acceptées et renforcées, la créativité et le savoir émergent pour atteindre l'excellence.

VOTRE PARCOURS CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH.

Par la suite, vous accèderez à un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable Prototypes ainsi que notre HR Business Partner.

Tout au long de son histoire, la Maison Cartier s'est distinguée par l'engagement de chacun de ses employés. Nous sommes convaincus que lorsque la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont pleinement assumées, l'innovation et la créativité émergent pour offrir l'excellence. Quelles que soient les différences visibles ou invisibles, nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où chacun a une chance égale de réaliser son plein potentiel, d'être entendu et de se sentir valorisé.

Entrée en fonction : 1er septembre 2026 ou à convenir

Lieu de travail : La Chaux-de-Fonds, Suisse

Contrat : A durée indéterminée

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR129325
La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutte le Professioni dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall'impegno per l'eccellenza, colpendo per arricchire continuamente la nostra Maison

CONTESTO

Nel laboratorio Prototipi, si eseguono i prototipi e gli elementi di prova dei componenti di condimento e fare le regolazioni necessarie, prima della produzione.

Come hai un'infezione?

• Si lavora a stretto contatto con l'ufficio di progettazione per valutare i piani e la fattibilità dei file tecnici
• Definire gli strumenti necessari e preparare i post
• Si gestisce la produzione di prototipi utilizzando macchine di controllo digitali a 5 assi e macchine convenzionali
• Supporti il controllo dimensionale delle parti
• Collaborate con altri dipartimenti interni e contribuite al continuo miglioramento del reparto

Quali sono le regole della tua vita a casa nostra?

A beneficio di un CFC micro-meccanico con orientamento make-up o equivalente, si giustifica un'esperienza di successo nella produzione di prototipi utilizzando macchine di controllo digitali a 5 assi e macchine convenzionali. Le capacità di arrampicata sono una risorsa.

Si padroneggia il software CREO e si sente a proprio agio con i soliti strumenti IT. Hai anche conoscenze nella lettura dei piani e nella manipolazione di strumenti di misura e di controllo (calibrazione, micrometro, comparatore, proiettore, ecc.).

La conoscenza dei gioielli è un plus, così come la padronanza della saldatura con torcia e laser.

Sei una persona motivata, dinamica, versatile con un buon spirito di squadra e godere di lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro agile.

Cosa ti abbiamo fatto?

Creiamo un ambiente positivo in cui siamo orgogliosi di impiegare talenti da diversi background, esperienze e identità. Siamo convinti che quando la diversità e l'inclusione sono pienamente accettate e rafforzate, la creatività e la conoscenza emergono per raggiungere l'eccellenza.

IL TUO PARCO CANDIDATO con noi

Se la tua applicazione corrisponde a quello che stiamo cercando, riceverai una prima telefonata il prima possibile con il nostro team HR.

Successivamente, si accederà a un'intervista individuale con il nostro Prototypes Manager e il nostro HR Business Partner.

Nel corso della sua storia, Maison Cartier si è distinta dall'impegno di ciascuno dei suoi dipendenti. Siamo convinti che quando la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione sono pienamente assunte, l'innovazione e la creatività emergono per offrire l'eccellenza. Qualunque siano le differenze visibili o invisibili, ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente in cui ognuno ha la stessa possibilità di realizzare il proprio pieno potenziale, di essere ascoltato e di sentirsi valorizzato.

Entrata in carica: 1 settembre 2026 o da concordare

Luogo di lavoro: La Chaux-de-Fonds, Svizzera

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR129325
Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist angenommen, der unsere Teams in allen Berufen von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Unternehmensbüros inspiriert. Unsere über 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint, auffallend, um unsere Maison kontinuierlich zu bereichern

KONTEXT

Im Prototypen-Workshop führen Sie die Prototypen und Testelemente der Abrichtkomponenten durch und nehmen die notwendigen Anpassungen vor der Herstellung vor.

Wie haben Sie eine Auswirkung?

• Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Konstruktionsbüro zusammen, um die Pläne und die Durchführbarkeit technischer Dateien zu bewerten
• Sie definieren die notwendigen Werkzeuge und bereiten die Posts vor
• Sie steuern die Produktion von Prototypen mit 5-achsigen digitalen Steuerungsmaschinen und konventionellen Maschinen
• Sie unterstützen die Dimensionskontrolle von Teilen
• Sie arbeiten mit anderen internen Abteilungen zusammen und tragen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Abteilung bei

Was sind die Cles Ihrer Umfrage in unserem Haus?

Für eine mikromechanische FCKW mit Make-up oder gleichwertiger Ausrichtung rechtfertigen Sie eine erfolgreiche Erfahrung in der Herstellung von Prototypen mit 5-achsigen digitalen Steuerungsmaschinen und konventionellen Maschinen. Kletterfertigkeiten sind ein Gewinn.

Sie beherrschen die CREO-Software und sind mit den üblichen IT-Tools vertraut. Sie haben auch Kenntnisse im Lesen von Plänen und in der Manipulation von Mess- und Kontrollinstrumenten (Kalibrierung, Mikrometer, Vergleicher, Projektor usw.).

Schmuckkenntnisse sind ein Plus, ebenso wie die Beherrschung des Schweißens mit Brenner und Laser.

Sie sind eine motivierte, dynamische, vielseitige Person mit einem guten Teamgeist und genießen es, in einem agilen Arbeitsumfeld zu arbeiten.

Was haben wir euch geboten?

Wir schaffen ein positives Umfeld, in dem wir stolz darauf sind, Talente mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Identitäten einzusetzen. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass, wenn Vielfalt und Inklusion vollständig akzeptiert und gestärkt werden, Kreativität und Wissen entstehen, um Exzellenz zu erreichen.

IHR KANDIDATSPARK MIT UNS

Wenn Ihre Anwendung mit dem übereinstimmt, wonach wir suchen, erhalten Sie so schnell wie möglich einen ersten Anruf mit unserem HR-Team.

Anschließend erhalten Sie Zugang zu einem individuellen Interview mit unserem Prototypes Manager und unserem HR Business Partner.

Im Laufe seiner Geschichte hat sich Maison Cartier durch das Engagement jedes seiner Mitarbeiter ausgezeichnet. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass, wenn Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion vollständig angenommen werden, Innovation und Kreativität entstehen, um Exzellenz zu liefern. Was auch immer die sichtbaren oder unsichtbaren Unterschiede sind, wir sind bestrebt, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder die gleiche Chance hat, sein volles Potenzial zu entfalten, gehört zu werden und sich geschätzt zu fühlen.

Amtsantritt: 1. September 2026 oder noch zu vereinbaren

Arbeitsplatz: La Chaux-de-Fonds, Schweiz

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129457

Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

• Store Design & Planning:
• Convert retail design concept into refined architectural layouts ensuring adherence to technical requirements across all sales channels,
• Master spatial planning principles, zoning definition, and architectural standards to ensure consistent and adaptable execution across diverse regions.
• Proven ability in creating and validating construction details, workflow management, budget and timeline coordination with local Store Planning teams,
• Responsible for tracking and maintaining up-to-date design and budget documentation throughout the entire project duration,
• Demonstrated communications skills for effective collaboration with external stakeholders, business partners, contractors, and operational teams
• Strategic thinking:
• Capable in connecting design decisions directly to brand identity, business objectives, and operational impact,
• Demonstrated proactive problem-solving attitude, breaking down complex challenges into clear frameworks and defining concrete actions
• End to End accountability: demonstrated experience in taking complete responsibility for ensuring architectural quality from the initial concept phase through to final implementation,
• Able to offer operational support to ensure excellence in every execution and opening,
• Able to identify and develop cross-functional projects for department improvement and optimization.
• Design Mastery
• Lead research into new materials, trends, and innovative ideas, supporting the team in refining and perfecting brand design codes,
• Proven ability to translate innovative design concepts into practical, buildable architectural solutions,
• Proven experience in developing design and technical guidelines.

WHAT ABOUT YOU?

• Degree in Architecture or Interior Design
• At least 5 years of experience in Retail Design, high-end Retail Architecture, Spatial design across multiple formats and regions highly appreciated
• Strong design and creative skills, UpToDate with latest trends with an eye on innovation in the sector
• Passionate about design, art, broader cultural aspects
• Expert in lighting and illumination design.
• Detail oriented with strong sense of aesthetics
• Highly flexible and able to work both independently and in team
• Able to react promptly and efficiently to project design adjustments due to site conditions, budget or timeline reasons
• Able to effectively prioritize and work under pressure in a fast pace environment
• Proficiency in Auto CAD, 3D software, MS Excel software and Adobe Creative package
• Excellent organization
• Languages: English mandatory, French a plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR129457

Dal 1833, guidato da una sete incrollabile di innovazione e creatività, e ispirato dal tranquillo ambiente naturale della sua casa nella Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre si distingue per la sua padronanza delle complicazioni e la precisione dei suoi meccanismi. Conosciuto come Watchmaker of Watchmakers, la Manifattura ha espresso il suo spirito incessantemente inventivo attraverso la creazione di oltre 1.400 diversi calibri e il riconoscimento di oltre 430 brevetti. Sfruttando 190 anni di esperienza accumulata, i produttori orologiai La Grande Maison progettano, producono, rifiniscono e ornano i meccanismi più avanzati e precisi, fondendo la passione con la savoir-faire secolare, collegando il passato al futuro, senza tempo ma sempre al passo con i tempi. Con 180 competenze riunite sotto un unico tetto, la Manifattura crea orologi pregiati che combinano l'ingegno tecnico con la bellezza estetica e una sofisticazione contraddistinta.

Come fai a fare un'infezione?

• Progettazione e pianificazione del negozio:
• Convertire il concetto di design al dettaglio in raffinati layout architettonici garantendo l'adesione a requisiti tecnici in tutti i canali di vendita,
• Principi di pianificazione territoriale, definizione dello zoning e standard architettonici per garantire l'esecuzione coerente e adattabile in diverse regioni.
• Prova capacità di creare e convalidare dettagli di costruzione, gestione del flusso di lavoro, coordinamento di budget e timeline con i team locali di pianificazione Store,
• Responsabile del tracciamento e del mantenimento della documentazione di progettazione e di bilancio aggiornata per tutta la durata del progetto,
• Competenze di comunicazione dimostrate per una collaborazione efficace con stakeholder esterni, partner commerciali, appaltatori e team operativi
• Pensiero strategico:
• Capace di collegare le decisioni di progettazione direttamente all'identità del marchio, obiettivi aziendali e impatto operativo,
• Dimostrata attitudine proattiva a risolvere i problemi, abbattere le sfide complesse in quadri chiari e definire azioni concrete
• Affidabilità finale: esperienza dimostrata nell'assunzione di piena responsabilità per garantire la qualità architettonica dalla fase iniziale del concetto fino all'implementazione finale,
• In grado di offrire supporto operativo per garantire l'eccellenza in ogni esecuzione e apertura,
• In grado di identificare e sviluppare progetti interfunzionali per il miglioramento e l'ottimizzazione del reparto.
• Design Mastery
• Guida la ricerca su nuovi materiali, tendenze e idee innovative, supportando il team nella raffinazione e perfezionamento dei codici di design del marchio,
• Prova capacità di tradurre concetti di design innovativi in soluzioni architettoniche pratiche e costruibili,
• Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo di linee guida tecniche e di design.

E tu?

• Laurea in Architettura o Interior Design
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel Retail Design, nel Retail Architecture di fascia alta, nel design spaziale in diversi formati e regioni molto apprezzate
• Forte design e competenze creative, UpToDate con le ultime tendenze con un occhio all'innovazione nel settore
• Appassionato di design, arte, aspetti culturali più ampi
• Esperto nella progettazione di illuminazione e illuminazione.
• Dettaglio orientato con forte senso estetico
• Altamente flessibile e in grado di lavorare sia in modo indipendente che in team
• In grado di reagire tempestivamente ed efficientemente alle regolazioni di progettazione del progetto a causa di condizioni del sito, ragioni di budget o timeline

jobs.title: Mécanicien régleur CNC (H/F/X) nuit ou 2x8
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129524
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

Contrat à durée maximale (CDM) de 2 ans / Horaire nuit ou 2x8

« Notre vision pour le secteur Précieux? Allier la rigueur horlogère à une énergie d'équipe positive.

Nous cherchons un mécanicien régleur pour qui l'excellence est un standard, et l'esprit d'équipe une priorité.»

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT

Mission

Au sein de notre département précieux, vous êtes membre d’une équipe d’environ 10-12 collaborateurs, vous travaillez en horaire d’équipe 2x8 ou de nuit dans un parc de machines CNC (principalement fraisage) et procédez aux réglages ainsi qu’à la production.

Responsabilités

•

Assurer la conduite, le réglage, la mise en train de nos machines de fraisage CNC de type Chiron FX/FZ, Micro 5 (UGV), Bumotec S181, CT501 (meulage) lors de l’usinage de nos pièces d’habillage horloger précieux

Être garant de la conformité de la fabrication en procédant aux contrôles visuels et dimensionnels et si besoin, effectuer les corrections nécessaires dans le respect des consignes de l'atelier

Préparer le poste d’usinage en montant les outils et les posages et en contrôlant la conformité des outillages. Si besoin, effectuer les corrections d’outils nécessaires.

S'assurer de la passation des consignes aux équipes relais

Participer au nettoyage et à l'entretien des équipements, des machines et des outils ainsi que respecter les règles en matière de Santé et Sécurité au Travail SST

Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus et de son environnement de travail ainsi qu'aux actions de formation dans le cadre des évolutions du processus de fabrication

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

CFC de polymécanicien, CFC de mécanicien de production ou BEP/BTS dans le domaine de la mécanique de précision

Expérience professionnelle confirmée dans l'usinage CNC

Connaissances des machines CNC 5-7 axes avec commande Fanuc serait un plus

Bonne maitrise des outils de contrôle dimensionnel habituels, Marcel Aubert et contrôle 3D type Zeiss

Personne rigoureuse, motivée, organisée et consciencieuse sachant travailler en équipe. Analytique, vous savez détecter les problèmes et les suivre jusqu’à leur résolution dans une dynamique d’amélioration constante.

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison.

Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez le Responsable du poste ainsi que notre HR Business Partner.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert

titleByLocale.it: Processo di conformità commerciale e esperto di dati
titleByLocale.fr: Expert en processus de conformité commerciale et données

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129654

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXT:

The Group Product & Trade Compliance department (GPTC) aims to prevent the Group and its Maisons from supply chain disruption and brand reputation damage stemming from regulatory non-compliance.

Within the GPTC department, GPTC Data & Operations Excellence team is responsible to manage and orchestrate the best strategy & solutions to ensure Product & Trade Compliance effectiveness within the Group.

The mission consists in leveraging best-in-class processes, organization, technology & Data Management implementation and supporting efficient end-to-end operational solutions across Functions, Maisons, and Regions for Compliance effectiveness while decreasing the most possible constraints on impacted processes and organization.

In this context, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert leverages a thorough knowledge of our Corporate Trade Compliance Processes & Data to support and accompany our colleagues and partners. He ensures the appropriate Trade Compliance processes, their formalization and optimization on the diversity of global trade activities such import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc. He ensures day-to-day the corresponding knowledge transfer through training or consulting to our internal stakeholders’ community to supports their operations across end-to-end value chain.

Co-warrant of our Group compliance effectiveness & control tower, the role is as well instrumental in relevant KPI monitoring, data quality stewardship and suboptimal process identification. When necessary, this will lead to conduct root-cause analyses and the corresponding continuous improvement initiatives for ensuring the robustness and performance of our processes on the long run. Ultimately, thanks to its expertise, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert is eventually acting as a Subject Matter Expert or Stream Lead into broader projects led under other’s entity leadership.

YOUR MISSION:

•

Ensure process formalization and process optimization on global trade compliance scope (import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc.). This mission includes the corresponding data management guidelines.

Ensure support and consulting service for our internal stakeholders’ community on Trade compliance data and processes. Conduct training in processes and system-driven solutions in place to empower people.

Analyse support demand for Trade Compliance implementation solution concerning system and data under our process ownership and conduct the appropriate enhancement or initiative framing to deliver effective & efficient solution.

Monitor & Analyse Trade Compliance KPI and act as a Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Perform data stewardship for data contributed by our stakeholders (Maisons, Group, Region) that are under our responsibility and covered by our Data Governance.

Conduct root cause analyze and continuous process improvements initiative

Support in projects that require our PTC data management & process expertise.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT:

At least 3 years’ experience in an international environment in the field of Trade Compliance

Comfortable with Supply Chain & Trade regulatory domain area (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory documentation & policies interpretation, International Logistics Operational flows,..)

Experience in Business Analysis, Process Management or Project Management an advantage

Meticulous and very detailed-oriented

Comfortable with Digital & IT systems logic and software user interface (good understanding of SAP and SAP GTS a plus).

General proficiency with Excel (data manipulation, export, filters, Xlookup, pivot table, etc.)

A kind, consultative and cooperative way of interacting. A sense of Customer focus

A proactive mindset in challenging the status quo and supporting continuous pragmatic improvement initiatives

descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR129654

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXT:

The Group Product & Trade Compliance department (GPTC) aims to prevent the Group and its Maisons from supply chain disruption and brand reputation damage stemming from regulatory non-compliance.

Within the GPTC department, GPTC Data & Operations Excellence team is responsible to manage and orchestrate the best strategy & solutions to ensure Product & Trade Compliance effectiveness within the Group.

The mission consists in leveraging best-in-class processes, organization, technology & Data Management implementation and supporting efficient end-to-end operational solutions across Functions, Maisons, and Regions for Compliance effectiveness while decreasing the most possible constraints on impacted processes and organization.

In this context, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert leverages a thorough knowledge of our Corporate Trade Compliance Processes & Data to support and accompany our colleagues and partners. He ensures the appropriate Trade Compliance processes, their formalization and optimization on the diversity of global trade activities such import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc. He ensures day-to-day the corresponding knowledge transfer through training or consulting to our internal stakeholders’ community to supports their operations across end-to-end value chain.

Co-warrant of our Group compliance effectiveness & control tower, the role is as well instrumental in relevant KPI monitoring, data quality stewardship and suboptimal process identification. When necessary, this will lead to conduct root-cause analyses and the corresponding continuous improvement initiatives for ensuring the robustness and performance of our processes on the long run. Ultimately, thanks to its expertise, the Trade Compliance Process & Data Expert is eventually acting as a Subject Matter Expert or Stream Lead into broader projects led under other’s entity leadership.

YOUR MISSION:

•

Ensure process formalization and process optimization on global trade compliance scope (import, export, special procedures, duties & FTA, etc.). This mission includes the corresponding data management guidelines.

Ensure support and consulting service for our internal stakeholders’ community on Trade compliance data and processes. Conduct training in processes and system-driven solutions in place to empower people.

Analyse support demand for Trade Compliance implementation solution concerning system and data under our process ownership and conduct the appropriate enhancement or initiative framing to deliver effective & efficient solution.

Monitor & Analyse Trade Compliance KPI and act as a Trade Compliance Data Quality Control Tower. Perform data stewardship for data contributed by our stakeholders (Maisons, Group, Region) that are under our responsibility and covered by our Data Governance.

Conduct root cause analyze and continuous process improvements initiative

Support in projects that require our PTC data management & process expertise.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT:

At least 3 years’ experience in an international environment in the field of Trade Compliance

Comfortable with Supply Chain & Trade regulatory domain area (HS Commodity Codes, Regulatory documentation & policies interpretation, International Logistics Operational flows,..)

Experience in Business Analysis, Process Management or Project Management an advantage

Meticulous and very detailed-oriented

Comfortable with Digital & IT systems logic and software user interface (good understanding of SAP and SAP GTS a plus).

General proficiency with Excel (data manipulation, export, filters, Xlookup, pivot table, etc.)

A kind, consultative and cooperative way of interacting. A sense of Customer focus

A proactive mindset in challenging the status quo and supporting continuous pragmatic improvement initiatives

Fluent in French, Full Proficient in English due the daily interaction with multi-cultural stakeholders. Speaking Italian and/or German a serious plus

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Head of Retail Excellence
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129783

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

We are on a mission to elevate our retail performance and cultivate an unyielding culture of excellence across our network. To lead this crucial endeavor, we are seeking a visionary Head of Retail Excellence to join our HQ commercial team.

Your mission

You will be the driving force behind our retail strategies, translating vision into impactful execution on the ground. Your leadership will ensure unparalleled operational excellence, empower our teams through expertly coordinated training, and cultivate extraordinary client experiences by championing best-in-class VIC management.

How will you make an impact?

Strategy & Vision:

• Develop and articulate a comprehensive Retail Excellence strategy aligned with the overall commercial objectives and brand vision.
• Identify key areas for improvement in retail operations, customer experience, and VIC management.

Process Optimization & Standardization:

• Establish and maintain the Retail Excellence framework and associated procedures, ensuring standards, best practices and consistent execution across all network.

Customer Experience Enhancement and focus on our top clients:

• Champion a customer-centric approach, focusing on elevating the end-to-end customer journey.
• Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs).
• Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level.
• Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience.

Training & Development:

• Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams.
• Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies.
• Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment.

Retail Strategic Initiatives:

• Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap.
• Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes.

How will you experience success?

• Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry.
• Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations.
• Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
• Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution.
• Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• Flexibility to travel.
• Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills.
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage.

What makes Panerai unique?

• Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions.
• Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability.
• Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience.
• Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group.

Your journey with us

Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness.

The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR129783

Fondata a Firenze nel 1860, Panerai forgia la sua reputazione sviluppando strumenti di precisione e orologi professionali per la Royal Italian Navy, rinomata per la loro affidabilità e design funzionale. Forte di performance, finalità e precisione, la Maison abbraccia il suo patrimonio spingendo i confini dell'innovazione, coniugando il design italiano con le competenze svizzere. Oggi, Panerai continua a creare orologi utensili che servono come compagni di fiducia per ogni avventura, anche negli ambienti più esigenti.

Siamo in missione per elevare le nostre prestazioni di vendita al dettaglio e coltivare una cultura unica di eccellenza in tutta la nostra rete. Per guidare questo impegno cruciale, stiamo cercando un visionario Capo di Eccellenza al dettaglio per unirsi al nostro team commerciale HQ.

La tua missione

Sarete la forza trainante dietro le nostre strategie di vendita al dettaglio, traducendo la visione in esecuzione efficace sul terreno. La vostra leadership garantirà un'eccellenza operativa senza pari, potenziare i nostri team attraverso una formazione sapientemente coordinata, e coltivare esperienze straordinarie dei clienti, sostenendo la gestione VIC di prima classe.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

Strategia e visione:

• Sviluppare e articolare una strategia di eccellenza al dettaglio completa allineata con gli obiettivi commerciali globali e la visione del marchio.
• Identificare le aree chiave per il miglioramento delle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, dell'esperienza del cliente e della gestione VIC.

Ottimizzazione dei processi e standardizzazione:

• Stabilire e mantenere il quadro di Retail Excellence e le procedure associate, garantendo standard, best practice ed esecuzione coerente in tutta la rete.

Miglioramento dell'esperienza del cliente e concentrarsi sui nostri migliori clienti:

• Campione un approccio orientato al cliente, concentrandosi sull'elevazione del viaggio clienti end-to-end.
• Strumenti di implementazione e metodologie per misurare e migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente (ad esempio, NPS, programmi di shopping misterioso).
• Guida i programmi VIC, assicurando l'impegno e la ritenzione di clienti di alto livello a livello globale.
• Collabora con team di marketing e prodotti per garantire un'esperienza di marca senza soluzione di continuità.

Formazione e sviluppo:

• Fornire programmi di formazione per il personale al dettaglio sulle procedure operative, le conoscenze dei prodotti, le tecniche di vendita e l'eccellenza del servizio clienti.
• Promuovere una cultura dell'apprendimento continuo e del miglioramento all'interno delle squadre di vendita al dettaglio.
• Lavorare con le squadre HR e il nostro creatore di contenuti di formazione, così come i team di talento per garantire lo sviluppo di talenti e la pianificazione di successione per ruoli di vendita al dettaglio chiave.

Collaborazione trasversale:

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Revenue Growth e le prestazioni commerciali, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM team e reparti HR, IT e supply chain per garantire strategie di vendita al dettaglio integrate ed efficaci.
• Agire come collegamento tra funzioni aziendali e operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per facilitare la comunicazione e l'allineamento.

Iniziative strategiche al dettaglio:

• Guidare e gestire progetti relativi all'innovazione al dettaglio, nuove aperture dei negozi, ristrutturazioni dei negozi e implementazioni tecnologiche in linea con la Richemont Roadmap.
• Controllare la consegna di successo dei progetti, assicurando l'allineamento con le priorità aziendali e i risultati attesi.

Come sperimenterai il successo?

• Corso di laurea o master e un minimo di 8 anni di relativa esperienza in Retail nel settore del lusso o gioielli / orologio.
• Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di vendita al dettaglio e migliori pratiche operative in più sedi.
• Forte comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti di lusso e degli standard di servizio.
• Capacità dimostrata di analizzare i dati, identificare le tendenze e tradurre intuizioni in strategie attuabili.
• Eccellente abilità di PM con un track record di esecuzione di successo.
• Forte capacità di guidare, motivare e influenzare team e stakeholder interfunzionali a tutti i livelli.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali sono necessarie con un'enfasi sui dettagli e l'organizzazione, con la capacità di gestire più compiti contemporaneamente.
• Approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione alle sfide.
• Flessibilità al viaggio.
• Grandi capacità mentali e di implementazione.
• È necessaria la fluidità in inglese; la competenza in altre lingue pertinente alla presenza globale di Richemont (ad esempio, francese, italiano,...) è un vantaggio significativo.

Cosa rende Panerai unico?

• Unisciti a uno spirito dinamico della Maison che valorizza e potenzia le tue competenze e i tuoi contributi unici.
• Thrive all'interno di comunità arricchenti costruite su cura genuina, miglioramento continuo, ed efficiente responsabilitÃ .
• Collabora tra confini e culture, acquisendo una preziosa esperienza internazionale.
• Imbarcarsi in un percorso di carriera soddisfacente all'interno di Panerai e attraverso il Gruppo Richemont.

Il tuo viaggio con noi

Il nostro viaggio di reclutamento è progettato per offrire spunti e scambi di arricchimento, radicati nella trasparenza, nel rispetto e nell'equità.

Il processo di reclutamento include conversazioni con il Gestore di Assunzione, partner aziendali chiave e membri dei nostri team executive.

La tua prossima avventura inizia a Panerai. Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti.
