jobs.title: New Foundations Programme Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130029

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:

New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation.

As Programme Manager for New Foundations, you will own the day-to-day orchestration, cadence and operational discipline of this strategic transformation programme. You will ensure the programme runs as a single, integrated effort, with decisions, risks and dependencies tracked and executed consistently across all workstreams. Partnering closely with the Programme Director, the programme team and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, you will be the trusted operational backbone of the programme, with no content ownership.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In this role, you will:

•

Co-design the New Foundations programme with the Programme Director and wider Group Platforms stakeholders, translating ambition, governance and decisions into a structured and executable plan.

Orchestrate overall programme execution, ensuring all streams progress in line with agreed scope, cadence and priorities.

Maintain a single integrated view of the programme and own its cadence and rhythm — planning cycles, forums, milestones and decision tracking.

Prepare and drive arbitration processes with relevant stakeholders, framing options, impacts and trade-offs for the Programme Director and Group Platforms Executive Committee (ExCo).

Track decisions and non-negotiables, ensuring commitments are clearly recorded and reflected in plans and deliverables, following up on actions, managing slippage and escalating risks early.

Coordinate documentation and readiness for Discovery deliverables and the planning and preparation of Solution Design.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Strong background in programme orchestration and complex delivery environments.

Experience operating in multi-entity, Group-level programmes

Exposure to large-scale ERP transformations, ideally including SAP S/4HANA conversions.

Experience working with external consulting partners during initial programme set-up.

Programme structuring and planning, including cadence, milestones and dependency management.

Rigorous tracking and follow-through, turning decisions into executable actions.

Risk and issue management, with early identification and escalation.

Clear synthesis and framing, consolidating complex inputs into concise programme views.

Strong coordination across business, technology, finance and change management teams.

Highly disciplined, structured and execution-oriented.

Comfortable operating in complex environment

Focused on outcomes, follow-through and operational excellence.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.

We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.

We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect:

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role.

A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role.

A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps.

We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Constructeur Mouvement (H/F)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130111

Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve.

Responsabilités Principales :
1. Conception et Développement :
• Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers mécaniques en utilisant des logiciels de CAO 2D et 3D PTC Creo et Tellwatch
• Réaliser les études de faisabilité technique et les analyses fonctionnelles des nouveaux mouvements ou des évolutions de mouvements existants.
• Définir les architectures mécaniques, les cinématiques et les tolérances dimensionnelles des composants.
• Intégrer les contraintes esthétiques, techniques, de coût et de production dès la phase de conception

2. Collaboration avec l’industrialisation et Prototypage :
• Établir les dossiers techniques complets (plans de fabrication, nomenclatures, spécifications techniques) pour le prototypage et la production.
• Collaborer avec l'atelier de prototypage et le chef de projet pour la réalisation des premières pièces et l'assemblage des mouvements.
• Participer aux phases de tests et de validation des prototypes, analyser les résultats et proposer des améliorations.
• Assurer le suivi technique lors de la phase d'industrialisation et de mise en production en série.

3. Optimisation et Amélioration Continue :
• Rechercher et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance, la fiabilité, la précision et la facilité d'assemblage des mouvements.
• Optimiser les coûts de fabrication sans compromettre la qualité.

4. Collaboration et Communication :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les designers, les horlogers, les méthodes, les chefs de projets et les équipes de production.
• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques.

Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie.

Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français

Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.
• Capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.
• Passion pour l'horlogerie et la mécanique de précision.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130111

Dal momento che MONTBLANC ha rivoluzionato la cultura della scrittura nel 1906 con la prima penna stilografica a prova di rovescia, siamo stati conosciuti per l'artigianato eccezionale, la massima estetica e soluzioni innovative. E continuiamo a spingere i confini. Uniamo il meglio della tradizione, della tecnologia e del design in strumenti di scrittura, orologi, pelletteria, nuove tecnologie e accessori selezionati. Con il nostro nome e nel nostro emlem, abbracciamo questa missione: mettere in atto idee audace con eccezionale artigianalità e creare prodotti raffinati per le persone con più alte aspettative. In questo modo, siamo all'avanguardia nella tecnologia e nel design, attingendo alla passione di oltre 3.000 dipendenti e vivendo una cultura che - come i nostri prodotti - ha ispirato le persone a scatenare il loro potenziale, a tre e a raggiungere.

Responsabilità chiave:
1. Design e sviluppo:
• Progettare e sviluppare movimenti di orologi meccanici utilizzando il software PTC Creo e Tellwatch 2D CAD e 3D
• Condurre studi di fattibilità tecnica e analisi funzionali di nuovi movimenti o cambiamenti nei movimenti esistenti.
• Definire le architetture meccaniche, la cinematica e le tolleranze dimensionali dei componenti.
• Integrare vincoli estetici, tecnici, di costo e di produzione dalla fase progettuale

2. Collaborazione con industrializzazione e prototipazione:
• Stabilire documenti tecnici completi (piani di fabbricazione, nomenclature, specifiche tecniche) per la prototipazione e la produzione.
• Collabora con il workshop di prototipazione e il responsabile del progetto per la realizzazione delle prime parti e l'assemblaggio dei movimenti.
• Partecipare alle fasi di test e validazione dei prototipi, analizzare i risultati e proporre miglioramenti.
• Monitoraggio tecnico durante la fase di industrializzazione e produzione di massa.

3. Ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo:
• Trovare e proporre soluzioni innovative per migliorare le prestazioni, l'affidabilità, l'accuratezza e la facilità di assemblaggio dei movimenti.
• Ottimizzare i costi di produzione senza compromettere la qualità.

4. Collaborazione e comunicazione:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con designer, orologiai, metodi, project manager e team di produzione.
• Presenti progressi tecnici e soluzioni a team e management interni.
• Partecipa a recensioni di progetti e incontri tecnici.

Requisiti richiesti:
• Formazione: Diploma di ingegnere in microtecnica orientamento orologiera o titolo ritenuto equivalente
• Esperienza: minimo 5 anni di esperienza significativa nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di movimenti orologi complessi, idealmente all'interno di un'alta fabbrica di orologi.

Competenze tecniche:
• Competenza approfondita della meccanica orologiera e delle complicazioni.
• Software Expertise PTC Creo e Windchill
• Conoscenza dei materiali e dei processi di fabbricazione dell'orologeria (lavorazione, taglio, lavorazione della superficie, ecc.).
• Capacità di leggere e interpretare piani tecnici complessi.
• Conoscenza degli standard e degli standard dell'industria orologiera.
• Lingue: Mastery of French

Qualità personali:
• Rigor, precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Creatività e innovazione.
• Capacità di analizzare e risolvere problemi complessi.
• Autonomia e proattività.
• Eccellente spirito di squadra e capacità di comunicazione.
• Passione per l'orologeria e la meccanica di precisione.

• Find and propose innovative solutions to improve the performance, reliability, accuracy and ease of assembly of movements.
• Optimize manufacturing costs without compromising quality.

4. Collaboration and Communication:
• Work closely with designers, watchmakers, methods, project managers and production teams.
• Present technical advances and solutions to internal teams and management.
• Participate in project reviews and technical meetings.

Qualifications Required:
• Training: Diploma of engineer in microtechnics orientation watchmaking or title deemed equivalent
• Experience: Minimum 5 years of significant experience in the design and development of complex watch movements, ideally within a high watchmaking factory.

Technical Skills:
• In-depth mastery of watch mechanics and complications.
• Software Expertise PTC Creo and Windchill
• Knowledge of watchmaking materials and manufacturing processes (machining, cutting, surface processing, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret complex technical plans.
• Knowledge of watch industry standards and standards.
• Languages: Mastery of French

Personal qualities:
• Rigor, precision and attention to detail.
• Creativity and innovation.
• Ability to analyze and solve complex problems.
• Autonomy and proactivity.
• Excellent team spirit and communication skills.
• Passion for watchmaking and precision mechanics.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR130111

Seit MONTBLANC 1906 mit dem ersten verschüttungssicheren Füllfederhalter die Schreibkultur revolutionierte, sind wir für herausragende Handwerkskunst, höchste Ästhetik und innovative Lösungen bekannt. Und wir verschieben die Grenzen. Wir kombinieren das Beste aus Tradition, Technologie und Design in Schreibgeräten, Uhren, Lederwaren, neuen Technologien und ausgewähltem Zubehör. Mit unserem Namen und in unserem Emlem nehmen wir diese Mission wahr: mutige Ideen mit herausragender Handwerkskunst umzusetzen und raffinierte Produkte für Menschen mit höchsten Erwartungen zu schaffen. Dabei stehen wir an der Spitze der Technik und des Designs, schöpfen aus der Leidenschaft von mehr als 3.000 Mitarbeitern und leben eine Kultur, die – wie unsere Produkte – Menschen dazu inspiriert hat, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten, zu dreit und zu erreichen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:
1. Design und Entwicklung:
• Entwerfen und Entwickeln von mechanischen Uhrwerken mit 2D CAD und 3D Software PTC Creo und Tellwatch
• Führen Sie technische Machbarkeitsstudien und funktionelle Analysen neuer Bewegungen oder Änderungen bestehender Bewegungen durch.
• Definieren Sie die mechanischen Architekturen, die Kinematik und die Dimensionstoleranzen von Komponenten.
• Integrieren Sie ästhetische, technische, Kosten- und Produktionsbeschränkungen aus der Designphase

2. Zusammenarbeit mit Industrialisierung und Prototyping:
• Erstellung vollständiger technischer Aufzeichnungen (Herstellungspläne, Nomenklaturen, technische Spezifikationen) für Prototyping und Produktion.
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Prototyping-Workshop und dem Projektmanager für die Realisierung der ersten Teile und die Montage der Uhrwerke zusammen.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Test- und Validierungsphasen von Prototypen, analysieren Sie Ergebnisse und schlagen Sie Verbesserungen vor.
• Technische Überwachung während der Industrialisierungs- und Massenproduktionsphase.

3. Optimierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung:
• Finden und schlagen Sie innovative Lösungen vor, um die Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit, Genauigkeit und einfache Montage von Bewegungen zu verbessern.
• Optimieren Sie die Herstellungskosten, ohne die Qualität zu beeinträchtigen.

4. Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation:
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Designern, Uhrmachern, Methoden, Projektmanagern und Produktionsteams zusammen.
• Präsentieren Sie technische Fortschritte und Lösungen für interne Teams und das Management.
• Nehmen Sie an Projektprüfungen und technischen Meetings teil.

Benötigte Qualifikationen:
• Ausbildung: Ingenieurdiplom in Mikrotechnik Orientierung Uhrmacherei oder Titel als gleichwertig angesehen
• Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Entwicklung komplexer Uhrwerke, idealerweise in einer Hochuhrfabrik.

Technische Fähigkeiten:
• Tiefe Beherrschung der Uhrenmechanik und Komplikationen.
• Software Expertise PTC Creo und Windchill
• Kenntnisse über Uhrmachermaterialien und Herstellungsverfahren (Bearbeitung, Schneiden, Oberflächenbearbeitung usw.).
• Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Pläne zu lesen und zu interpretieren.
• Kenntnisse der Uhrenindustrie Standards und Standards.
• Sprachen: Französisch beherrschen

Persönliche Eigenschaften:
• Strenge, Präzision und Liebe zum Detail.
• Kreativität und Innovation.
• Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen.
• Autonomie und Proaktivität.
• Ausgezeichneter Teamgeist und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Leidenschaft für Uhrmacherei und Präzisionsmechanik.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Reference code: JR130111

Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve.

Responsabilités Principales :
1. Conception et Développement :
• Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers mécaniques en utilisant des logiciels de CAO 2D et 3D PTC Creo et Tellwatch
• Réaliser les études de faisabilité technique et les analyses fonctionnelles des nouveaux mouvements ou des évolutions de mouvements existants.
• Définir les architectures mécaniques, les cinématiques et les tolérances dimensionnelles des composants.
• Intégrer les contraintes esthétiques, techniques, de coût et de production dès la phase de conception

2. Collaboration avec l’industrialisation et Prototypage :
• Établir les dossiers techniques complets (plans de fabrication, nomenclatures, spécifications techniques) pour le prototypage et la production.
• Collaborer avec l'atelier de prototypage et le chef de projet pour la réalisation des premières pièces et l'assemblage des mouvements.
• Participer aux phases de tests et de validation des prototypes, analyser les résultats et proposer des améliorations.
• Assurer le suivi technique lors de la phase d'industrialisation et de mise en production en série.

3. Optimisation et Amélioration Continue :
• Rechercher et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance, la fiabilité, la précision et la facilité d'assemblage des mouvements.
• Optimiser les coûts de fabrication sans compromettre la qualité.

4. Collaboration et Communication :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les designers, les horlogers, les méthodes, les chefs de projets et les équipes de production.
• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques.

Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie.

Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français

Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.
• Capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.
• Passion pour l'horlogerie et la mécanique de précision.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130200
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

End of studies internship with school agreement

Duration: 6 months minimum

Location: 1752 Villars-sur-Glâne, Switzerland

Context:

The objective of this internship is to enrich your academic background with a stimulating professional experience in an international environment.

How will you make an impact?

In our Supply Chain department in charge of the distribution of finished goods, you will be part of a highly established team and you will contribute to the following missions:

Carry out business analysis for the definition and implementation of the supply strategy to ensure optimum stock level, challenge forecast and loops with all stakeholders,

Collaborate with markets, marketing and external supplier on their problematics,

Create reporting and maintain existing reports, particularly under Power BI or Anaplan

Participate in continuous improvement projects related to the department activity

Your profile

You are in your last year master’s degree in engineering with a Supply Chain focus.

You have advanced skills in Excel and/or experience with Power BI.

You have robust analytical skills, and you easily analyze and work with Data and Information Systems.

You are organized, autonomous and reliable.

You have a very good command of French and English.

How do we keep you smiling?

You will be a part of a dynamic and international work environment, where we always go the extra mile to uphold outstanding service for our clients

Your journey with us

If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. The next step will be an introductory call with one of our Data Scientists, followed by a technical interview and a business case.

jobs.title: Anaplan Model Builder
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130201
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

As one of the core building block of the Cartier Data Office, Connected Planning is a critical, yet rapidly expending part of our Data ecosystem.

The Anaplan model builder has a key role in the development of the solution within the Maison and the maintenance of the models ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity. As a model builder, you will ensure that models used Maison-wide are matching industry standard best practices and delivering the best level of performance and robustness.

How will you make an impact?

You will have the following responsibilities:

• Model building
• Implement best practices for model development, including version control, documentation and technical optimizations.
• Proactively keep a high level of technical expertise, and stay up to date with latest developments of the Solution.
• Ensure robustness and perennity of the models. Ensure data integrity, accuracy and reliability within the models.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation including design specifications, formulas, and assumptions.
• Maintenance
• Investigate and resolve issues related to Anaplan models, including data inconsistencies, formula errors, and system performance. Provide support to end-users.
• New projects
• Collaborate with business stakeholders from different department of the Maison.
• Work with project teams to understand their challenges and requirements. Translate them into scalable and efficient Anaplan models.
• Supporting new projects from the beginning to a successful launch.
• Collaborate and federate
• Facilitate the exchanges of experience and best practices among domains, while evaluating the appropriate help based on their specific needs.
• Actively contribute to the Anaplan community by sharing knowledge, collaborating on projects and driving innovation.

Your profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience as an Anaplan Model builder and Anaplan Model builder certification are a must. Anaplan Solution Architect certification is a plus.
• Experience in Supply Chain
• Experience working with Agile methodologies and management tools (e.g. Jira).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Understanding of supply chain processes is a plus.
• English and French.

How do we keep you smiling?

You will play an active role into our Transformation journey, working on solutions that individually generate immediate value, but that collectively enrich our data platform, opening the door to further value creation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130201
La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione.

Come uno dei principali blocchi di costruzione dell'Ufficio dati di Cartier, Connected Planning è una parte critica, ma rapidamente esponente del nostro ecosistema dati.

Il costruttore di modelli Anaplan ha un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo della soluzione all'interno della Maison e nella manutenzione dei modelli garantendo efficienza operativa e continuità aziendale. Come costruttore di modelli, vi assicurerete che i modelli utilizzati a livello Maison sono le migliori pratiche standard del settore e che offrono il miglior livello di prestazioni e robustezza.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

Avrete le seguenti responsabilità:

• Costruzione di modelli
• Implementare le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo del modello, tra cui il controllo delle versioni, la documentazione e le ottimizzazioni tecniche.
• Proattivamente mantenere un alto livello di competenza tecnica, e rimanere aggiornati con gli ultimi sviluppi della Soluzione.
• Assicurare robustezza e perennitÃ dei modelli. Assicurare l'integrità dei dati, la precisione e l'affidabilità all'interno dei modelli.
• Mantenere la documentazione completa, comprese le specifiche di progettazione, le formule e le ipotesi.
• Manutenzione
• Indagare e risolvere i problemi relativi ai modelli Anaplan, comprese le incongruenze dei dati, gli errori delle formule e le prestazioni del sistema. Fornisci supporto agli utenti finali.
• Nuovi progetti
• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali di diversi dipartimenti della Maison.
• Lavora con i team di progetto per comprendere le loro sfide e i loro requisiti. Traducili in modelli Anaplan scalabili ed efficienti.
• Sostenere nuovi progetti dall'inizio a un lancio di successo.
• Collaborazione e federazione
• Facilitare gli scambi di esperienze e le migliori pratiche tra i domini, valutando l'aiuto appropriato in base alle loro esigenze specifiche.
• Contribuire attivamente alla comunità Anaplan condividendo le conoscenze, collaborando a progetti e promuovendo l'innovazione.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria, Informatica, Gestione dei dati, o un campo relativo.
• Esperienza comprovata come un costruttore Anaplan Model e Anaplan Model costruttore certificazione sono un must. Anaplan Solution Architect certificazione è un plus.
• Esperienza nella Supply Chain
• Esperienza di lavoro con metodologie Agile e strumenti di gestione (ad esempio Jira).
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• La comprensione dei processi della supply chain è un vantaggio.
• Inglese e francese.

Come ti facciamo sorridere?

Si svolgerà un ruolo attivo nel nostro viaggio di trasformazione, lavorando su soluzioni che generano individualmente valore immediato, ma che arricchiscono collettivamente la nostra piattaforma di dati, aprendo la porta alla creazione di ulteriore valore.

Der Anaplan Model Builder spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung der Lösung innerhalb der Maison und der Wartung der Modelle, die die betriebliche Effizienz und Geschäftskontinuität gewährleisten. Als Modellbauer stellen Sie sicher, dass Modelle, die Maison-weit verwendet werden, den branchenüblichen Best Practices entsprechen und das beste Leistungs- und Robustheitsniveau bieten.

Wie werden Sie etwas bewirken?

Sie haben folgende Aufgaben:

• Modellbau
• Implementieren Sie Best Practices für die Modellentwicklung, einschließlich Versionskontrolle, Dokumentation und technischer Optimierungen.
• Halten Sie proaktiv ein hohes Maß an technischem Know-how und bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über die neuesten Entwicklungen der Lösung.
• Gewährleistung der Robustheit und Dauerhaftigkeit der Modelle. Gewährleistung der Datenintegrität, -genauigkeit und -zuverlässigkeit innerhalb der Modelle.
• Pflegen Sie eine umfassende Dokumentation, einschließlich Designspezifikationen, Formeln und Annahmen.
• Instandhaltung
• Untersuchen und Beheben von Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Anaplan-Modellen, einschließlich Dateninkonsistenzen, Formelfehlern und Systemleistung. Unterstützung für Endbenutzer.
• Neue Projekte
• Arbeiten Sie mit Geschäftsinteressenten aus verschiedenen Abteilungen der Maison zusammen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Projektteams zusammen, um ihre Herausforderungen und Anforderungen zu verstehen. Übersetzen Sie diese in skalierbare und effiziente Anaplan Modelle.
• Unterstützung neuer Projekte von Anfang an bis zum erfolgreichen Start.
• Zusammenarbeit und Föderation
• Erleichterung des Austauschs von Erfahrungen und bewährten Verfahren zwischen den Bereichen und Bewertung der geeigneten Hilfe auf der Grundlage ihrer spezifischen Bedürfnisse.
• Tragen Sie aktiv zur Anaplan-Gemeinschaft bei, indem Sie Wissen austauschen, an Projekten zusammenarbeiten und Innovationen vorantreiben.

Dein Profil

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, Datenmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Bewährte Erfahrungen als Anaplan Model Builder und Anaplan Model Builder Zertifizierung sind ein Muss. Anaplan Solution Architect Zertifizierung ist ein Plus.
• Erfahrung in Supply Chain
• Erfahrung im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Management-Tools (z.B. Jira).
• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.
• Das Verständnis von Lieferkettenprozessen ist ein Plus.
• Englisch und Französisch.

Wie halten wir dich lächelnd?

Sie werden eine aktive Rolle in unserer Transformationsreise spielen und an Lösungen arbeiten, die individuell unmittelbaren Wert generieren, aber gemeinsam unsere Datenplattform bereichern und die Tür für weitere Wertschöpfung öffnen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Code de référence: JR130201
L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous avons adopté un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes à travers tous les Métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux corporatifs. Nos plus de 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation.

Comme l'un des éléments de base du bureau de données Cartier, la planification connectée est un élément essentiel, mais qui dépense rapidement une partie de notre écosystème de données.

Le constructeur de modèles Anaplan joue un rôle clé dans le développement de la solution au sein de la Maison et la maintenance des modèles assurant l'efficacité opérationnelle et la continuité des activités. En tant que constructeur de modèles, vous vous assurerez que les modèles utilisés à l'échelle de Maison correspondent aux meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et offrent le meilleur niveau de performance et de robustesse.

Comment allez-vous avoir un impact?

Vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :

• Bâtiment modèle
• Mettre en oeuvre des pratiques exemplaires pour l'élaboration de modèles, y compris le contrôle des versions, la documentation et les optimisations techniques.
• Conservez de manière proactive un haut niveau d'expertise technique et restez au courant des derniers développements de la Solution.
• Assurer la robustesse et la perennité des modèles. Assurer l'intégrité, la précision et la fiabilité des données dans les modèles.
• Tenir à jour une documentation complète comprenant les spécifications de conception, les formules et les hypothèses.
• Entretien
• Étudier et résoudre les problèmes liés aux modèles Anaplan, y compris les incohérences dans les données, les erreurs de formule et le rendement du système. Fournir un soutien aux utilisateurs finaux.
• Nouveaux projets
• Collaborer avec des intervenants d'affaires de différents départements de la Maison.
• Travailler avec les équipes de projet pour comprendre leurs défis et leurs exigences. Traduisez-les en modèles Anaplan évolutifs et efficaces.
• Soutenir de nouveaux projets depuis le début jusqu'à un lancement réussi.
• Collaborer et fédérer
• Faciliter l'échange d'expériences et de meilleures pratiques entre les domaines, tout en évaluant l'aide appropriée en fonction de leurs besoins spécifiques.
• Contribuer activement à la communauté Anaplan en partageant les connaissances, en collaborant à des projets et en stimulant l'innovation.

Votre profil

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie, informatique, gestion des données ou un domaine connexe.
• Une expérience éprouvée en tant que constructeur de modèles Anaplan et certification de constructeur de modèles Anaplan sont un must. La certification Anaplan Solution Architect est un plus.
• Expérience dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement
• Expérience de travail avec les méthodologies Agiles et les outils de gestion (p. ex. Jira).
• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
• La compréhension des processus de la chaîne d'approvisionnement est un atout.
• Anglais et français.

Comment tu souris ?

Vous jouerez un rôle actif dans notre parcours de transformation, en travaillant sur des solutions qui génèrent individuellement une valeur immédiate, mais qui enrichissent collectivement notre plate-forme de données, ouvrant la porte à de nouvelles créations de valeur.

titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire en Gestion des Connaissances de la Supply Chain

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130276

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

You will work within Group Supply Chain Execution team to enrich the new Supply Chain Knowledge platform for Watch and Jewelry Maisons, interacting directly with them to build the right approach for publishing and enhancing Group Operating Model knowledge and ensuring W&J business continuity through it.

You will be involved in various ongoing projects to be able to capitalize on documentation and allow the W&J knowledge to spread through the various Group Supply Chain actors in a more structured way and better user accessibility.

You will also deliver the documentation within the appropriate tools, validate each key processes with Maisons and experts, and support the final publication on the platform, looking for a “User buy-in” of this reshuffled and completed documentation platform

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?

You will bring:

• your desire to explore the Supply Chain end-to-end business models, procedures, and best practices of our Watch & Jewelry Maisons
• your appetence for detailed process mapping and for tools associated.
• your soft skills to interact with the Supply Chain departments of our W&J Maisons, IT department, and Richemont Group technical experts.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US?

You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains.

You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two hundred years of heritage with cutting edge innovation.

Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Fribourg, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. The offices are close to local transport with direct access to the train station.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130276

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

Come fai a fare un'infezione?

Potrai lavorare all'interno del team Group Supply Chain Execution per arricchire la nuova piattaforma di Supply Chain Knowledge per Watch and Jewelry Maisons, interagire direttamente con loro per costruire l'approccio giusto per la pubblicazione e migliorare le conoscenze del Modello Operativo del Gruppo e garantire la continuità aziendale W&J attraverso di esso.

Sarete coinvolti in vari progetti in corso per essere in grado di capitalizzare sulla documentazione e permettere alle conoscenze W&J di diffondersi attraverso i vari attori della catena di approvvigionamento di Gruppo in modo più strutturato e migliore accessibilità degli utenti.

Potrai anche fornire la documentazione all'interno degli strumenti appropriati, convalidare ogni processo chiave con Maison e esperti, e sostenere la pubblicazione finale sulla piattaforma, alla ricerca di un “User buy-in” di questa piattaforma di documentazione ripiena e completata

Cosa vuoi fare in questo ruolo?

Porterai:

• il vostro desiderio di esplorare la Supply Chain end-to-end modelli di business, procedure e le migliori pratiche delle nostre Maison di orologi e gioielli
• per la mappatura dettagliata del processo e per gli strumenti associati.
• le vostre competenze morbide per interagire con i reparti di Supply Chain delle nostre W&J Maisons, reparto IT e esperti tecnici del Gruppo Richemont.

Come fai a superare la nostra esperienza?

Potrai lavorare con diverse squadre e avere l'opportunità di conoscere una vasta gamma di domini.

Si otterrà intuizioni nel settore del lusso dalla prospettiva di uno dei leader globali che sta bridging più di duecento anni di patrimonio con innovazione all'avanguardia.

Lavorando nei pressi della campagna svizzera proprio fuori Fribourg, offriamo un ristorante in loco, una splendida cornice e un ampio ambiente di lavoro a pianta aperta. Gli uffici sono vicini al trasporto locale con accesso diretto alla stazione ferroviaria.

#Richemont # WeCraftTheFuture #

Bezugscode: JR130276

Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir der Innovation und dem Design neuer Produkte verpflichtet, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität.

WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND?

Sie werden innerhalb des Group Supply Chain Execution-Teams daran arbeiten, die neue Supply Chain Knowledge-Plattform für Uhren- und Schmuckmaisons zu bereichern, indem Sie direkt mit ihnen interagieren, um den richtigen Ansatz für die Veröffentlichung und Verbesserung des Group Operating Model-Wissens zu entwickeln und die Geschäftskontinuität von W & J sicherzustellen.

Sie werden an verschiedenen laufenden Projekten beteiligt sein, um von der Dokumentation zu profitieren und das W&J-Wissen strukturierter und besser zugänglich durch die verschiedenen Akteure der Supply Chain zu verbreiten.

Sie liefern auch die Dokumentation innerhalb der entsprechenden Tools, validieren jeden wichtigen Prozess mit Maisons und Experten und unterstützen die endgültige Veröffentlichung auf der Plattform, auf der Suche nach einem "User Buy-In" dieser neu gemischten und abgeschlossenen Dokumentationsplattform.

WAS MÜSSEN SIE IN DIESER ROLLE ERFOLGEN?

Sie bringen:

• Ihr Wunsch, die Supply Chain End-to-End-Geschäftsmodelle, Verfahren und Best Practices unserer Uhr & Schmuck Maisons zu erkunden
• Ihre Appetence für detailliertes Prozess-Mapping und damit verbundene Tools.
• Ihre Soft Skills für die Interaktion mit den Supply Chain-Abteilungen unserer W&J Maisons, der IT-Abteilung und den technischen Experten der Richemont Group.

WIE WERDEN SIE UNS ERFAHREN?

Sie werden mit verschiedenen Teams arbeiten und haben die Möglichkeit, über eine Vielzahl von Domains zu lernen.

Sie erhalten Einblicke in die Luxusbranche aus der Perspektive eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen, das mehr als zweihundert Jahre Erbe mit innovativen Innovationen verbindet.

In der Nähe der Schweizer Landschaft direkt außerhalb von Freiburg bieten wir ein Restaurant vor Ort, eine schöne Umgebung und eine geräumige offene Arbeitsumgebung. Die Büros befinden sich in der Nähe des Nahverkehrs mit direktem Zugang zum Bahnhof.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130546

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Business Analyst Intern

Starting Date: September

Duration: 6 months (100%, full-time)

Location: Bellevue, GE, CH

YOU WANT TO:

Discover a unique distribution brand

Improve your business & commercial know-how in a fast-paced & agile environment

Support a wide range of topics (distribution, performance, operations…) with a varied list stakeholders, including other functions, Maisons & retailers

Then you must be the right talent to join TimeVallée!

Launched in 2014, TimeVallée is a visionary multi-brand watch retail concept offering a curated selection of the most prestigious watchmaking Maisons with a complete range of experiences and services.

Fully operated by strategic partners, TimeVallée’s mission is to provide a complete turnkey solution: a 360 brand concept to support the Maison and retail partners , a customer-centric approach to maximize engagement and retention, cross-industry partnerships & unique experiences to boost client acquisition while always looking at excellence in execution.

With more than 50 stores worldwide, TimeVallée is the only multi-brand with a global presence and its ambition is to drive a qualitative and sustainable network growth.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Reporting to the Business Performance & Development Manager, you will be assisting the team as follows:

• Support the timely delivery & accuracy of recurring/ad-hoc presentations and analyses responding to TimeVallée business priorities
• Prepare templates, research, export and consolidate data for analysis for deployment to maisons, retailers, other group functions and top management
• Ensure the updates, maintenance and improvements of various TimeVallée commercial files
• Document existing business processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness

This is a unique opportunity to learn from both the strategic perspective of our headquarters team and the practical realities of working directly with our retail partners, Maisons and other group functions, providing a well-rounded learning experience.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Enrolled in a Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field
• First experience as a business analyst or similar role
• Fluency in English
• Excellent proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint
• Prior experience working with data visualization tools, looker is a plus
• Proactivity, entrepreneurship & team spirit with ability to work independently
• Business oriented with analytical skills
• Available for a 6-month internship starting in September 2026
• You have a mandatory internship agreement by your university

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.
- We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. The next step from there would be an interview with the Hiring Manager.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi raffinati e negli accessori premium. Analizzatore di affari Interno

Data di inizio: settembre

Durata: 6 mesi (100%, a tempo pieno)

Ubicazione: Bellevue, GE, CH

Vuoi...

Scopri un marchio di distribuzione unico

Migliora il tuo know-how commerciale e commerciale in un ambiente veloce e agile

Sostenere una vasta gamma di argomenti (distribuzione, performance, operazioni...) con un elenco variegato stakeholders, tra cui altre funzioni, Maisons & rivenditori

Allora devi essere il talento giusto per unirti a TimeVallée!

Lanciato nel 2014, TimeVallée è un visionario concetto di vendita al dettaglio di orologi multi-brand che offre una selezione curata delle Maison orologiere più prestigiose con una gamma completa di esperienze e servizi.

Interamente gestito da partner strategici, la missione di TimeVallée è quella di fornire una soluzione chiavi in mano completa: un concept a 360 brand per supportare i partner Maison e retail, un approccio orientato al cliente per massimizzare l’impegno e la ritenzione, partnership cross-industry e esperienze uniche per incrementare l’acquisizione del cliente, cercando sempre l’eccellenza nell’esecuzione.

Con oltre 50 negozi in tutto il mondo, TimeVallée è l'unico multi-brand con una presenza globale e la sua ambizione è quella di guidare una crescita di rete qualitativa e sostenibile.

Come fai a fare un'infezione?

Segnalando al Business Performance & Development Manager, assisterai il team come segue:

• Sostenere la consegna tempestiva e l'accuratezza delle presentazioni e delle analisi ricorrenti/ad-hoc rispondendo alle priorità aziendali di TimeVallée
• Preparare modelli, ricerca, esportazione e consolidare i dati per l'analisi per la distribuzione a maison, rivenditori, altre funzioni di gruppo e top management
• Assicurare aggiornamenti, manutenzione e miglioramenti di vari file commerciali TimeVallée
• Documentare i processi aziendali esistenti e suggerire miglioramenti per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia

Questa è un'occasione unica per imparare sia dal punto di vista strategico del nostro team di quartier generale che dalle realtà pratiche di lavorare direttamente con i nostri partner al dettaglio, Maison e altre funzioni di gruppo, fornendo un'esperienza di apprendimento a tutto tondo.

Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi?

• Iscritti in un Master in Business, Finanza, Economia, Gestione o in un campo relativo
• Prima esperienza come analista aziendale o ruolo simile
• Fluency in inglese
• Ottima competenza in Excel & PowerPoint
• Esperienza precedente che lavora con strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati, looker è un plus
• Proattività, imprenditorialità e spirito di squadra con capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente
• Business orientato con competenze analitiche
• Disponibile per uno stage di 6 mesi a partire dal settembre 2026
• Hai un accordo obbligatorio di stage da parte della tua università

Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo?

Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato.

- Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà.
- Noi adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità.
- Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo.

Il tuo viaggio con noi

Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, arriveremo a breve per una chiamata introduttiva. Il prossimo passo da lì sarebbe un'intervista con il responsabile dell'assunzione.

Fully operated by strategic partners, TimeVallée’s mission is to provide a complete turnkey solution: a 360 brand concept to support the Maison and retail partners , a customer-centric approach to maximize engagement and retention, cross-industry partnerships & unique experiences to boost client acquisition while always looking at excellence in execution.

• Support the timely delivery & accuracy of recurring/ad-hoc presentations and analyses responding to TimeVallée business priorities
• Prepare templates, research, export and consolidate data for analysis for deployment to maisons, retailers, other group functions and top management
• Ensure the updates, maintenance and improvements of various TimeVallée commercial files

• First experience as a business analyst or similar role
• Fluency in English
• Excellent proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint
• Prior experience working with data visualization tools, looker is a plus
• Proactivity, entrepreneurship & team spirit with ability to work independently
• Business oriented with analytical skills
• Available for a 6-month internship starting in September 2026
• You have a mandatory internship agreement by your university

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.
- We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. The next step from there would be an interview with the Hiring Manager.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130767

Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura.

Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations.
Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation.

Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design:

• Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity.
• Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants).
• Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency.

Budgeting, Planning & Construction:

• Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning.
• Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards.
• Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting.
• Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations.
• Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project.
• Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards.

Risk Management:

• Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Maintenance:

• Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works.
• Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe.
• Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives.

Transversal Management:

• Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors).

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience:

• Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction.
• Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands.
• Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence.
• Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants.
• Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control.

Technical Competencies:

• Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills.
• Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge.
• Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a significant asset.
• Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise.

Soft Skills:

• Creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about luxury retail environments, architecture, and design trends.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, effective in multicultural teams.
• Agile, adaptable, and adept at managing changing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes.
• Strong decision-maker with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented, continuous improvement mindset.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects.

STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY?

• A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference.
• Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated.
• Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.

The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130767

Circondato dalla sua famiglia e guidato dalla sua forte mentalità imprenditoriale, Georges-Edouard Piaget decise, nel 1874, di creare un'officina orologiera a La Côte-aux-Fées, un piccolo villaggio al centro delle montagne svizzere della Giura.

Da quel giorno, Piaget ha spinto i limiti a “fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima” e artigianale orologi sofisticati e fiammeggianti e creazioni di gioielli.
All’interno delle mura dei nostri Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, i nostri maestri artigiani continuano a sfruttare rare abilità che sono state conservate e perfezionate di generazione in generazione.

Oggi, l’eccezionale maestria di Piaget è celebrata in tutto il mondo, sostenuta da una forte presenza globale e da una rete dedicata di supporto clienti e colleghi retail che portano lo spirito della nostra Maison alla vita ogni giorno.

Come fai a fare un'infezione?

In qualità di responsabile del progetto Store Planning and Construction, dirigerai il ciclo di vita completo dei progetti di sviluppo retail di Piaget in tutta Europa, dalla progettazione alla post-apertura. Questo ruolo fondamentale, fondendo le competenze del quartier generale e regionale, assicura sia la disabilità del brand attraverso l'eccellenza del design e la produttività del marchio attraverso l'efficienza operativa, la qualità, il controllo dei costi e la sostenibilità. Sarete strumentali nel fornire il programma di sviluppo e ristrutturazione retail della regione, sostenere la disabilità del marchio, la qualità dell'esecuzione, la pianificazione del progetto, il bilancio e gli impegni di sostenibilità. I viaggi regolari in Francia, Svizzera, Italia e Nordics sono essenziali per la valutazione del sito e la supervisione del progetto.

RISPOSTE DI LAVORO

Design:

• Coordinate lo sviluppo del design dal concetto alla documentazione costruttiva, garantendo coerenza con gli standard architettonici di Piaget e l'identità di Brand.
• Gestire gli specialisti del design esterno (architetti, artisti 3D, consulenti).
• Collabora con i team HQ Retail, VM e Commercial per ottimizzare l'esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e l'efficienza operativa.

Budgeting, Pianificazione & Costruzione:

• Condurre i progetti dalla convalida degli investimenti attraverso la costruzione e la chiusura, lo sviluppo e il controllo dei bilanci, CAPEX e la pianificazione.
• Guidare l'appalto, le valutazioni tecniche, i negoziati commerciali e i premi contrattuali.
• Gestisci gli acquisti, gli ordini di acquisto, gli ordini di cambiamento e la rendicontazione finanziaria.
• Coordinate permettendo, approvazioni del proprietario, e le relazioni dell'autorità locale.
• Agire come stakeholder chiave con i partner di Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legale ed Estero in tutto il progetto.
• Gestisci tutte le fasi di costruzione, assicurando che i progetti vengano consegnati in tempo, all'interno del budget e agli standard di qualità e sostenibilità di Piaget.

Gestione del rischio:

• Identificare i rischi del progetto e implementare piani di mitigazione e recupero.

Manutenzione:

• Coordinare programmi di manutenzione regionale e post-apertura, tra cui snagging, progetti retrofit e lavori minori.
• Mantenere la comunicazione regolare con i team commerciali e i direttori di boutique in tutta Europa.
• Garantire il rispetto degli standard, della qualità e degli obiettivi di sostenibilità del marchio Piaget.

Gestione trasversale:

• Atto come l'interfaccia HQ primaria per la regione Europa, coordinando i mercati regionali per la costruzione e la manutenzione di boutique.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interni (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legale, Finanza, Sicurezza, VM, Contenuti) e sviluppare relazioni forti con i partner esterni (ufficiali, consulenti, appaltatori).

Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi?

Esperienza:

• Minimo 10 anni in Architettura, Architettura degli Interni, o Costruzione Project Management, con almeno 7 anni in particolare nel lusso Store Planning and Construction.
• Provato track record che offre progetti di vendita al dettaglio internazionali all'interno del settore di lusso o marchi premium.
• Solida comprensione del design di lusso, dei processi di costruzione e dell'eccellenza operativa.
• Ampia esperienza nella gestione di architetti esecutivi, sondaggi quantità, contraenti generali e consulenti specializzati.
• Forte conoscenza degli appalti, della gestione delle offerte, dei negoziati commerciali e del controllo dei costi.

Competenze tecniche:

• Eccezionale capacità di analisi, pianificazione e gestione del progetto.
• Straordinarie capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Proficienza in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite e conoscenze avanzate di Microsoft Office Suite.
• La fluenza professionale in inglese e francese è essenziale; le lingue aggiuntive sono un bene significativo.
• Forte consapevolezza commerciale, comprovate capacità di negoziazione e competenze sui costi di costruzione.

Abilità morbide:

• Creativo, orientato alla soluzione e appassionato di ambienti retail di lusso, architettura e tendenze di design.
• Ottima capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, efficace in team multiculturali.
• Agile, adattabile, e adatto a gestire le mutevoli priorità e i paesaggi complessi delle parti interessate.
• Un decisore forte con un elevato senso di proprietà, responsabilità e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo orientata ai risultati.
• Altamente organizzato, proattivo e capace di gestire simultaneamente più progetti strategici.

Stavo pensando perche' dovresti chiederlo?

• A Welcoming Team: Unisciti alla nostra squadra amichevole, aperta e di talento, dove le tue abilità saranno valutate e i tuoi contributi faranno una vera differenza.
• Lavoro dinamico e coinvolgente: sperimentare attività quotidiane che sono interessanti, stimolanti e diversificate, mantenendovi impegnati e motivati.
• Investimenti nella vostra crescita: Siamo appassionati di sviluppare la nostra gente, e avrete accesso a varie opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per migliorare le vostre abilità e migliorare la vostra carriera.

La cultura Piaget di incoraggiare Extra-Care, promuovere la Mastery e far emergere lo Straordinario nel nostro popolo, significa che andremo sempre oltre, facendo “cosa non è mai stato fatto prima”. Insieme. Se si desidera diventare una parte di esso non esitate ad applicare!

In den Mauern unserer Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire nutzen unsere Handwerksmeister weiterhin seltene Fähigkeiten, die von Generation zu Generation erhalten und perfektioniert wurden.

Heute wird die außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst von Piaget weltweit gefeiert, unterstützt durch eine starke globale Präsenz und ein engagiertes Netzwerk von Kunden- und Einzelhandelskollegen, die den Geist unseres Hauses jeden Tag zum Leben erwecken.

WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND?

Als Projektmanager für Store Planning und Construction führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einzelhandelsentwicklungsprojekte von Piaget in der gesamten Region Europa an, vom Design bis zur Eröffnung. Diese zentrale Rolle, die den Hauptsitz und die regionalen Verantwortlichkeiten verbindet, gewährleistet sowohl die Markenerwünschtheit durch Design-Exzellenz als auch die Markenproduktivität durch betriebliche Effizienz, Qualität, Kostenkontrolle und Nachhaltigkeit. Sie sind maßgeblich an der Umsetzung des Einzelhandelsentwicklungs- und -renovierungsprogramms der Region beteiligt und halten die Markenerwünschtheit, die Ausführungsqualität, die Projektplanung, das Budget und die Nachhaltigkeitsverpflichtungen ein. Regelmäßige Reisen durch Frankreich, die Schweiz, Italien und die nordischen Länder sind für Standortbewertungen und die Projektaufsicht unerlässlich.

WICHTIGKEITEN

Konstruktion:

• Koordinieren Sie die Designentwicklung vom Konzept bis zur Baudokumentation und gewährleisten Sie die Konsistenz mit den architektonischen Standards und der Markenidentität von Piaget.
• Verwalten Sie externe Design-Spezialisten (Architekten, 3D-Künstler, Berater).
• Arbeiten Sie mit den Teams von HQ Retail, VM und Commercial zusammen, um die Einzelhandelserfahrung und die betriebliche Effizienz zu optimieren.

Budgetierung, Planung & Bau:

• Führen Sie Projekte von der Investitionsvalidierung über Bau und Close-Out, Entwicklung und Kontrolle von Budgets, CAPEX und Planung.
• Fahre Ausschreibungen, technische Bewertungen, kommerzielle Verhandlungen und Auftragsvergaben.
• Verwalten Sie Beschaffung, Kaufaufträge, Änderungsaufträge und Finanzberichterstattung.
• Koordinieren Sie Genehmigungen, Vermietergenehmigungen und lokale Behördenbeziehungen.
• Handeln Sie als wichtiger Stakeholder mit Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal und externen Partnern während des gesamten Projekts.
• Verwalten Sie alle Bauphasen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Projekte pünktlich, im Rahmen des Budgets und nach den Qualitäts- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards von Piaget geliefert werden.

Risikomanagement:

• Identifizieren Sie Projektrisiken und implementieren Sie Minderungs- und Sanierungspläne.

Instandhaltung:

• Koordinieren Sie regionale Wartungs- und Nacheröffnungsprogramme, einschließlich Snagging, Retrofit-Projekte und kleinere Arbeiten.
• Pflegen Sie regelmäßige Kommunikation mit kommerziellen Teams und Boutique Directors in ganz Europa.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Standards, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeitsziele der Marke Piaget.

Transversales Management:

• Er fungiert als primäre HQ-Schnittstelle für die Region Europa und koordiniert regionale Märkte für den Bau und die Wartung von Boutiquen.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Einzelhandel, Beschaffung, Immobilien, Recht, Finanzen, Sicherheit, VM, Inhalte) und Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu externen Partnern (Vermieter, Berater, Auftragnehmer).

WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS?

Erfahrung:

• Mindestens 10 Jahre in Architektur, Innenarchitektur oder Bauprojektmanagement, mit mindestens 7 Jahren speziell in Luxusgeschäft Planung und Bau.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung internationaler Einzelhandelsprojekte innerhalb der Luxusbranche oder Premiummarken.
• Solides Verständnis von Luxusdesign, Bauprozessen und operativer Exzellenz.
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Management von Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, Generalunternehmern und Fachberatern.
• Starke Kenntnisse in Beschaffung, Ausschreibungsmanagement, Handelsverhandlungen und Kostenkontrolle.

Technische Kompetenzen:

• Außergewöhnliche analytische, Planungs- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.
• Herausragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.
• Kenntnisse in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite und erweiterten Kenntnissen der Microsoft Office Suite.
• Professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein wichtiger Vorteil.
• Starkes kommerzielles Bewusstsein, nachgewiesenes Verhandlungsgeschick und Baukosten-Know-how.

Soft Skills:

• Kreativ, lösungsorientiert und leidenschaftlich für Luxus-Einzelhandelsumgebungen, Architektur und Designtrends.
• Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, effektiv in multikulturellen Teams.
• Agile, anpassungsfähig und geschickt im Management sich verändernder Prioritäten und komplexer Stakeholder-Landschaften.
• Starker Entscheidungsträger mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verantwortlichkeit und einer ergebnisorientierten, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmentalität.
• Hoch organisiert, proaktiv und in der Lage, gleichzeitig mehrere strategische Projekte zu verwalten.

WUNDERUNG WARUM SIE ANWENDEN SOLLTEN?

• Ein Willkommensteam: Treten Sie unserem freundlichen, aufgeschlossenen und talentierten Team bei, in dem Ihre Fähigkeiten geschätzt werden und Ihre Beiträge einen echten Unterschied machen.
• Dynamische und engagierte Arbeit: Erleben Sie tägliche Aktivitäten, die interessant, herausfordernd und vielfältig sind und Sie engagiert und motiviert halten.
• Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, unsere Mitarbeiter zu entwickeln, und Sie haben Zugang zu verschiedenen Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben.

Die Piaget-Kultur der Förderung von Extra-Care, der Förderung der Meisterschaft und der Hervorbringung des Außerordentlichen in unserem Volk bedeutet, dass wir immer weiter gehen und tun werden, "was noch nie zuvor getan wurde". Gemeinsam. Wenn Sie ein Teil davon werden wollen, zögern Sie nicht, sich zu bewerben!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Code de référence: JR130767

Entouré de sa famille et guidé par son esprit d'entreprise fort, Georges-Edouard Piaget décide, en 1874, de créer un atelier d'horlogerie à La Côte-aux-Fées, petit village au milieu des montagnes suisses du Jura.

Depuis ce jour, Piaget a poussé les limites à faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant.
Dans les murs de nos Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire, nos maîtres artisans continuent d'exploiter des compétences rares qui ont été préservées et perfectionnées de génération en génération.

Aujourd'hui, l'artisanat exceptionnel de Piaget est célébré dans le monde entier, soutenu par une forte présence mondiale et un réseau dédié de clients et de collègues de vente au détail qui animent chaque jour l'esprit de notre Maison.

Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ?

En tant que responsable de projet de planification et de construction de magasins, vous dirigerez le cycle de vie complet des projets de développement de détail de Piaget dans toute la région d'Europe, de la conception à la post-ouverture. Ce rôle central, qui combine les responsabilités de l'Administration centrale et celles de la région, assure à la fois l'opportunité de la marque par l'excellence de la conception et la productivité de la marque par l'efficacité opérationnelle, la qualité, le contrôle des coûts et la durabilité. Vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la mise en oeuvre du programme de développement et de rénovation de la région, dans le respect de l'intérêt de la marque, de la qualité de l'exécution, de la planification de projet, du budget et des engagements en matière de durabilité. Les voyages réguliers en France, en Suisse, en Italie et dans les pays nordiques sont essentiels pour l'évaluation des sites et la supervision des projets.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Conception:

• Coordonner le développement de la conception du concept à la documentation de construction, en assurant la cohérence avec les normes architecturales de Piaget et l'identité de marque.
• Gérer des spécialistes du design externe (architectes, artistes 3D, consultants).
• Collaborez avec les équipes de vente au détail, de VM et de Commercial pour optimiser l'expérience de vente au détail et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Budget, planification et construction :

• Diriger les projets depuis la validation des investissements jusqu'à la construction et à la clôture, à l'élaboration et au contrôle des budgets, du CAPEX et de la planification.
• Diriger les appels d'offres, les évaluations techniques, les négociations commerciales et l'attribution des marchés.
• Gérer les achats, les commandes, les commandes de modification et les rapports financiers.
• Coordonner les permis, les approbations des propriétaires et les relations avec les autorités locales.
• Agir en tant qu'intervenant clé auprès de Groupe Approvisionnement, Immobilier, juridique et des partenaires externes tout au long du projet.
• Gérer toutes les phases de construction, en veillant à ce que les projets soient exécutés dans les délais, dans les limites du budget et selon les normes de qualité et de durabilité de Piaget.

Gestion des risques :

• Identifier les risques du projet et mettre en oeuvre des plans d'atténuation et de rétablissement.

Entretien:

• Coordonner les programmes régionaux d'entretien et de post-ouverture, y compris les travaux d'apposition, les projets de modernisation et les travaux mineurs.
• Maintenir une communication régulière avec les équipes commerciales et les directeurs de boutiques en Europe.
• Assurer le respect des normes de la marque Piaget, de la qualité et des objectifs de durabilité.

Gestion transversale :

• Agir en tant qu'interface principale du siège social pour la région Europe, en coordonnant les marchés régionaux pour la construction et l'entretien de boutiques.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes (Retail, Approvisionnement, Immobilier, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) et développer de solides relations avec des partenaires externes (locaux, consultants, entrepreneurs).

Comment allez-vous nous convaincre?

Expérience :

• Minimum 10 ans en Architecture, Architecture Intérieure ou Gestion de Projet de Construction, avec au moins 7 ans spécifiquement dans la planification de magasins de luxe et la construction.
• Expérience éprouvée dans la réalisation de projets internationaux de vente au détail dans l'industrie du luxe ou des marques haut de gamme.
• Une bonne compréhension de la conception de luxe, des processus de construction et de l'excellence opérationnelle.
• Expérience approfondie en gestion d'architectes exécutifs, d'arpenteurs de quantité, d'entrepreneurs généraux et de consultants spécialisés.
• Bonne connaissance de l'approvisionnement, de la gestion des appels d'offres, des négociations commerciales et du contrôle des coûts.

Compétences techniques :

• Compétences exceptionnelles en analyse, planification et gestion de projet.
• Capacités exceptionnelles de communication, de présentation et de gestion des intervenants.
• Compétence en AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite et connaissances avancées de Microsoft Office Suite.
• La maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais est essentielle; d'autres langues constituent un atout important.
• Forte sensibilisation commerciale, compétences éprouvées en négociation et expertise en coûts de construction.

Compétences souples :

• Créative, orientée vers la solution et passionnée par les environnements de détail de luxe, l'architecture et les tendances du design.
• Excellente capacité de collaboration et de communication, efficace dans les équipes multiculturelles.
• Agile, adaptable et apte à gérer des priorités changeantes et des paysages d'intervenants complexes.
• Un décideur fort avec un sentiment élevé d'appropriation, de responsabilité et d'amélioration continue axée sur les résultats.
• Très organisé, proactif et capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets stratégiques.

J'aimerais encore savoir pourquoi tu te présentes ?

• Une équipe accueillante : Rejoignez notre équipe amicale, ouverte d'esprit et talentueuse, où vos compétences seront valorisées et vos contributions feront une réelle différence.
• Travail dynamique et stimulant : Vivez des activités quotidiennes intéressantes, stimulantes et diversifiées, qui vous maintiennent engagés et motivés.
• Investir dans votre croissance : Nous sommes passionnés par le développement de notre personnel, et vous aurez accès à diverses possibilités de formation et de perfectionnement pour améliorer vos compétences et faire progresser votre carrière.

La culture Piaget d'encourager Extra-Care, d'encourager la maîtrise et de faire sortir l'extraordinaire dans notre peuple, signifie que nous allons toujours aller plus loin, faisant ce qui n'a jamais été fait auparavant. Ensemble. Si vous voulez en faire partie, n'hésitez pas à postuler !

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130726

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

WE RECRUIT

Within Richemont group, Richemont China Affairs & Strategy department has proven to be an effective asset in the development of the relations between various Chinese organizations, Richemont and its Maisons. The department dedicates to providing not only strategic insight and advice as an intelligence desk, but also operational support to all the Maisons of Richemont, and high-level representation of Richemont towards trade and official Chinese partners. Richemont China Affairs & Strategy department is looking for a proactive and business operation competent China Affairs Intern.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Research and Analysis

• Assist our team to provide analytical insights on macro-economy and consumer market to the Group and Maisons
• Monitor Chinese domestic and overseas markets for information on Chinese travellers & local Chinese communities
• Prepare accurate presentation material to deliver research insights in a comprehensive manner effectively
• Compile information for ad-hoc topics according to Richemont Group’s & Maisons’ requests

Operational Support

• Support the planning, follow-up, and execution of Department’s business operation projects worldwide
• Help the team to identify, explore, and establish contact with prospective business partners and clients for the Maisons’ business
• Assist our team in maintaining and strengthening relationship with existing business partners and Richemont Maisons

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Student with « convention de stage »
• 1-2 years of work experience in project management/market research/business development
• Good knowledge of macro/micro-economy and geopolitics, as well as the luxury industry
• Impeccable analytical skills for editorial and research purposes
• Proven capability to handle multiple priorities and to work in a dynamic, constantly changing field
• Good interpersonal skills; ability to handle problematic issues and balance multiple interlocutors and projects
• Fluency in English and Chinese is mandatory, fluency in French is a plus
• Prior experience in luxury sector or high-net-worth audience-facing businesses is a plus
