Una High Jewelry House con un patrimonio forte che promuove un know-how eccezionale in un ambiente incantevole e creativo.

La nostra Maison è alla ricerca di persone di talento che contribuiscono a sviluppare e trasmettere le loro competenze con cura e senza compromessi. A Van Cleef & Arpels sarete circondati da esperti appassionati e contribuirà a numerosi nuovi progetti che permettono alla nostra Maison di reinventarsi regolarmente.

A Van Cleef & Arpels, siamo orgogliosi di attrarre talenti da diversi background ed esperienze. Crediamo che quando la diversità e l'inclusione sono pienamente abbracciati e potenziati, la creatività e la conoscenza emergono per offrire l'eccellenza.

Corrisponde al profilo?

Sei forte da una solida esperienza sui temi architettonici/modelli delle soluzioni di pianificazione.
Si padroneggia Anaplan perfettamente e hanno una forte sensibilità funzionale.

Siete orientati al progetto – metodi agili e cicli V.

Curioso e potente, si agisce per migliorare e trovare la soluzione ottimale.

Hai eccellenti capacità relazionali per evolverti con molte squadre trasversali.

Siete una forza di proposta e di persuasione per consigliare efficacemente le squadre.

Siete organizzati e rigorosi.

Analitico, sei a tuo agio con i numeri.

Sei agile e autonomo.
Padrone inglese.

Se è così, non esitate a fare domanda!

Cosa ci aspettiamo da te?

All'interno del dipartimento Technology & Data e collegato al responsabile senior Data Engage & Planning Systems, si è incaricati di implementare progetti Anaplan trasversali per la Casa. Lei interviene dall'espressione del bisogno di supporto post-go-live. Animare, sviluppare ed evolvere applicazioni Anaplan.

Come parte dei vostri doveri:

• Garantisci il buon funzionamento dei progetti Anaplan, dalle fasi di scoping all'implementazione delle applicazioni, nonché la gestione e la pianificazione del budget.
• Lei è il garante dell'adeguatezza delle soluzioni proposte alle esigenze dei Trades e della strategia del Parlamento.
• Lei agisce come vero ambasciatore della funzione e garantisce una stretta collaborazione tra team interni ed esterni.
• Sei coinvolto nella realizzazione e nello sviluppo di progetti Anaplan (design di moduli Anaplan, definizione di architettura tecnica, sviluppo di interazioni tra moduli diversi, qualità dei flussi di dati...).
• Si assiste gli utenti nelle fasi di test.
• Garantisci il mantenimento e l'evoluzione della roadmap Anaplan della Casa facendola evolvere, animando la comunità Anaplan della Casa e introducendo un orologio tecnologico.
• Hai la responsabilità di gestire un team di integrazione esterno.

Più di un lavoro... Stiamo reclutando per una carriera!

Integrare Van Cleef & Arpels è soprattutto un team in cui lo sviluppo dei dipendenti è al centro della nostra ambizione.

Potrai beneficiare della piena integrazione con la formazione sulla nostra storia, il nostro know-how e creazioni, e il supporto quotidiano.

Il processo di reclutamento

Applicare direttamente online

Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, sei contattato dal team HR per un'intervista.

Poi si incontra in fasi, il responsabile senior Data Entangling & Planning, poi il responsabile dei dati.

Se necessario, riceverete una e-mail informandovi del rifiuto della vostra richiesta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR130985

Who are we?

A High Jewelry House with a strong heritage who promote exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment.

Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.

At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to attract talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence.

Do you match the profile?

You are strong from a solid experience on architectural/model-bulding issues of planning solutions.
You master Anaplan perfectly and have a strong functional sensitivity.

You are project oriented – agile methods and V-cycles.

Curious and powerful, you act with a view to improving and finding the optimal solution.

You have excellent relational skills in order to evolve with many transverse teams.

You are a force of proposal and persuasion to effectively advise the teams.

You are organized and rigorous.

Analytic, you're comfortable with the numbers.

You are agile and autonomous.
You master English.

If so, do not hesitate to apply!

What do we expect from you?

Within the Technology & Data department and attached to the Senior Manager Data Engage & Planning Systems, you are in charge of implementing transversal Anaplan projects for the House. You intervene from the expression of need to post-go-live support. You animate, develop and evolve Anaplan applications.

As part of your duties:

• You ensure the smooth running of Anaplan projects, from the scoping phases to the deployment of applications as well as budget management and planning.
• You are the guarantor of the adequacy of the solutions proposed to the needs of the Trades and the strategy of the House.
• You act as the true ambassador of the function and ensure close collaboration between internal and external teams.
• You are involved in the implementation and development of Anaplan projects (design of Anaplan modules, definition of technical architecture, development of interactions between different modules, quality of data flows...).
• You assist users in testing phases.
• You guarantee the maintenance and evolution of the Anaplan roadmap of the House by making it evolve, by animating the Anaplan community of the House and by introducing a technological watch.
• You have a responsibility to manage an external integration team.

More than a job... We're recruiting for a career!

Integrating Van Cleef & Arpels is above all a team where the development of employees is at the heart of our ambition.

You will benefit from full integration with training on our history, our know-how and creations, and daily support.

Apply directly online

If your profile is selected, you are contacted by the HR team for an interview.

jobs.title: Associate Security Technology Engineer

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur associé en technologie de sécurité

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131014

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

The primary role of the Associate Security Technology Engineer is to support Richemont’s Group Operational Technology/Internet of Things (OT/IoT) security strategy through the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of OT/IoT security technologies across manufacturing and industrial environments. It operates at the intersection of Group Security, Business Owners, and Maison manufacturing teams, ensuring that OT/IoT security capabilities are aligned with operational constraints, risk profiles, and Group security standards, reinforcing accountability within the First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Deploy and implement OT/IOT security monitoring technologies across manufacturing and operational environments in line with Group Security standards.
• Act as an operational Group OT security interface for Manufacturing entities and selected Maisons and Group Platforms & Group Technology
• Execute the Group OT/IOT security strategy by translating defined requirements into operable and scalable security technology solutions.
• Ensure OT/IOT security monitoring technologies are operational, reliable, and delivering expected services within industrial availability and safety constraints.
• Operate and manage OT/IOT security technologies within assigned scope, ensuring compliance with Group policies and applicable industry regulations.
• Contribute to Group‑level security initiatives and projects on the OT/IOT technology track, working with cross‑functional stakeholders across regions and Maisons and Group functions
• Maintain and update documentation related to OT/IOT security technologies, including deployment, configuration, and operational procedures.
• Provide technical guidance and enablement to internal stakeholders and team members on the use of OT/IOT security technologies in manufacturing environments.
• Contribute & Supports OT SOC development.
• Supports CSIRT/FUSION Center, if required, in case of OT/IT incidents.
• Manage and/or contribute to projects, also outside of the OT/IOT scope, ran by Group Security Technology.
• Contribute to the general support within Group Security Technology.

REQUIREMENTS / SKILLS:

• Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Information Technology / Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in OT/IOT security/systems, evidenced by relevant industry certifications is an advantage.
• Hands-on experience in technical engineering and operational experience.
• Experience in cross-teams projects.
• Experience in a multinational, global environment.
• Proficiency in Windows and Unix/Linux OS environment.
• Knowledge of Python, or any other programming language is an asset.
• Knowledge of OT/IoT most common protocols and standards
• Knowledge of Cloud and Cloud Security.
• Exposure to industrial environments (manufacturing, production systems, etc.)
• Experience working with plant engineers, automation teams, or industrial vendors
• Excellent proficiency in English & French. Fluency in additional languages is a strong asset.
• Collaborative and open mindset, good listening skills, and strong feedback culture.
• Highly curious, proactive, autonomous, and agile.
• Outstanding personal and professional integrity and work ethics.
• Exceptional analytical mindset, keen attention to detail, and an advocate for cybersecurity.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

Il ruolo primario dell’Associated Security Technology Engineer è quello di supportare la strategia di sicurezza del Gruppo Richemont per la tecnologia operativa/Internet of Things (OT/IoT) attraverso l’implementazione, il funzionamento e il miglioramento continuo delle tecnologie di sicurezza OT/IoT negli ambienti produttivi e industriali. Opera all'incrocio tra gruppi di sicurezza di Gruppo, imprenditori e team di produzione di Maison, assicurando che le capacità di sicurezza OT/IoT siano allineate con vincoli operativi, profili di rischio e standard di sicurezza di Gruppo, rafforzando la responsabilità all'interno della First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology).

RISPOSTE DI KEY:

• Distribuire e implementare le tecnologie di monitoraggio della sicurezza OT/IOT in ambienti produttivi e operativi in linea con gli standard di sicurezza di Gruppo.
• Atto come un'interfaccia di sicurezza del Gruppo operativo OT per le entità manifatturiere e le piattaforme di gruppo selezionate & Group Technology
• Eseguire la strategia di sicurezza del Gruppo OT/IOT traducendo i requisiti definiti in soluzioni tecnologiche di sicurezza operabili e scalabili.
• Assicurarsi che le tecnologie di monitoraggio della sicurezza OT/IOT siano operative, affidabili e che forniscono servizi attesi all'interno della disponibilità industriale e dei vincoli di sicurezza.
• Operare e gestire le tecnologie di sicurezza OT/IOT nell'ambito di applicazione assegnata, garantendo il rispetto delle politiche di Gruppo e delle normative industriali applicabili.
• Contribuisci alle iniziative e ai progetti di sicurezza a livello di Gruppo sulla pista tecnologica OT/IOT, lavorando con gli stakeholder interfunzionali in tutte le regioni e le funzioni di Maison e Group
• Mantenere e aggiornare la documentazione relativa alle tecnologie di sicurezza OT/IOT, tra cui distribuzione, configurazione e procedure operative.
• Fornire assistenza tecnica e abilitazione agli stakeholder interni e ai membri del team sull'uso delle tecnologie di sicurezza OT/IOT negli ambienti produttivi.
• Contribuisci & Supporta lo sviluppo di OT SOC.
• Supporta CSIRT/FUSION Centro, se necessario, in caso di incidenti OT/IT.
• Gestire e/o contribuire a progetti, anche al di fuori del campo OT/IOT, gestiti da Group Security Technology.
• Contribuisci al supporto generale all'interno di Group Security Technology.

PRESCRIZIONI / SKILLS:

• Laurea con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale in Informatica / Informatica o esperienza equivalente.
• La comprovata esperienza nella sicurezza/sistemi OT/IOT, evidenziata da certificazioni di settore rilevanti è un vantaggio.
• Esperienza pratica nell'ingegneria tecnica e nell'esperienza operativa.
• Esperienza nei progetti cross-teams.
• Esperienza in un ambiente multinazionale e globale.
• Proficienza in ambiente Windows e Unix/Linux OS.
• La conoscenza di Python, o qualsiasi altro linguaggio di programmazione è un bene.
• Conoscenza dei protocolli e degli standard più comuni di OT/IoT
• Conoscenza di Cloud e Cloud Security.
• Esposizione ad ambienti industriali (produzione, sistemi di produzione, ecc.)
• Esperienza di lavoro con ingegneri, team di automazione o fornitori industriali
• Ottima competenza in inglese e francese. La fluidità nelle lingue aggiuntive è un bene forte.
• mentalità collaborativa e aperta, buone capacità di ascolto e forte cultura del feedback.
• Molto curioso, proattivo, autonomo e agile.
• Eccellente integrità personale e professionale ed etica del lavoro.
• Eccezionale mentalità analitica, molta attenzione ai dettagli, e un avvocato per la sicurezza informatica.

#Richemont # WeCraftTheFuture #

Bezugscode: JR131014

Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität.

Die Hauptaufgabe des Associate Security Technology Engineer besteht darin, Richemonts Group Operational Technology/Internet of Things (OT/IoT)-Sicherheitsstrategie durch die Bereitstellung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von OT/IoT-Sicherheitstechnologien in Fertigungs- und Industrieumgebungen zu unterstützen. Es arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Gruppensicherheit, Geschäftsinhabern und Maison-Fertigungsteams und stellt sicher, dass die OT/IoT-Sicherheitsfunktionen an operativen Einschränkungen, Risikoprofilen und Gruppensicherheitsstandards ausgerichtet sind, wodurch die Rechenschaftspflicht innerhalb der First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology) gestärkt wird.

WICHTIGKEITEN:

• Bereitstellung und Implementierung von OT/IOT-Sicherheitsüberwachungstechnologien in Fertigungs- und Betriebsumgebungen im Einklang mit den Sicherheitsstandards der Gruppe.
• Handeln Sie als operative Group OT-Sicherheitsschnittstelle für Fertigungsunternehmen und ausgewählte Maisons und Gruppenplattformen & Group Technology
• Führen Sie die Group OT/IOT-Sicherheitsstrategie aus, indem Sie definierte Anforderungen in funktionsfähige und skalierbare Sicherheitstechnologielösungen übersetzen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass OT/IOT-Sicherheitsüberwachungstechnologien betriebsbereit und zuverlässig sind und die erwarteten Dienste innerhalb der industriellen Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheitsbeschränkungen bereitstellen.
• Betrieb und Verwaltung von OT/IOT-Sicherheitstechnologien innerhalb des zugewiesenen Anwendungsbereichs, um die Einhaltung der Gruppenrichtlinien und der geltenden Branchenvorschriften sicherzustellen.
• Beitrag zu Sicherheitsinitiativen und -projekten auf Gruppenebene im Bereich der OT/IOT-Technologie, Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern in allen Regionen und mit Maisons und Gruppenfunktionen
• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie die Dokumentation in Bezug auf OT/IOT-Sicherheitstechnologien, einschließlich Bereitstellungs-, Konfigurations- und Betriebsverfahren.
• Bereitstellung technischer Unterstützung und Unterstützung für interne Stakeholder und Teammitglieder zum Einsatz von OT/IOT-Sicherheitstechnologien in Fertigungsumgebungen.
• Contribute & Supports OT SOC Entwicklung.
• Unterstützt CSIRT/FUSION Center, falls erforderlich, im Falle von OT / IT-Vorfällen.
• Verwalten und/oder beitragen zu Projekten, auch außerhalb des OT/IOT-Bereichs, die von Group Security Technology betrieben werden.

jobs.description:

Who are we?

A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment.

Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.

At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence.

ARE YOU A GOOD MATCH?

Your management and leadership skills allow you to collaborate, empower and communicate with different teams.

Analytical, you are pragmatic and results oriented

You are able to drive a portfolio of different projects with strong planning and organization skills

You have a strategic and business-oriented mindset.

You have a team player attitude and foster collaboration in the team.

You have knowledge of SQL, Python and Google Looker.

You are fluent in English.

WHAT ARE OUR EXPECTATIONS?

Within the International Retail Department and reporting to the Retail Performance Senior Manager, you will lead a team of analysts responsible for the creation, diffusion, maintenance, evolution and analysis of various performance indicators and reports for the Retail teams (HQ, regions, markets, boutiques) and the Maison Top Management.

In this function, you will:

• Act as a key ambassador, referent and expert for all retail performance analytical topics for HQ and regional stakeholders. You will identify emerging trends and opportunities.
• Lead the transition to new Looker reporting tools, encompassing data quality, oversee the design, development and maintenance of dashboards…
• Track key performance indicators and deliver actionable insights.
• Lead and manage a team of analysts.
• Drive a strong performance culture with training programs and build and nurture a cross-functional community.

MORE THAN A JOB...We recruit for a career!

By joining Van Cleef & Arpels you will be part of a Maison where employee career development is at the heart of our ambition.

Upon your arrival, you will be immersed into our enchanting world with trainings on our history, our know-how and our creations.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Send your application online.

If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Along the recruitment process you will meet the Retail Performance Senior Manager then the Retail Excellence Director. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR131187

Who are we?

A High Jewelry House with a strong heritage who promote exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment.

Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allow our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.

At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to attract talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence.

Do you match the profile?

You are strong from a significant experience as director of a supply chain division.

You have a solid managerial experience and know how to embark your teams.

You master the business issues associated with supply chain and quickly understand the opportunities of your environment.

Your expertise allows you to bring a true long-term vision of your projects.

Your relationship qualities allow you to act as a true partner with a variety of teams and interlocutors.

You have strong leadership that allows you to convince your contact person to present the best solution.

You are agility, serenity and proactivity in carrying out your missions.

You master perfectly English

If so, do not hesitate to apply!

What do we expect from you?

Attached to the International Supply Chain Director, you are responsible for the business planning for all of the company's product lines. You and your team drive and drive all the forecasting processes with regions and calculations of needs, range and novelty.

As part of your duties:

• You are responsible for key downstream processes (forecasting of demand with regions, calculation of needs with supply chain upstream).
• You coordinate all the different project interlocutors on the transversal processes (new, life cycles, budget and stock, continuous improvement).
• You drive the monthly processes: sales forecasts, calculation of need, projected stock, forecast variances and budgets...
• You also lead the annual and tactical processes including S&OP.
• You promote Change Management within the central supply teams and in the regions.
• You maintain the level of excellence of the world community (dedicated training, seminar, action plan...)
• You manage a team of central planners.

More than a job... We're recruiting for a career!

Integrating Van Cleef & Arpels is above all a team where the development of employees is at the heart of our ambition.

You will benefit from full integration with training on our history, our know-how and creations, and daily support.

The recruitment process

Apply directly online

If your profile is selected, you are contacted by the HR team for an interview.

Then you meet the International Supply Chain Director and then the International Operations & Trades Director.

If necessary, you will receive an email informing you of the refusal of your application.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR131187

Wer sind wir?

Ein Hochschmuckhaus mit einem starken Erbe, das außergewöhnliches Know-how in einer bezaubernden und kreativen Umgebung fördert.

Unser Haus sucht talentierte Personen, die dazu beitragen, ihr Fachwissen mit Sorgfalt und ohne Kompromisse zu entwickeln und weiterzugeben. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels werden Sie von leidenschaftlichen Experten umgeben sein und zu vielen neuen Projekten beitragen, die es unserem Haus ermöglichen, sich regelmäßig neu zu erfinden.

Bei Van Cleef & Arpels sind wir stolz darauf, Talente aus vielen verschiedenen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen zu gewinnen. Wir glauben, dass, wenn Vielfalt und Inklusion vollständig angenommen und gestärkt werden, Kreativität und Wissen entstehen, um Exzellenz zu liefern.

Passen Sie zum Profil?

Sie sind stark von einer bedeutenden Erfahrung als Direktor einer Supply Chain Division.

Sie haben eine solide Führungserfahrung und wissen, wie Sie Ihre Teams einsteigen können.

Sie beherrschen die mit der Lieferkette verbundenen Geschäftsprobleme und verstehen schnell die Chancen Ihrer Umgebung.

Ihre Expertise ermöglicht es Ihnen, eine echte langfristige Vision Ihrer Projekte zu bringen.

Ihre Beziehungsqualitäten ermöglichen es Ihnen, als echter Partner mit einer Vielzahl von Teams und Gesprächspartnern zu handeln.

Sie haben eine starke Führung, mit der Sie Ihren Ansprechpartner überzeugen können, die beste Lösung zu präsentieren.

Sie sind Agilität, Gelassenheit und Proaktivität bei der Durchführung Ihrer Missionen.

Sie beherrschen perfekt Englisch

Wenn ja, zögern Sie nicht zu bewerben!

Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?

An den International Supply Chain Director angeschlossen, sind Sie für die Geschäftsplanung aller Produktlinien des Unternehmens verantwortlich. Sie und Ihr Team treiben alle Prognoseprozesse mit Regionen und Berechnungen von Bedarf, Reichweite und Neuheit voran.

Im Rahmen Ihrer Aufgaben:

• Sie sind verantwortlich für wichtige nachgelagerte Prozesse (Nachfrageprognose mit Regionen, Bedarfsberechnung mit Supply Chain Upstream).
• Sie koordinieren die verschiedenen Projektgesprächspartner auf den transversalen Prozessen (neu, Lebenszyklen, Budget und Bestand, kontinuierliche Verbesserung).
• Sie steuern die monatlichen Prozesse: Umsatzprognosen, Bedarfsberechnung, projizierter Bestand, prognostizierte Varianzen und Budgets...
• Sie leiten auch die jährlichen und taktischen Prozesse einschließlich S&OP.
• Sie fördern Change Management innerhalb der zentralen Versorgungsteams und in den Regionen.
• Sie halten das Niveau der Exzellenz der Weltgemeinschaft (dedizierte Ausbildung, Seminar, Aktionsplan ...)
• Sie führen ein Team von zentralen Planern.

Mehr als ein Job... Wir rekrutieren für eine Karriere!

Die Integration von Van Cleef & Arpels ist vor allem ein Team, in dem die Entwicklung der Mitarbeiter im Mittelpunkt unserer Ambitionen steht.

Sie profitieren von der vollständigen Integration mit Schulungen zu unserer Geschichte, unserem Know-how und unseren Kreationen sowie der täglichen Unterstützung.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess

Direkt online bewerben

Wenn Ihr Profil ausgewählt ist, werden Sie vom HR-Team für ein Interview kontaktiert.

Dann treffen Sie den International Supply Chain Director und dann den International Operations & Trades Director.

Bei Bedarf erhalten Sie eine E-Mail, die Sie über die Ablehnung Ihrer Bewerbung informiert.

Postulez directement en ligne

Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature.

jobs.title: Responsable Outillage
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131050
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

CONTEXTE

Rattaché au département Support de Production, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne du secteur Outillage afin de garantir l’approvisionnement sans rupture des outils de coupe et consommables, les gains sur achats planifiés et le déploiement de la roadmap de transformation du département. Vos succès contribueront à l’amélioration de la performance de nos ateliers.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT

Responsabilités

En tant que manager d’équipe :

• Vous organisez de façon optimale le département, définissez et développez le potentiel et l'expertise technique de l’équipe ainsi que sa polyvalence et son autonomie
• Vous assurez une communication fluide et régulière (ascendante, descendante, transversale) auprès des collaborateurs et promouvez les valeurs de la Maison
• Vous contribuez à développer un climat de travail sain et stimulant
• Vous collaborez étroitement avec les différentes interfaces

En tant que « pilote » de votre activité :

• Vous rationnalisez les frais de production
• Vous mettez en place une stratégie d’achats respectueuse de notre écosystème, consolidant les partenariats en place
• Vous négociez avec les fournisseurs le juste prix des articles à approvisionner
• Vous optimisez les stocks

En tant que garant des démarches d’amélioration continue :

• Vous déployez la roadmap de transformation du département
• Vous digitalisez les flux
• Vous automatisez les process
• Vous rationalisez le portefeuille articles Cartier Horlogerie

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

En tant que Responsable Outillage, vous vous distinguez par votre leadership, votre esprit de service et d’analyse ainsi que par votre compréhension des enjeux industriels. Force de proposition, vous apportez des solutions innovantes permettant l’amélioration des processus.

Vous savez faire preuve de qualité managériales et humaines qui vous permettront de fédérer votre équipe vers un objectif commun.

Au bénéfice d’une formation à dominante mécanique ou microtechnique de technicien supérieur, d’ingénieur ou formation jugée équivalente, vous êtes fort d’une première expérience professionnelle de 2 ans durant laquelle vous avez fait preuve de dynamisme et d’autonomie. Vous maîtrisez les outils

informatiques, disposez idéalement de connaissances SAP et êtes attirés par les nouveaux outils numériques.

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Notre équipe RH se tient à votre écoute, selon votre souhait et vos besoins, tout au long de votre expérience au sein de notre Maison.

Au fur et à mesure de votre avancée dans notre processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez notre Responsable Support de Production ainsi que notre HR Business Partner.

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Vous savez faire preuve de qualité managériales et humaines qui vous permettront de fédérer votre équipe vers un objectif commun.

Au bénéfice d’une formation à dominante mécanique ou microtechnique de technicien supérieur, d’ingénieur ou formation jugée équivalente, vous êtes fort d’une première expérience professionnelle de 2 ans durant laquelle vous avez fait preuve de dynamisme et d’autonomie. Vous maîtrisez les outils

informatiques, disposez idéalement de connaissances SAP et êtes attirés par les nouveaux outils numériques.

jobs.title: Head of Group Insurance
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130915

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

About us

Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, with a prestigious portfolio of Maisons spanning jewellery, watchmaking, and fashion. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and protecting our heritage, while anticipating future challenges.

How will you make an impact?

We are looking for an experienced and agile Head of Insurance to shape how Richemont manages risk in an increasingly dynamic global environment. As Head of Insurance, you will provide strategic leadership across our Group non-life insurance portfolio, acting as a true business partner to senior leaders to protect our people, assets, and balance sheets, while enabling sustainable growth.

This is a distinctive hands-on leadership role where you will define the strategic direction of the function and advise senior leadership, while remaining closely involved in execution. You will be perfectly comfortable presenting to the CFO in the morning and spending the afternoon reviewing wording on a complex policy, coaching a team member through a claim, or preparing a Board paper. You will lead from within the team, actively contributing and supporting, while also empowering your team members to grow with trust and confidence. Your agility will allow you to comfortably navigate and engage with diverse activities and people, from brokers to individual contributors across the Group.

Reporting to the Group Treasurer, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a key role within the Treasury & Risk Leadership Team.

Your Key Responsibilities will be:

• Strategic Leadership: Shape and execute the Group’s non-life insurance and risk strategy, ensuring it evolves alongside our business priorities and risk profile. You will act as an internal entrepreneur, understanding insurance not just as a cost, but as a critical component of risk financing.
• Influential Business Partnership: Partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, acting as an ambassador for the insurance function. You will provide commercially pragmatic insurance advice that supports strategic initiatives, operational resilience, and informed decision-making, focusing on influence rather than mere negotiation. Building strong relationships with our Maisons will be paramount.
• Program Management & Innovation: Lead the design, placement, and governance of Group’s non-life insurance programs, including captive strategy, insurer and broker relationships, and effective claims oversight. You will foster innovation, curiosity, and embrace new approaches, including automation and AI, to continuously improve our processes.
• Function Optimization: Continuously enhance the effectiveness of the insurance function by leveraging data, technology, and process improvements to optimize the Group's total cost of risk.
• Strategic Advice Acumen: Provide strategic insight to the Group Treasurer and Treasury Leadership Team on emerging risks, market developments, and opportunities to strengthen the Group's financial resilience.
• Empowering Team Leadership: Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement while leading, developing, and inspiring a high-performing global insurance team. You will ensure the team has the space to grow, supported by your trust and confidence.

What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a leader whose approach goes beyond technical excellence. You are someone who:

• Builds trust and lasting relationships across a diverse, global organization, understanding that this role is fundamentally based on strong connections. You are a great business partner and ambassador for the function.
• Leads with integrity, authenticity, and a strong sense of accountability, setting an example for the team.
• Balances delegation with active, hands-on involvement, and demonstrate a genuine willingness to support the team in delivering results, while also empowering them to grow.
• Communicates with clarity and confidence, adapting complex insurance topics for a broad range of stakeholders, from senior executives to individual contributors, and knowing where to influence.
• Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments.
• Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies.
• Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively.

Your Key Skills & Competencies:

• Mature, assertive, and self-motivated, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude.
• A visionary leader, able to inspire and influence a highly specialized team towards excellence and value-added impact on the organization.
• Strategic thinking and business acumen with a strong foundation in finance, insurance, and risk management.
• Results-oriented, acts decisively, and an active team player.
• Strong customer focus (internal and external) with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to present complex insurance information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, and confident in dealing with different management levels.
• Skilled at leading cross-functional projects from design to implementation.
• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and data analysis skills.
• Digitally savvy and a strong interest in new technology use, automation.
• Unquestioned personal integrity with strong ethics and values consistent with company culture.
• Ability to stand firm on difficult issues when required.

Your qualifications:

• Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Law.
• Minimum of 15 years of corporate insurance experience, preferably gained through a variety of in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility, combined with another experience like broker/consultancy.
• Expert knowledge of global insurance markets, international insurance programs, and captive experience. A captive board position is a plus.
• Deep experience in advising the internal organization on insurance matters
• Ability to think like a businessperson, to integrate insurance and business issues, and to partner with business leaders.
• Fluent English is a must.

What We Offer:

At Richemont, we value our employees and offer a stimulating and enriching work environment. You will have the opportunity to work within a prestigious international group, develop your skills, and contribute to the protection and growth of our iconic Maisons.

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value and foster integrity, empathy, collaboration, excellence and courage.
• We care for the world we live in.

Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly.

If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview.

The next steps will be an interview with our Insurance specialists, our Group Treasurer, a behavioural assessment, and an interview with our HR Business Partner.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130915

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

Informazioni su di noi

Richemont è leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, con un prestigioso portafoglio di Maisons che spaziano dai gioielli, dall'orologeria e dalla moda. Ci impegniamo per l'eccellenza, l'innovazione e la tutela del nostro patrimonio, anticipando le sfide future.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto e agile capo di assicurazione per modellare come Richemont gestisce il rischio in un ambiente globale sempre più dinamico. In qualità di capo dell'assicurazione, fornirete leadership strategica attraverso il nostro portafoglio di assicurazioni non vita del Gruppo, agendo come un vero partner commerciale per i leader senior per proteggere le nostre persone, beni e bilanci, consentendo allo stesso tempo una crescita sostenibile.

Questo è un ruolo di leadership mani-on distintivo in cui definirete la direzione strategica della funzione e consigliare la leadership senior, rimanendo strettamente coinvolti nell'esecuzione. Sarete perfettamente a vostro agio presentando al CFO al mattino e trascorrendo il pomeriggio a rivedere le parole su una politica complessa, allenando un membro del team attraverso un reclamo, o preparando una carta del consiglio. Potrai guidare dall'interno del team, contribuire attivamente e sostenere, e anche rafforzare i membri del team di crescere con fiducia e fiducia. La vostra agilità vi permetterà di navigare comodamente e di impegnarsi con diverse attività e persone, dai broker ai singoli collaboratori in tutto il Gruppo.

Segnalando al Tesoriere del Gruppo, sarai un consulente di fiducia per la leadership senior e svolgerai un ruolo chiave all'interno del Team di Leadership del Tesoro e del rischio.

Le tue responsabilità chiave saranno:

• Leadership strategica: Formare ed eseguire la strategia di assicurazione e di rischio non vita del Gruppo, assicurandosi che si evolva accanto alle nostre priorità aziendali e al profilo di rischio. Agirai come imprenditore interno, comprendendo l'assicurazione non solo come un costo, ma come componente critica del finanziamento del rischio.
• Partenariato aziendale influente: collaborare a stretto contatto con i leader senior in tutta l'organizzazione, agendo come ambasciatore per la funzione assicurativa. Fornirai consigli di assicurazione commercialmente pragmatici che supporta iniziative strategiche, resilienza operativa e processi decisionali informati, concentrandosi sull'influenza piuttosto che sulla mera negoziazione. Costruire forti relazioni con le nostre Maison sarà fondamentale.
• Gestione del programma & innovazione: guidare la progettazione, il posizionamento e la governance dei programmi di assicurazione non vita del Gruppo, tra cui la strategia di prigionia, i rapporti di assicurazione e di broker, e rivendicazioni efficaci di supervisione. Incoraggiate l'innovazione, la curiosità e abbracciate nuovi approcci, tra cui l'automazione e l'IA, per migliorare continuamente i nostri processi.
• Ottimizzazione della funzione: Migliorare costantemente l'efficacia della funzione assicurativa sfruttando i dati, la tecnologia e i miglioramenti del processo per ottimizzare il costo totale del rischio del Gruppo.
• Acumen: fornire informazioni strategiche al Gruppo Tesoriere e Leadership Team sui rischi emergenti, gli sviluppi del mercato e le opportunità per rafforzare la resilienza finanziaria del Gruppo.
• Promuovere una cultura di partenariato, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo, guidando, sviluppando e ispirando un team di assicurazioni globale di alto livello. Ti assicurerai che il team abbia lo spazio per crescere, supportato dalla tua fiducia e fiducia.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

Stiamo cercando un leader il cui approccio va oltre l'eccellenza tecnica. Sei qualcuno che...

• Costruisce la fiducia e le relazioni durature in un'organizzazione globale diversificata, comprendendo che questo ruolo è fondamentalmente basato su forti connessioni. Sei un grande partner commerciale e ambasciatore per la funzione.
• Conduce con integrità, autenticità e un forte senso di responsabilità, impostando un esempio per la squadra.
• Equilibrare la delegazione con un coinvolgimento attivo e pratico, e dimostrare una genuina disponibilità a sostenere il team nella fornitura di risultati, pur consentendo loro di crescere.
• Comunica con chiarezza e fiducia, adattando temi di assicurazione complessi per una vasta gamma di stakeholder, dai dirigenti senior ai singoli collaboratori, e sapendo dove influenzare.
• Bilancia il pensiero strategico con un approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, dimostrando l'agilità nell'adattare a nuove sfide e ambienti.
• È naturalmente curioso, innovativo e collaborativo, impegnato a sviluppare sia le persone che la funzione, e non ha paura di esplorare nuove tecnologie.
• Possede un buon radar, la comprensione delle dinamiche organizzative e come navigarli efficacemente.

Le tue competenze chiave e competenze:

• Matura, assertiva e automotivata, dimostrando un atteggiamento positivo e proattivo.
• Un leader visionario, capace di ispirare e influenzare un team altamente specializzato verso l'eccellenza e l'impatto sul valore aggiunto dell'organizzazione.
• pensiero strategico e business acum con una forte fondazione in finanza, assicurazione e gestione dei rischi.
• Risultati orientati, agisce in modo decisivo, e un giocatore di squadra attivo.
• Forte attenzione del cliente (internal ed esterno) con eccellenti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, in grado di presentare informazioni di assicurazione complesse chiaramente agli stakeholder non finanziari, e fiducioso nel trattare con diversi livelli di gestione.
• Abilitato ai principali progetti interfunzionali dalla progettazione all'implementazione.
• Avanzate capacità di analisi analitica, problem solving e dati.
• Digitalmente esperto e un forte interesse per il nuovo uso tecnologico, l'automazione.
• Indiscussa integrità personale con forte etica e valori coerenti con la cultura aziendale.
• Capacità di stare fermo su problemi difficili quando necessario.

Le tue qualifiche:

• Laurea in Business Administration, finanza o legge.
• Minimo di 15 anni di esperienza assicurativa aziendale, preferibilmente guadagnato attraverso una varietà di ruoli interni di crescente visibilità e responsabilità, combinati con un'altra esperienza come broker / console.
• Conoscenza esperta dei mercati assicurativi globali, programmi assicurativi internazionali e esperienza in cattività. Una posizione di bordo prigioniera è un vantaggio.
• Esperienza profonda nella consulenza dell'organizzazione interna in materia di assicurazione
• Capacità di pensare come un uomo d'affari, di integrare le questioni di assicurazione e di affari, e di collaborare con i leader aziendali.
• L'inglese fluente è un must.

Cosa offriamo:

A Richemont, apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti e offriamo un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e arricchinte. Avrete l'opportunità di lavorare all'interno di un prestigioso gruppo internazionale, sviluppare le vostre competenze e contribuire alla protezione e alla crescita delle nostre iconiche Maison.

Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato.

• Valoriamo e adottiamo l'integrità, l'empatia, la collaborazione, l'eccellenza e il coraggio.
• Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo.

La vostra domanda sarà attentamente esaminata dai nostri team di reclutamento, che vi darà un follow-up a breve.

Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, ti contatteremo per un'intervista telefonica iniziale.

I prossimi passi saranno un'intervista con i nostri specialisti delle assicurazioni, il nostro Tesoriere di Gruppo, una valutazione comportamentale, e un'intervista con il nostro HR Business Partner.

We are looking for an experienced and agile Head of Insurance to shape how Richemont manages risk in an increasingly dynamic global environment. As Head of Insurance, you will provide strategic leadership across our Group non-life insurance portfolio, acting as a true business partner to senior leaders to protect our people, assets, and balance sheets, while enabling sustainable growth.

This is a distinctive hands-on leadership role where you will define the strategic direction of the function and advise senior leadership, while remaining closely involved in execution. You will be perfectly comfortable presenting to the CFO in the morning and spending the afternoon reviewing wording on a complex policy, coaching a team member through a claim, or preparing a Board paper. You will lead from within the team, actively contributing and supporting, while also empowering your team members to grow with trust and confidence. Your agility will allow you to comfortably navigate and engage with diverse activities and people, from brokers to individual contributors across the Group.

Reporting to the Group Treasurer, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a key role within the Treasury & Risk Leadership Team.

Your Key Responsibilities will be:

• Strategic Leadership: Shape and execute the Group’s non-life insurance and risk strategy, ensuring it evolves alongside our business priorities and risk profile. You will act as an internal entrepreneur, understanding insurance not just as a cost, but as a critical component of risk financing.
• Influential Business Partnership: Partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, acting as an ambassador for the insurance function. You will provide commercially pragmatic insurance advice that supports strategic initiatives, operational resilience, and informed decision-making, focusing on influence rather than mere negotiation. Building strong relationships with our Maisons will be paramount.
• Program Management & Innovation: Lead the design, placement, and governance of Group’s non-life insurance programs, including captive strategy, insurer and broker relationships, and effective claims oversight. You will foster innovation, curiosity, and embrace new approaches, including automation and AI, to continuously improve our processes.
• Function Optimization: Continuously enhance the effectiveness of the insurance function by leveraging data, technology, and process improvements to optimize the Group's total cost of risk.
• Strategic Advice Acumen: Provide strategic insight to the Group Treasurer and Treasury Leadership Team on emerging risks, market developments, and opportunities to strengthen the Group's financial resilience.
• Empowering Team Leadership: Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement while leading, developing, and inspiring a high-performing global insurance team. You will ensure the team has the space to grow, supported by your trust and confidence.

What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a leader whose approach goes beyond technical excellence. You are someone who:

• Builds trust and lasting relationships across a diverse, global organization, understanding that this role is fundamentally based on strong connections. You are a great business partner and ambassador for the function.
• Leads with integrity, authenticity, and a strong sense of accountability, setting an example for the team.
• Balances delegation with active, hands-on involvement, and demonstrate a genuine willingness to support the team in delivering results, while also empowering them to grow.
• Communicates with clarity and confidence, adapting complex insurance topics for a broad range of stakeholders, from senior executives to individual contributors, and knowing where to influence.
• Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments.
• Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies.
• Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively.

Your Key Skills & Competencies:

• Mature, assertive, and self-motivated, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude.
• A visionary leader, able to inspire and influence a highly specialized team towards excellence and value-added impact on the organization.
• Strategic thinking and business acumen with a strong foundation in finance, insurance, and risk management.
• Results-oriented, acts decisively, and an active team player.
• Strong customer focus (internal and external) with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to present complex insurance information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, and confident in dealing with different management levels.
• Skilled at leading cross-functional projects from design to implementation.
• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and data analysis skills.
• Digitally savvy and a strong interest in new technology use, automation.
• Unquestioned personal integrity with strong ethics and values consistent with company culture.
• Ability to stand firm on difficult issues when required.

Your qualifications:

• Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Law.
• Minimum of 15 years of corporate insurance experience, preferably gained through a variety of in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility, combined with another experience like broker/consultancy.
• Expert knowledge of global insurance markets, international insurance programs, and captive experience. A captive board position is a plus.
• Deep experience in advising the internal organization on insurance matters
• Ability to think like a businessperson, to integrate insurance and business issues, and to partner with business leaders.
• Fluent English is a must.

What We Offer:

At Richemont, we value our employees and offer a stimulating and enriching work environment. You will have the opportunity to work within a prestigious international group, develop your skills, and contribute to the protection and growth of our iconic Maisons.

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value and foster integrity, empathy, collaboration, excellence and courage.
• We care for the world we live in.

Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly.

If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview.

The next steps will be an interview with our Insurance specialists, our Group Treasurer, a behavioural assessment, and an interview with our HR Business Partner.

Bezugscode: JR130915

Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität.

Über uns

Richemont ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Luxussektor mit einem prestigeträchtigen Portfolio von Maisons, das Schmuck, Uhrmacherei und Mode umfasst. Wir engagieren uns für Exzellenz, Innovation und den Schutz unseres Erbes, während wir zukünftige Herausforderungen antizipieren.

Wie werden Sie eine Wirkung erzielen?

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und agilen Head of Insurance, um Richemont in einem zunehmend dynamischen globalen Umfeld risikobewältigt zu gestalten. Als Head of Insurance übernehmen Sie eine strategische Führungsrolle in unserem Nichtlebensversicherungsportfolio und agieren als echter Geschäftspartner für Führungskräfte, um unsere Mitarbeiter, Vermögenswerte und Bilanzen zu schützen und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum zu ermöglichen.

Dies ist eine unverwechselbare praktische Führungsrolle, in der Sie die strategische Richtung der Funktion definieren und die Führungsebene beraten, während Sie eng in die Ausführung einbezogen bleiben. Sie werden sich wohl fühlen, wenn Sie dem CFO am Morgen präsentieren und den Nachmittag damit verbringen, den Wortlaut einer komplexen Richtlinie zu überprüfen, ein Teammitglied durch einen Anspruch zu coachen oder ein Board Paper vorzubereiten. Sie werden aus dem Team heraus führen, aktiv beitragen und unterstützen und gleichzeitig Ihre Teammitglieder befähigen, mit Vertrauen und Zuversicht zu wachsen. Ihre Agilität ermöglicht es Ihnen, bequem zu navigieren und sich mit verschiedenen Aktivitäten und Menschen zu beschäftigen, von Brokern bis hin zu einzelnen Mitwirkenden in der gesamten Gruppe.

Wenn Sie dem Group Treasurer berichten, sind Sie ein vertrauenswürdiger Berater für die Geschäftsleitung und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle im Treasury & Risk Leadership Team.

Ihre Hauptverantwortung wird sein:

• Strategische Führung: Form und Umsetzung der Nichtlebensversicherungs- und Risikostrategie der Gruppe, um sicherzustellen, dass sie sich neben unseren Geschäftsprioritäten und unserem Risikoprofil entwickelt. Sie handeln als interner Unternehmer und verstehen Versicherungen nicht nur als Kosten, sondern als kritische Komponente der Risikofinanzierung.
• Einflussreiche Geschäftspartnerschaft: Enge Partnerschaft mit leitenden Führungskräften in der gesamten Organisation als Botschafter für die Versicherungsfunktion. Sie bieten eine wirtschaftlich pragmatische Versicherungsberatung an, die strategische Initiativen, operative Widerstandsfähigkeit und fundierte Entscheidungen unterstützt und sich auf Einfluss und nicht nur auf Verhandlungen konzentriert. Der Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu unseren Maisons wird von größter Bedeutung sein.
• Programmmanagement & Innovation: Führen Sie die Gestaltung, Platzierung und Governance der Nichtlebensversicherungsprogramme der Gruppe, einschließlich Captive-Strategie, Versicherungs- und Maklerbeziehungen und effektiver Schadensaufsicht. Sie fördern Innovation, Neugier und neue Ansätze, einschließlich Automatisierung und KI, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
• Funktionsoptimierung: Steigern Sie die Effektivität der Versicherungsfunktion kontinuierlich, indem Sie Daten-, Technologie- und Prozessverbesserungen nutzen, um die Gesamtrisikokosten des Konzerns zu optimieren.
• Strategische Beratung: Geben Sie dem Group Treasurer und Treasury Leadership Team strategische Einblicke in neue Risiken, Marktentwicklungen und Möglichkeiten zur Stärkung der finanziellen Widerstandsfähigkeit der Gruppe.
• Stärkung der Teamführung: Pflegen Sie eine Kultur der Partnerschaft, Verantwortlichkeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, während Sie ein leistungsstarkes globales Versicherungsteam leiten, entwickeln und inspirieren. Sie werden sicherstellen, dass das Team den Raum zum Wachsen hat, unterstützt von Ihrem Vertrauen und Vertrauen.

Was wir suchen:

Wir suchen eine Führungskraft, deren Ansatz über technische Exzellenz hinausgeht. Sie sind jemand, der:

• Baut Vertrauen und dauerhafte Beziehungen in einer vielfältigen, globalen Organisation auf und versteht, dass diese Rolle grundsätzlich auf starken Verbindungen basiert. Sie sind ein großartiger Geschäftspartner und Botschafter für die Funktion.
• Führt zu Integrität, Authentizität und einem starken Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht und gibt dem Team ein Beispiel.
• Balanciert Delegation mit aktiver, praktischer Beteiligung und zeigt eine echte Bereitschaft, das Team bei der Bereitstellung von Ergebnissen zu unterstützen und es gleichzeitig zu befähigen, zu wachsen.
• Kommuniziert mit Klarheit und Vertrauen, passt komplexe Versicherungsthemen für ein breites Spektrum von Stakeholdern an, von leitenden Angestellten bis hin zu einzelnen Mitwirkenden, und weiß, wo sie Einfluss nehmen können.
• Balanciert strategisches Denken mit einem pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Ansatz und zeigt Agilität bei der Anpassung an neue Herausforderungen und Umgebungen.
• Ist natürlich neugierig, innovativ und kollaborativ, engagiert sich für die Entwicklung von Menschen und der Funktion und hat keine Angst, neue Technologien zu erforschen.
• Besitzt ein gutes Radar, Verständnis der Organisationsdynamik und wie man sie effektiv zu navigieren.

Ihre wichtigsten Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen:

• Reife, durchsetzungsfähig und selbstmotiviert, zeigt eine positive und proaktive Einstellung.
• Eine visionäre Führungskraft, die ein hochspezialisiertes Team für Exzellenz und wertschöpfende Auswirkungen auf die Organisation begeistern und beeinflussen kann.
• Strategisches Denken und Geschäftssinn mit einer starken Grundlage in Finanzen, Versicherungen und Risikomanagement.
• Ergebnisorientiert, handelt entschlossen und ein aktiver Teamplayer.
• Starke Kundenorientierung (intern und extern) mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten, in der Lage, komplexe Versicherungsinformationen für nichtfinanzielle Stakeholder klar zu präsentieren und zuversichtlich im Umgang mit verschiedenen Managementebenen.
• Kompetenz bei der Leitung von funktionsübergreifenden Projekten vom Design bis zur Umsetzung.
• Fortgeschrittene analytische, Problemlösungs- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten.
• Digital versiert und ein starkes Interesse an neuen Technologien, Automatisierung.
• Unbestrittene persönliche Integrität mit starker Ethik und Werten, die mit der Unternehmenskultur übereinstimmen.
• Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf in schwierigen Fragen standhaft zu bleiben.

Ihre Qualifikationen:

• Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen oder Recht.
• Mindestens 15 Jahre Erfahrung in der Unternehmensversicherung, vorzugsweise durch eine Vielzahl von internen Rollen mit zunehmender Sichtbarkeit und Verantwortung, kombiniert mit einer anderen Erfahrung wie Broker / Beratung.
• Expertenwissen über globale Versicherungsmärkte, internationale Versicherungsprogramme und Captive-Erfahrung. Eine unverlierbare Boardposition ist ein Plus.
• Tiefe Erfahrung in der Beratung der internen Organisation in Versicherungsfragen
• Fähigkeit, wie ein Unternehmer zu denken, Versicherungs- und Geschäftsfragen zu integrieren und mit Führungskräften zusammenzuarbeiten.
• fließendes Englisch ist ein Muss.

Was wir anbieten:

Bei Richemont schätzen wir unsere Mitarbeiter und bieten ein anregendes und bereicherndes Arbeitsumfeld. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, in einer renommierten internationalen Gruppe zu arbeiten, Ihre Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und zum Schutz und Wachstum unserer ikonischen Maisons beizutragen.

Unsere wahre Macht liegt nicht in unseren Ähnlichkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutztes Potenzial zu fördern.

• Wir schätzen und fördern Integrität, Empathie, Zusammenarbeit, Exzellenz und Mut.
• Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben.

Ihre Bewerbung wird von unseren Rekrutierungsteams sorgfältig geprüft, die Ihnen in Kürze ein Follow-up geben werden.

Wenn ihr profil ausgewählt ist, werden wir sie für ein erstes telefoninterview kontaktieren.

Die nächsten Schritte werden ein Interview mit unseren Versicherungsspezialisten, unserem Group Treasurer, eine Verhaltensbeurteilung und ein Interview mit unserem HR Business Partner sein.

Code de référence: JR130915

Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue.

Sur nous

Richemont est un leader mondial dans le secteur du luxe, avec un portefeuille prestigieux de Maisons couvrant les bijoux, l'horlogerie et la mode. Nous sommes attachés à l'excellence, à l'innovation et à la protection de notre patrimoine, tout en anticipant les défis futurs.

Comment allez-vous avoir un impact?

Nous cherchons un chef d'assurance expérimenté et agile pour déterminer comment Richemont gère le risque dans un environnement mondial de plus en plus dynamique. En tant que chef de l'assurance, vous assurerez un leadership stratégique dans notre portefeuille d'assurances non-vie du Groupe, en agissant comme véritable partenaire d'affaires auprès des dirigeants supérieurs pour protéger nos employés, nos actifs et nos bilans, tout en favorisant une croissance durable.

Il s'agit d'un rôle particulier de leadership pratique où vous définirez l'orientation stratégique de la fonction et conseillerez les cadres supérieurs, tout en restant étroitement impliqué dans l'exécution. Vous serez parfaitement à l'aise de présenter au DPF le matin et de passer l'après-midi à examiner le libellé d'une politique complexe, à entraîner un membre de l'équipe dans une réclamation ou à préparer un document du Conseil. Vous dirigerez l'équipe, y contribuant activement et y apportant votre soutien, tout en donnant à vos membres les moyens de grandir avec confiance. Votre agilité vous permettra de naviguer confortablement et de vous engager avec diverses activités et personnes, des courtiers aux contributeurs individuels à travers le Groupe.

Rendre compte au trésorier du groupe, vous serez un conseiller de confiance auprès de la haute direction et jouerez un rôle clé au sein de l'équipe de direction du Trésor et du risque.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Leadership stratégique : façonner et exécuter la stratégie d'assurance et de risque non-vie du Groupe, en s'assurant qu'elle évolue parallèlement à nos priorités et à notre profil de risque. Vous agirez comme un entrepreneur interne, comprenant l'assurance non seulement comme un coût, mais comme une composante essentielle du financement du risque.
• Partenariat d'affaires influent : S'associer étroitement avec les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation, en tant qu'ambassadeur pour la fonction d'assurance. Vous fournirez des conseils d'assurance commercialement pragmatiques qui appuient les initiatives stratégiques, la résilience opérationnelle et la prise de décisions éclairées, en mettant l'accent sur l'influence plutôt que sur la simple négociation. Il sera primordial d'établir des relations solides avec nos Maisons.
• Gestion et innovation des programmes : Diriger la conception, le placement et la gouvernance des programmes d'assurance non-vie du Groupe, y compris la stratégie captive, les relations entre assureurs et courtiers et la surveillance efficace des réclamations. Vous encouragerez l'innovation, la curiosité et adopterez de nouvelles approches, y compris l'automatisation et l'IA, pour améliorer continuellement nos processus.
• Optimisation de la fonction : Améliorer continuellement l'efficacité de la fonction d'assurance en tirant parti des données, de la technologie et des améliorations des processus pour optimiser le coût total du risque du Groupe.
• Conseils stratégiques Œcumé : Donner un aperçu stratégique à l'équipe de direction du Trésor et du Trésor du Groupe sur les risques émergents, l'évolution du marché et les possibilités de renforcer la résilience financière du Groupe.
• Empowering Team Leadership: Favoriser une culture de partenariat, de responsabilité et d'amélioration continue tout en dirigeant, développant et inspirant une équipe d'assurance mondiale à haut rendement. Vous veillerez à ce que l'équipe ait l'espace nécessaire pour grandir, avec votre confiance.

Ce que nous cherchons :

Nous cherchons un leader dont l'approche va au-delà de l'excellence technique. Vous êtes quelqu'un qui :

• Instaurer la confiance et des relations durables au sein d'une organisation mondiale diversifiée, en comprenant que ce rôle repose fondamentalement sur des liens solides. Vous êtes un excellent partenaire d'affaires et ambassadeur pour la fonction.
• Dirige avec intégrité, authenticité et un fort sens de la responsabilité, en donnant l'exemple à l'équipe.
• Équilibre la délégation avec une participation active et concrète, et démontre une réelle volonté d'aider l'équipe à obtenir des résultats, tout en lui donnant les moyens de croître.
• Communique avec clarté et confiance, en adaptant des sujets d'assurance complexes à un large éventail d'intervenants, des cadres supérieurs aux cotisants individuels et en sachant où influencer.
• Équilibre la pensée stratégique avec une approche pragmatique, orientée vers la solution, démontrant l'agilité à s'adapter aux nouveaux défis et environnements.
• Est naturellement curieux, innovant et collaboratif, engagé à développer à la fois les gens et la fonction, et ne pas craindre d'explorer de nouvelles technologies.
• Possède un bon radar, comprendre la dynamique organisationnelle et comment les naviguer efficacement.

Vos compétences clés :

• Mûr, affirmé et automotivé, démontrant une attitude positive et proactive.
• Leader visionnaire, capable d'inspirer et d'influencer une équipe hautement spécialisée vers l'excellence et l'impact à valeur ajoutée sur l'organisation.
• La pensée stratégique et l'esprit d'entreprise reposent sur une solide base en matière de finance, d'assurance et de gestion des risques.
• Des résultats orientés, agit de manière décisive, et un joueur d'équipe actif.
• Forte orientation client (interne et externe) avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, capable de présenter des informations d'assurance complexes clairement aux intervenants non financiers, et confiant dans le traitement des différents niveaux de gestion.
• Compétence pour diriger des projets interfonctionnels de la conception à la mise en oeuvre.
• Compétences avancées en analyse, résolution de problèmes et analyse de données.
• Savvy numérique et un fort intérêt pour l'utilisation des nouvelles technologies, l'automatisation.
• Intégrité personnelle non contestée avec une éthique et des valeurs fortes conformes à la culture de l'entreprise.
• Capacité de tenir ferme sur des questions difficiles au besoin.

Vos qualifications:

• Diplôme en administration des affaires, finances ou droit.
• Minimum de 15 ans d'expérience en assurance d'entreprise, de préférence acquise grâce à divers rôles internes d'accroissement de la visibilité et de la responsabilité, associés à une autre expérience comme courtier/consultance.
• Connaissance des marchés mondiaux de l'assurance, des programmes d'assurance internationaux et de l'expérience captive. Une position captive est un plus.
• Expérience approfondie en conseillant l'organisation interne sur les questions d'assurance
• Capacité de penser comme une personne d'affaires, d'intégrer les questions d'assurance et d'affaires, et de s'associer avec des chefs d'entreprise.
• L'anglais est un must.

Ce que nous offrons:

Chez Richemont, nous apprécions nos employés et offrons un environnement de travail stimulant et enrichissant. Vous aurez la possibilité de travailler au sein d'un groupe international prestigieux, de développer vos compétences et de contribuer à la protection et à la croissance de nos Maisons emblématiques.

Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique de favoriser un potentiel inexploité.

• Nous apprécions et favorisons l'intégrité, l'empathie, la collaboration, l'excellence et le courage.
• Nous nous soucions du monde dans lequel nous vivons.

Votre candidature sera soigneusement examinée par nos équipes de recrutement, qui vous donneront un suivi sous peu.

Si votre profil est sélectionné, nous vous contacterons pour une entrevue téléphonique initiale.

Les prochaines étapes seront une entrevue avec nos spécialistes de l'assurance, notre trésorier de groupe, une évaluation comportementale et une entrevue avec notre partenaire d'affaires RH.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131328

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

This is a unique opportunity to grow in an exciting and challenging environment, co-building and providing procurement expertise to technology-passionate stakeholders.

Richemont is looking for a Technology Procurement Intern to support our Technology Procurement team.

Reporting directly to the Head of Technology Procurement and the Technology Category Manager, you will support Group Technology teams in optimizing and executing sourcing strategies for cutting-edge IT categories—including SaaS, cloud services, software, professional services, and hardware—delivering optimal value in terms of quality, service, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

• Location: Meyrin (Geneva area)
• Contract Type: 5-month fixed-term contract (Internship)
• Start Date: ideally January 2027

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In close partnership with our Group Technology department, Maisons, and regions, you will ensure the successful implementation of our procurement policies and global sourcing strategies.

Contribute to Global Category Management:

• Market Intelligence: Support category intelligence management, including category analysis, spend and risk analysis and best practices identification, to facilitate the implementation of category strategies across the organisation
• Supplier Relations: Support the management of the preferred suppliers list
• Value Creation: Propose value creation initiatives, such as rationalization opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
• Performance: Contribute to enhancing category performance reporting.

Support stakeholders in their sourcing and supplier management activities:

• Advisory: Collaborate closely with stakeholders and advise them on optimal sourcing strategies
• Process Execution: Actively contribute to defining technical/business requirements and performing procurement actions in accordance with Group policies.
• Full Sourcing Support: Provide comprehensive procurement support for technology-related needs:
• Negotiate the best conditions TCO-wise (pricing, terms and conditions, SLA, etc.)
• Provide procurement support throughout technology projects, including managing RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs, as well as contract renewals.
• Ensure compliance with the negotiated terms.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• You are a proactive team player who communicates clearly and brings positive energy to collaborative goals.
• You are naturally curious, highly structured, and possess strong analytical skills.
• You are fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).
• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (for data and spend analysis) and PowerPoint (for clear presentations).
• You are in your 4th or, ideally, 5th year of a Master’s degree majoring in Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related business field.
• You have an active internship agreement (convention de stage) with your school or university.
• You are available for a 5-month internship ideally starting in September 2026.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?
This is a premium opportunity to discover and contribute to both projects and category management within a leading global luxury group. You will join a diverse, dynamic, and highly supportive team working in an international environment where innovation and heritage meet.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

• First Contact: If your application is selected, our recruitment team will reach out to you within one week for a brief, informal introductory call.
• First Interview: A formal interview with our Recruiter to discuss your background and motivations.
• Final Round: A personal meeting (virtual or in-person) with the Technology Procurement Team to dive deeper into the role and meet your future colleagues.

Technical expertise and training

Organization and Performance Optimization

Quality assurance

• Solve technical problems and quality non-conformities directly in the field
• Actively participate in continuous improvement (5R/5S) and conduct quality process audits
• Contribute to the improvement of flows related to other departments

Management support

• Relay key technical information on equipment and promote a positive and motivating working environment within the team
• Contribute to the assessment of the technical versatility of the teams and mentor candidates on the test on these equipment
• To be the driving force for proposals on technical, organisational and performance improvement aspects

Your profile:

• You have a relevant technical training in mechanics, micromechanics, machining or production, or have significant experience in a similar production environment, with mechanized polishing machines.
• You have a thorough knowledge and proven practical experience of Recomatic CT500/CT501 polishing machines or comparable equipment.
• You master the principles and techniques of precision machining and finishing.
• You have an excellent sense of organization and know how to manage priorities efficiently in a demanding production environment.
• Your communication skills are proven, allowing you to interact with ease at all levels, including training and technical support.
• You have a very good stress management and know how to maintain a positive and motivating attitude.
• You have a good spirit of initiative and a strong proposal for continuous process improvement.
• You have mastered basic computer knowledge, including potentially machine programming or production tracking software.
