jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133496
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

WE WELCOME

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate (12-month contract) who wants to join one of the legendary boutique, Cartier Zürich, and contribute to the success and growth of one of our main boutiques.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your Client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently English & German and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133496 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutte le Professioni dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. Sarete Ambasciatore di Cartier e diventerete la vostra seconda natura nella Boutique e negli eventi esterni del cliente. Avrete la missione di fornire un servizio eccezionale agli ospiti di alto valore, facendoli sentire a casa nella nostra Boutique. Sarete accolti da un team amichevole e aperto e diversificato che si concentra sulla fornitura di un servizio ultra-personale. Ora, se tu sei il tipo che stiamo cercando! jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133422

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced HR Business Partner to join our Cartier Switzerland team.

This pivotal role will position you as a partner for our boutiques and Retail leadership, actively contributing to the definition and execution of our HR strategy in service of Cartier’s commercial success.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trusted HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, translating business priorities into concrete and effective HR initiatives. Provide expert guidance on all HR matters, including Swiss labor law, talent acquisition, HR policies, performance management, and skills development.
• Talent Lifecycle Management: Drive the entire talent lifecycle for our boutique employees, including recruitment, performance management, talent reviews and development, salary review processes, and succession planning, to strengthen our Retail teams' capabilities and enhance retention.
• Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilize HR Information Systems (such as Workday and SAP) to optimize processes and adopt an analytical approach to interpret HR data. Provide data-driven recommendations to improve HR effectiveness and contribute to business outcomes, including budget planning and headcount control.
• Cultural Leadership & Change Management: Promote a performance-driven, diverse, and inclusive culture within Cartier. Lead and implement local and international HR projects, driving and executing impactful HR change management initiatives across the boutique network.
• Boutique Proximity & Collaboration: Ensure strong proximity and close collaboration with our boutique teams, involving regular travel across Switzerland (minimum 30%) to understand their needs and provide on-the-ground support.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in a HRBP role.
• Demonstrated experience within the luxury industry, with a strong understanding of the retail environment being a significant asset.
• Proven ability to effectively manage diverse stakeholders and build strong relationships in a multicultural setting.
• Proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), including Workday and SAP, coupled with advanced Excel skills.
• A detail-oriented approach combined with a strong drive for results.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
• In-depth knowledge and practical application of Swiss labor law.
• Fluency in both French and English is essential; proficiency in German or Italian is a distinct advantage.
• Ability to travel up to 30 % of the time

Still wondering why, you should apply?

• You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise
• Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit
• You will interact with numerous stakeholders across Maisons, Functions

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity
• We care for the world we live in.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133422 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Stiamo vedendo un partner aziendale HR dinamico ed esperto per unirsi al nostro team Cartier Svizzera. Questo ruolo fondamentale vi posiziona come partner per le nostre boutique e la nostra leadership al dettaglio, contribuendo attivamente alla definizione e all'esecuzione della nostra strategia HR al servizio di Cartier Key
• Responsabilità: Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trust HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, traducendo le priorità aziendali in iniziative HR concrete ed efficaci. Fornire una guida esperta su tutte le questioni HR, tra cui diritto del lavoro svizzero, talento di acquisizione, politiche HR, gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo delle competenze. Talent Lifecycle Management: guidare l'intero ciclo di vita del talento per i nostri dipendenti boutique, tra cui il reclutamento, la gestione delle prestazioni, le recensioni dei talenti e lo sviluppo, i processi di revisione salariale e la pianificazione di successione, per rafforzare le capacità dei nostri team di vendita al dettaglio e il resonant di valorizzazione. Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilizzare sistemi informativi HR (come Workday e SAP) per ottimizzare i processi e adottare un approccio analitico per interpretare i dati HR. Fornire raccomandazioni basate sui dati per migliorare l'efficacia delle risorse umane e contribuire ai risultati aziendali, compresa la pianificazione del budget e il controllo dei conti. Leadership culturale & Change Management: Promuovere una cultura orientata alle prestazioni, diversificata e inclusiva all'interno di Cartier. Guidare e implementare progetti HR locali e internazionali, guidare e implementare iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti HR impattanti in tutta la rete boutique. Proximity & Collaboration: Garantire una forte prossimità e una stretta collaborazione con i nostri team di boutique, coinvolgendo regolarmente i viaggi in tutta la Svizzera (minimo 30%) per capire le loro esigenze e fornire supporto on-the-ground. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Un minimo di 3 a 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo HRBP. Esperienza dimostrata all'interno del settore del lusso, con una forte comprensione dell'ambiente di dettaglio essendo un bene significativo. Prove capacità di gestire efficacemente vari negozi e costruire relazioni forti in un ambiente multiculturale. Proficienza nei sistemi di informazione HR (HRIS), tra cui Workday e SAP, insieme alle competenze avanzate di Excel. Un approccio dettagliato, combinato con una forte spinta per i risultati. Comunicazione eccezionale e competenze interpersonali, con una comprovata capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente. Conoscenza approfondita e applicazione pratica del diritto del lavoro svizzero. La fluidità sia in francese che in inglese è essenziale; la facoltà in tedesco o in italiano è un vantaggio distinto. Capacità di viaggiare fino al 30% del tempo Ancora vincendo perché, si dovrebbe applicare? descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR133422

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced HR Business Partner to join our Cartier Switzerland team.

This pivotal role will position you as a partner for our boutiques and Retail leadership, actively contributing to the definition and execution of our HR strategy in service of Cartier’s commercial success.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trusted HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, translating business priorities into concrete and effective HR initiatives. Provide expert guidance on all HR matters, including Swiss labor law, talent acquisition, HR policies, performance management, and skills development.
• Talent Lifecycle Management: Drive the entire talent lifecycle for our boutique employees, including recruitment, performance management, talent reviews and development, salary review processes, and succession planning, to strengthen our Retail teams' capabilities and enhance retention.
• Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilize HR Information Systems (such as Workday and SAP) to optimize processes and adopt an analytical approach to interpret HR data. Provide data-driven recommendations to improve HR effectiveness and contribute to business outcomes, including budget planning and headcount control.
• Cultural Leadership & Change Management: Promote a performance-driven, diverse, and inclusive culture within Cartier. Lead and implement local and international HR projects, driving and executing impactful HR change management initiatives across the boutique network.
• Boutique Proximity & Collaboration: Ensure strong proximity and close collaboration with our boutique teams, involving regular travel across Switzerland (minimum 30%) to understand their needs and provide on-the-ground support.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in a HRBP role.
• Demonstrated experience within the luxury industry, with a strong understanding of the retail environment being a significant asset.
• Proven ability to effectively manage diverse stakeholders and build strong relationships in a multicultural setting.
• Proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), including Workday and SAP, coupled with advanced Excel skills.
• A detail-oriented approach combined with a strong drive for results.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
• In-depth knowledge and practical application of Swiss labor law.
• Fluency in both French and English is essential; proficiency in German or Italian is a distinct advantage.
• Ability to travel up to 30 % of the time

Still wondering why, you should apply?

• You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise
• Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit
• You will interact with numerous stakeholders across Maisons, Functions

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity
• We care for the world we live in.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133497
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT

Mission

Nous recherchons un Chef de groupe usinage pour renforcer notre équipement de management au sein de l’équipe de nuit pour notre site de Villars-sur-Glâne.

Responsabilités

Pour 50% de votre taux d’activité, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne du secteur en termes de management d’équipe, de technique, de qualité, de productivité, de délai ainsi que la mise en place de nouveaux produits :

•

Vous organisez de façon optimale votre département, évaluer la performance, développer les potentiels et l'expertise pour fédérer et retenir

Vous êtes le relais de communication auprès de vos collaborateurs et promouvoir les valeurs de la Maison

Vous contribuez à développer une ambiance de travail saine et stimulante

Vous veillez à l’application de l’ensemble des règles d'Hygiène et de Sécurité et au suivi de la gestion administrative de votre équipe

Vous assurez le maintien des processus et des moyens existants et participez à la mise en place des nouveaux processus de fabrication

Vous veillez au partage des informations auprès des différents partenaires et de votre équipe

Vous assurez le suivi de la production et préparer le reporting de votre secteur

Vous êtes force de propositions pour améliorer la production (ergonomie, flux, méthode, outils, qualité)

Vous mettez en place et gérez l'auto-contrôle

Vous analysez les problèmes de non-conformité rencontrés et mettez en place les actions correctives en partenariat avec les équipes Qualité et Méthodes

Vous participez à la résolution de problèmes de votre secteur

Pour 50% de votre taux d’activité, vous êtes acteur de la production:

Vous produisez et vous vous efforcez à maintenir, soutenir et améliorer les performances Qualité, Livraison et Productivité de votre secteur

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Au bénéfice d’un CFC polymécanicien ou Micromécanicien ou d’un Diplôme de Technicien·ne ES en microtechniques vous avez plusieurs années d’expérience dans l’industrie ainsi que la maîtrise des processus d’usinage.

Vous connaissez les outils informatiques et ERP et connaissez des outils de gestion, de planification et des indicateurs de performance.

L’autonomie est une force chez vous. Vous êtes par ailleurs, agile, capable de conduire le changement et bénéficiez d’une bonne résistance au stress.

Doté de bonnes capacités de communication, de pédagogie, et d’un sens de l’écoute, vous êtes capable de fédérer les équipes.

Enfin, vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, responsable et dotée d’un esprit pro-actif

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH.

Par la suite, un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable fabrication ainsi que notre HR Business Partner sera organisé.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 4 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité de Polymécanicien·ne. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de la mécanique, en fonction des activités et des opportunités de formation.

Pendant cette formation, vous apprendrez à fabriquer des pièces précises, uniques ou en prototype. Vous utiliserez des machines conventionnelles et des machines CNC (à commandes numériques). Vous développerez des compétences en programmation de ces machines, et la maîtrise de différentes techniques (exemple : d'érosion à fil ou par plongée).

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des assemblages mécaniques complets
• Réaliser des opérations d’usinage sur machines conventionnelles et CNC
• Programmer et utiliser des machines CNC
• Contrôler la qualité des pièces produites
• Identifier et analyser les éventuels défauts
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de production
• Collaborer avec les différents métiers et départements

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Bon niveau de français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle
• Bonnes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt, curiosité et motivation pour la mécanique de précision, la technique et l'horlogerie (une expérience de stage dans ce domaine serait un atout)
• Dextérité manuelle, minutie et souci du détail
• Autonomie, rigueur et proactivité
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous avons hâte de découvrir votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera étudié par nos équipes recrutement et formation. Par la suite, vous aurez un entretien individuel avec un membre de notre équipe RH et le Responsable de la formation et réaliserez des tests théoriques et pratiques.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133485
La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutte le Professioni dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall'impegno per l'eccellenza, colpendo per arricchire continuamente la nostra Maison

Che cosa abbiamo detto

A Cartier, si integra una comunità unita da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo fioriscono.

Apprezziamo l'individualità dei nostri talenti, spinti da un impegno comune all'eccellenza, ispirato alla diversità delle culture del mondo, e impegnati a rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico.

Siamo convinti che diverse prospettive promuovano l'innovazione e ci incoraggiano a creare esperienze eccezionali.

Vi offriamo un ambiente stimolante e l'opportunità di contribuire, attraverso la vostra visione personale, ad un patrimonio di creatività.

Celebriamo tutti i successi, qualunque cosa siano, promuovendo così legami significativi basati sulla reciproca gratitudine e sostegno e coltivando un forte senso di appartenenza.

Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un luogo unico e in continua evoluzione.

Che cosa sarà il tuo IMPACT?

Missioni

Dall'inizio di agosto 2027, sarete addestrati per 4 anni per ottenere il certificato federale di capacità politecnica. Durante il tuo apprendistato, svilupperai le tue competenze tecniche e scoprirai diverse aree di meccanica, a seconda delle attività e delle opportunità di formazione.

Durante questa formazione, imparerai come fare parti precise, uniche o prototipi. Userai macchine convenzionali e macchine CNC (digitalmente controllate). Si svilupperà competenze nella programmazione di queste macchine, e la padronanza di tecniche diverse (ad esempio, l'erosione del filo o le immersioni).

responsabilità

• Fare assemblaggi meccanici completi
• Eseguire operazioni di lavorazione su macchine convenzionali e CNC
• Pianificare e utilizzare macchine CNC
• Controllare la qualità delle parti prodotte
• Identificare e analizzare eventuali difetti
• Partecipazione al miglioramento continuo dei processi produttivi
• Collabora con diversi scambi e dipartimenti

COSA RICONOSCIUTO

• Un buon livello di francese nelle competenze sia orali che scritte per completare con successo la formazione professionale
• Buone competenze matematiche e interesse nel ragionamento logico e tecnico
• Interessi, curiosità e motivazione per meccanica di precisione, tecnica e orologeria (un'esperienza di stage in questo campo sarebbe un bene)
• Destrezza manuale, accuratezza e attenzione ai dettagli
• Autonomia, rigore e proattività
• Spirito di squadra e rapporto facilità

La tua esperienza con noi

Se siete motivati, non vediamo l'ora di scoprire il vostro file completo di applicazione, che sarà esaminato dai nostri team di reclutamento e formazione. In seguito, avrai un colloquio individuale con un membro del nostro team HR e il responsabile della formazione e eseguirai test teorici e pratici.

Scrivi il prossimo passo nella tua storia con Cartier.

Reference code: JR133485
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Professions from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striking to continuously rich our Maison

WHAT WE SAY

At Cartier, you will integrate a community united by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration and collective spirit flourish.

We value the individuality of our talents, driven by a common commitment to excellence, inspired by the diversity of the world's cultures, and committed to respecting and enriching our unique heritage.

We are convinced that diverse perspectives foster innovation and encourage us to create exceptional experiences.

We offer you a stimulating environment and opportunity to contribute, through your personal vision, to a heritage of creativity.

We celebrate all successes, whatever they may be, thus fostering meaningful ties based on mutual gratitude and support and cultivating a strong sense of belonging.

Join us at Cartier, a unique and ever-changing place.

WHAT WILL YOUR IMPACT BE?

Missions

From the beginning of August 2027, you will be trained for 4 years to obtain your Federal Certificate of Polytechnician Capacity. During your apprenticeship, you will develop your technical skills and discover different areas of mechanics, depending on the activities and training opportunities.

During this training, you will learn how to make precise, unique or prototype parts. You will use conventional machines and CNC machines (digitally controlled). You will develop skills in programming these machines, and mastering different techniques (e.g. wire erosion or diving).

Responsibilities

• Make complete mechanical assemblies
• Carry out machining operations on conventional and CNC machines
• Schedule and use CNC machines
• Control the quality of the parts produced
• Identify and analyse any defects
• Participate in continuous improvement of production processes
• Collaborate with different trades and departments

WHAT WE RECOGNIZE

• A good level of French in both oral and written skills to successfully complete vocational training
• Good mathematical skills and interest in logical and technical reasoning
• Interest, curiosity and motivation for precision mechanics, technique and watchmaking (an internship experience in this field would be an asset)
• Manual dexterity, thoroughness and attention to detail
• Autonomy, rigor and proactivity
• Team spirit and relationship ease

YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH US

If you are motivated, we look forward to finding out your full application file, which will be reviewed by our recruitment and training teams. Afterwards, you will have an individual interview with a member of our HR team and the Head of Training and perform theoretical and practical tests.

Write the next step in your story with Cartier.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR133485
Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist angenommen, der unsere Teams in allen Berufen von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Unternehmensbüros inspiriert. Unsere mehr als 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint, auffallend, um unsere Maison kontinuierlich zu bereichern

Was wir sagen

Bei Cartier integrieren Sie eine Gemeinschaft, die durch ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein vereint ist, in der Verbindung, Zusammenarbeit und kollektiver Geist gedeihen.

Wir schätzen die Individualität unserer Talente, angetrieben von einem gemeinsamen Engagement für Exzellenz, inspiriert von der Vielfalt der Kulturen der Welt und verpflichtet, unser einzigartiges Erbe zu respektieren und zu bereichern.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass vielfältige Perspektiven Innovationen fördern und uns ermutigen, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen.

Wir bieten Ihnen ein anregendes Umfeld und die Möglichkeit, durch Ihre persönliche Vision zu einem Erbe der Kreativität beizutragen.

Wir feiern alle Erfolge, was auch immer sie sein mögen, und fördern so sinnvolle Bindungen, die auf gegenseitiger Dankbarkeit und Unterstützung basieren, und pflegen ein starkes Zugehörigkeitsgefühl.

Begleiten Sie uns bei Cartier, einem einzigartigen und sich ständig verändernden Ort.

Was wird deine Wirkung sein?

Dienstreisen

Ab Anfang August 2027 werden Sie für 4 Jahre ausgebildet, um Ihr Federal Certificate of Polytechnician Capacity zu erhalten. Während Ihrer Ausbildung entwickeln Sie Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten und entdecken verschiedene Bereiche der Mechanik, abhängig von den Aktivitäten und Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Während dieses Trainings lernen Sie, wie Sie präzise, einzigartige oder Prototypenteile herstellen. Sie verwenden konventionelle Maschinen und CNC-Maschinen (digital gesteuert). Sie werden Fähigkeiten entwickeln, diese Maschinen zu programmieren und verschiedene Techniken zu beherrschen (z. B. Drahterosion oder Tauchen).

Zuständigkeiten

• Vollständige mechanische Baugruppen
• Durchführung von Bearbeitungsvorgängen auf konventionellen und CNC-Maschinen
• Planen und Verwenden von CNC-Maschinen
• Kontrolle der Qualität der produzierten Teile
• Feststellung und Analyse etwaiger Mängel
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse
• Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Gewerken und Abteilungen

WAS WIR ERKENNEN

• Ein gutes Französischniveau in mündlichen und schriftlichen Fähigkeiten, um die berufliche Ausbildung erfolgreich abzuschließen
• Gute mathematische Fähigkeiten und Interesse an logischem und technischem Denken
• Interesse, Neugier und Motivation für Präzisionsmechanik, Technik und Uhrmacherei (eine Praktikumserfahrung in diesem Bereich wäre von Vorteil)
• Manuelle Geschicklichkeit, Gründlichkeit und Detailgenauigkeit
• Autonomie, Strenge und Proaktivität
• Teamgeist und Beziehung Leichtigkeit

Deine Erfahrung mit uns

Wenn Sie motiviert sind, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbungsdatei, die von unseren Rekrutierungs- und Schulungsteams überprüft wird. Im Anschluss führen Sie ein individuelles Interview mit einem Mitglied unseres HR-Teams und dem Head of Training durch und führen theoretische und praktische Tests durch.

Schreibe den nächsten Schritt in deiner Geschichte mit Cartier.

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133495
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

WE WELCOME

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate who wants to join one of the legendary boutique, Cartier Lugano, and contribute to the success and growth of our boutique.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your Client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you are a native Italian speaker, fluent in English & any other Swiss language is a plus and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133449

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

The mission of the Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury Project Manager is to support the expert in the suppliers & raw materials responsible sourcing performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

You will participate in the steady development of the diamonds and coloured gemstones risk mapping. You will also follow-up on the continuous evaluation of suppliers and subcontractors along the supply chain and formalize all due diligence related information.
In a fast evolving ESG regulations context, this role will also contribute to the definition of new quantitative indicators, building a resilient Responsible Sourcing management system.

The scope of the mission will encompass all Richemont Maisons sourcing and/or producing finished products with diamonds and coloured gemstones.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Maintain an accurate, reliable diamonds and coloured gemstones supply chain database and KPI’s

•

Maintain and continuously improve the supply chain database including all due diligence related information.

Prepare and follow-up on a regular basis the diamonds and coloured gemstones Responsible Sourcing key performance indicators - KPI’s

Participate in the definition of new Responsible Sourcing KPI’s

Engage in the different data digitalisation initiatives of the department

Ensure data security and confidentiality

Coordinate supplier naturality and traceability audits and follow-ups

In collaboration with the expert and the Maisons, prepare the audit campaigns

Follow-up with Maisons and ensure audit plan execution

Provide and formalize regular status update and escalate if needed

Participate in the animation of Group Diamonds & Coloured gemstones community

Support the Head of Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury in the preparation of the different Committees and internal and external working groups

Preparation of minute meetings

Other transversal related tasks

Contribute to the Group ESG reporting

Collaborate with the team responsible for emission factors related topics

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Compliance, or Sustainability related discipline.

Minimum 2-4 years’ experience in Procurement or within the Sustainability area with a strong interest in Responsible Sourcing topics

An experience in the field of the precious materials is a plus

Knowledge & Skills

Integrity, Discretion & Confidentiality

Professional communications skills both verbally and in writing with mandatory fluency in French and English

Data oriented Proficient in MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Word), Power Bi

SAP Knowledge is a plus

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.

We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.

We care for the world we live in.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. La missione del Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury Project Manager è di supportare l'esperto nei fornitori e materie prime responsabile del monitoraggio delle prestazioni e del miglioramento continuo. Parteciperai allo sviluppo costante dei diamanti e delle pietre colorate che rischiano di mappare. Mantenere un accurato, affidabile diamanti e pietre preziose colorate database catena di approvvigionamento e KPI Mantenere e migliorare continuamente il database della supply chain, comprese tutte le informazioni relative a due diligence. Preparare e seguire regolarmente i diamanti e le pietre preziose colorate Responsible Sourcing Indicatori di performance chiave - KPI Partecipa alla definizione del nuovo Responsible Sourcing KPI’s Engage nelle diverse iniziative di digitalizzazione dei dati del dipartimento Assicurare la sicurezza dei dati e la riservatezza Coordinate naturalità dei fornitori e controlli di tracciabilità e follow-up In collaborazione con l'esperto e le Maison, preparare le campagne di audit Seguire con Maisons e garantire l'esecuzione del piano di audit Fornire e formalizzare aggiornamento dello stato regolare ed escalare se necessario Partecipare all'animazione di Gruppo Diamanti e gemme colorate comunità Supporta il Capo di Sourcing Hard Luxury responsabile nella preparazione dei diversi Comitati e gruppi di lavoro interni ed esterni Preparazione di riunioni minute Contribuire al Gruppo ESG reporting Collabora con il team responsabile dei fattori di emissione relativi argomenti HOW WILL EXPERIENCE SUCCESS With US? Corso di laurea o anni equivalenti di esperienza, preferibilmente in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business Administration, Compliance, o disciplina relativa sostenibilità. Esperienza minima di 2-4 anni in Procurement o nell’area Sostenibilità con un forte interesse nei temi Responsible Sourcing Un'esperienza nel campo dei materiali preziosi è un plus Knowledge & Skills Integrity, Discretion & Confidentiality Competenze di comunicazione professionali sia verbalmente che per iscritto con corrente obbligatoria in francese e inglese Proficient Data oriented in MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Word), Power Bi SAP Knowledge è un plus CHE MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Noi adottiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità. jobs.title: Responsable de ligne
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133439
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

VOTRE MISSION

Assurer l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coût, de sûreté et de sécurité en gérant son équipe et les moyens techniques utilisés.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Assurer le management de votre équipe

•

Vous organisez de façon optimale votre département, vous recrutez les bons profils, vous évaluez et vous valorisez la performance et vous développez les potentiels et l'expertise pour les fédérer et les retenir.

Vous êtes un relais de communication auprès de vos collaborateurs et vous promouvez les valeurs de la Maison.

Vous êtes le moteur de l'amélioration continue en animant les rituels et garantissant la méthodologie, tout en adoptant une posture de coach pour identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'optimisation de la performance.

Vous incarnez les valeurs de l'entreprise et vous en êtes le premier ambassadeur sur le terrain, inspirant votre équipe à les adopter et à les promouvoir dans votre environnement de travail.

Vous gérez les conflits et vous contribuez à développer une ambiance de travail saine et stimulante.

Vous contribuez et vous faites contribuer activement à la démarche de l’environnement durable de la Maison.

Responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs de votre secteur en terme de coût, qualité, délai et sécurité

Vous assurez le maintien des processus et des moyens existants et vous participez à la mise en place des nouveaux processus de fabrication.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133489
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CONTEXT

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate (12-month contract) who wants to join our team and contribute to the success and growth of one of our main boutiques.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently French & English and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

jobs.title: Spécialiste Assurance Qualité Fournisseurs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133491

Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen.

At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches.

SPECIALISTE ASSURANCE QUALITE FOURNISSEURS (H/F)

Plan-les-Ouates

Contrat CDD

POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE

Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur.

VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON

Vous êtes attiré(e) par un poste de Technicien Qualité polyvalent et bénéficiez d’une expérience réussie dans ce domaine, cette opportunité peut répondre à vos aspirations !

VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER

• Animer la performance qualité auprès de nos partenaires : Vous serez le maillon clé pour assurer le déploiement de la démarche Qualité Vacheron Constantin et garantir la diffusion de nos exigences auprès des fournisseurs.
• Garantir la conformité des produits achetés : De la phase du premier prototype jusqu'à la vie série, vous veillerez à la conformité de nos produits.
• Créer et optimiser les plans de contrôles réception.
• Apporter un support aux ateliers de production lors de difficultés liées aux composants achetés.
• Piloter, suivre et valider les plans d'actions concernant les non-conformités fournisseurs ou les plans de progression fournisseur. Vous vérifierez leur pertinence et leur mise en œuvre.
• Mener les audits qualité produits et process auprès de nos fournisseurs.

LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER :

La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur :

• Une formation type Ingénieur en Mécanique et/ou qualité.
• Votre motivation pour un rôle riche au sein d’une équipe Assurance Qualité Fournisseurs dynamique et en développement.
• Votre autonomie dans les décisions stratégiques
• Votre aisance avec les moyens de mesures, les méthodes de résolutions de problème, les outils qualité, la gestion de projets, les processus de fabrication et idéalement le domaine horloger.
• Votre excellente capacité à faciliter la communication avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs.
• Votre grande aisance avec les logiciels de bureautique.
• Votre excellente maîtrise du français et bonnes capacités en anglais.
• Votre expérience en tant que technicien/ne qualité au sein d'une manufacture horlogère serait un réel atout.

Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux.

Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133491

Fondata nel 1755, Vacheron Constantin è l'orologio più antico Fabbricazione in produzione continua per più di 270 anni, perpetuando in realtà un patrimonio orgoglioso di eccellenza orologiera e raffinatezza stilistica attraverso generazioni di maestri artigiani.

Al pinnacolo dell'Alta Orologeria e dell'eleganza sobria, la Maison crea segnatempo con firme tecniche ed estetiche uniche e un livello estremamente elevato di finiture.

PROVIDORI DI QUALITÀ DI ASSIONE SPECIALE

Programma-les-Ouates

Contratto CSD

PER LA TERZA E GLI ESCELLENCE DELLA RICERCA

Unisciti a una delle iconiche case dell'alta orologeria, dove l'eccellenza è un requisito costante. Partecipa al nostro successo collettivo e alla creazione del nostro futuro patrimonio.

La tua ragione di essere nella casa

Sei attratto da una posizione tecnica di qualità versatile e beneficiare di un'esperienza di successo in questo settore, questa opportunità può soddisfare le tue aspirazioni!

IL TUO RUOLO DI PIÙ

• Le principali prestazioni di qualità con i nostri partner: sarete il collegamento chiave per garantire l'implementazione dell'approccio Quality Vacheron Constantin e garantire la diffusione delle nostre esigenze ai fornitori.
• Assicurare la conformità dei prodotti acquistati: Dal primo prototipo alla vita seriale, vi assicurerete che i nostri prodotti siano conformi.
• Creare e ottimizzare i piani di controllo di accettazione.
• Fornire supporto ai laboratori di produzione durante le difficoltà legate ai componenti acquistati.
• Pilota, monitora e convalida i piani d'azione per i piani di avanzamento dei fornitori. Verrà verificata la loro rilevanza e implementazione.
• Condurre prodotti di qualità e audit di processo con i nostri fornitori.

QUALIFICAZIONI PER L'ESCELLAZIONE:

Il successo di questo ruolo dipende da:

• Un tipico addestramento degli ingegneri in meccanica e/o qualità.
• La vostra motivazione per un ruolo ricco in un team dinamico e in via di sviluppo di Quality Assurance.
• La vostra autonomia nelle decisioni strategiche
• La vostra facilità con i mezzi di misura, i metodi di problem solving, gli strumenti di qualità, la gestione del progetto, i processi di produzione e idealmente il campo dell'orologeria.
• La vostra eccellente capacità di facilitare la comunicazione con team e fornitori interni.
• La vostra grande facilità con il software di ufficio.
• La vostra eccellente padronanza di francese e buone abilità inglesi.
• La vostra esperienza come tecnico di qualità in una fabbrica di orologiera sarebbe un bene reale.

Vacheron Constantin ha celebrato 270 anni come la più antica fabbrica orologiera del mondo, in funzionamento continuo dal 1755. Con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, la nostra Casa gestisce una rete mondiale di quasi 200 punti vendita in 36 paesi. Ogni membro della nostra eccezionale comunità – orologiai, artigiani e professionisti – condivide la stessa passione per la nostra eredità e l'ambizione di costruire un futuro ancora più luminoso.

Pronto a far parte della nostra storia? Saremo lieti di scoprire la vostra applicazione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR133491

Found in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, actually perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen.

At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timespieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches.

SPECIALIST INSURANCE QUALITY PROVIDERS (M/F)

Plan-les-Ouates

CSD contract

FOR THOSE AND THOSE WHO RESEARCH EXCELLENCE

Join one of the iconic houses of high watchmaking, where excellence is a constant requirement. Take part in our collective success and the creation of our future heritage.

YOUR REASON TO BE IN THE HOUSE

You are attracted to a versatile Quality Technician position and benefit from a successful experience in this area, this opportunity can meet your aspirations!

YOUR ROLE TO PLAY

• Leading quality performance with our partners: You will be the key link to ensure the deployment of the Quality Vacheron Constantin approach and ensure the dissemination of our requirements to suppliers.
• Ensure conformity of purchased products: From the first prototype to serial life, you will ensure that our products comply.
• Create and optimize acceptance control plans.
• Provide support to production workshops during difficulties related to purchased components.
• Pilot, monitor and validate action plans for supplier non-compliances or supplier progress plans. You will verify their relevance and implementation.
• Conduct quality product and process audits with our suppliers.

QUALIFICATIONS FOR EXCELLING:

Success in this role depends on:

• A typical Engineer training in Mechanical and/or Quality.
• Your motivation for a rich role in a dynamic and developing Quality Assurance team.
• Your autonomy in strategic decisions
• Your ease with measurement means, problem solving methods, quality tools, project management, manufacturing processes and ideally the watchmaking field.
• Your excellent ability to facilitate communication with internal teams and suppliers.
• Your great ease with office software.
• Your excellent mastery of French and good English skills.
• Your experience as a quality technician in a watchmaking factory would be a real asset.

Vacheron Constantin celebrated 270 years as the oldest watchmaking factory in the world, in continuous operation since 1755. Based in Geneva, Switzerland, our House operates a worldwide network of nearly 200 outlets in 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional community – watchmakers, artisans and professionals – shares the same passion for our legacy and ambition to build an even brighter future.

Ready to be part of our story? We will be delighted to discover your application.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR133491

Vacheron Constantin wurde 1755 gegründet und ist seit mehr als 270 Jahren die älteste Uhrenmanufaktur in kontinuierlicher Produktion, die tatsächlich ein stolzes Erbe an hervorragender Uhrmacherkunst und stilistischer Raffinesse durch Generationen von Handwerksmeistern fortsetzt.

An der Spitze der Haute Horlogerie und der dezenten Eleganz kreiert die Maison Uhren mit einzigartigen technischen und ästhetischen Signaturen und einem extrem hohen Grad an Finishing.

SPEZIALISTISCHE VERSICHERUNGSQUALITÄT (M/W)

Plan-les-Ouates

CSD-Vertrag

FÜR DIE UND DIE, DIE DIE FORSCHUNG AUSSCHLÜSSELN

Treten Sie einem der ikonischen Häuser der Hochuhrmacherei bei, in denen Exzellenz eine ständige Anforderung ist. Nehmen Sie teil an unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und der Schaffung unseres zukünftigen Erbes.

Dein Grund, im Haus zu sein

Sie werden von einer vielseitigen Position als Qualitätstechniker angezogen und profitieren von einer erfolgreichen Erfahrung in diesem Bereich, diese Gelegenheit kann Ihre Wünsche erfüllen!

DEINE ROLLE ZU SPIELEN

• Führende Qualitätsleistung mit unseren Partnern: Sie sind das wichtigste Bindeglied, um den Einsatz des Quality Vacheron Constantin-Ansatzes sicherzustellen und die Verbreitung unserer Anforderungen an die Lieferanten sicherzustellen.
• Gewährleistung der Konformität der gekauften Produkte: Vom ersten Prototyp bis zum Serienleben stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Produkte den Anforderungen entsprechen.
• Erstellen und Optimieren von Akzeptanzkontrollplänen.
• Unterstützung von Produktionswerkstätten bei Schwierigkeiten im Zusammenhang mit gekauften Komponenten.
• Pilotierung, Überwachung und Validierung von Aktionsplänen für Verstöße von Lieferanten oder von Lieferantenfortschrittsplänen. Sie werden ihre Relevanz und Umsetzung überprüfen.
• Führen Sie Qualitätsprodukt- und Prozessaudits mit unseren Lieferanten durch.

QUALIFIKATIONEN FÜR DIE AUSLÖSUNG:

Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt ab von:

• Eine typische Ingenieurausbildung in Mechanik und / oder Qualität.
• Ihre Motivation für eine reiche Rolle in einem dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Qualitätssicherungsteam.
• Ihre Autonomie bei strategischen Entscheidungen
• Ihre Leichtigkeit mit Messmitteln, Problemlösungsmethoden, Qualitätswerkzeugen, Projektmanagement, Fertigungsprozessen und idealerweise dem Uhrmacherfeld.
• Ihre hervorragende Fähigkeit, die Kommunikation mit internen Teams und Lieferanten zu erleichtern.
• Ihre große Leichtigkeit mit Office-Software.
• Ihre hervorragende Beherrschung von Französisch und gute Englischkenntnisse.
• Ihre Erfahrung als Qualitätstechniker in einer Uhrenfabrik wäre ein echter Gewinn.

Vacheron Constantin feierte 270 Jahre als älteste Uhrenfabrik der Welt, die seit 1755 ununterbrochen in Betrieb ist. Mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreibt unser Haus ein weltweites Netzwerk von fast 200 Filialen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Gemeinschaft - Uhrmacher, Handwerker und Profis - teilt die gleiche Leidenschaft für unser Vermächtnis und den Ehrgeiz, eine noch bessere Zukunft aufzubauen.

Bereit, Teil unserer Geschichte zu sein? Wir freuen uns, Ihre Anwendung zu entdecken.

jobs.title: HRIS Onboarding Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133536

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Internship to assist the HRIS Talent and Experience team in deploying and designing our onboarding tool across Brands and Regions.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a HRIS Onboarding Intern, vou will be in charge of Enboarder, our Onboarding tool:

•

Integration of Enboarder with different systems
Creation of the workflows

Support and advice on the creation of the different workflows for Maisons and Regions

IT contact for the Enboarder project Team

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US:

You are an excellent communicator and vou are rigorous and able to anticipate needs with a strong sense of initiative

You have a good team spirit.
You are client oriented, open-minded, organized and love to be challenged to solve problems.
You like to connect the dots between different tools using API's. Knowledge in Javascript, HTML and CSS is a plus.

You are fluent in English, French is a plus.
You are available for a 6-month internship
Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory

HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING!

By providing you great opportunities to become a part of a dynamic and diverse environment where passion is not scarce and where you can count on your team to qo that extra mile with you to reach success. This position will also be your opportunity to deepen your knowledge of Onboarding/Recruiting and other Talent processes on a Global scale, while thinking the future with the people in the center.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:

1. it your application is selected, we will reach out to you AsAr tor an informal introductory call.

2. The next step from there would be a first interview with the recruiter; and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with the Manager.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

Internship per aiutare il team HRIS Talent and Experience a distribuire e progettare il nostro strumento di bordo attraverso Brand e Regioni.

Integrazione di Enboarder con diversi sistemi
Creazione dei flussi di lavoro

Supporto e consulenza per la creazione dei diversi flussi di lavoro per Maison e Regioni

Contatto IT per il team di progetto Enboarder

Sei un ottimo comunicatore e vou sono rigorosi e in grado di anticipare le esigenze con un forte senso di iniziativa

Sei orientato al cliente, aperto, organizzato e amore per essere sfidato per risolvere i problemi.

Accordo di stage con la tua scuola/università obbligatorio

Fornendo grandi opportunità per diventare parte di un ambiente dinamico e diversificato in cui la passione non è scarsa e dove si può contare sul vostro team a qo che miglio extra con voi per raggiungere il successo. 2. Il passo successivo da lì sarebbe una prima intervista con il reclutatore; e se c'è una partita, si avrà un incontro personale con il Manager.

jobs.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133524

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

At Richemont, we craft the future. Our unique portfolio includes prestigious Maisons distinguished by their craftsmanship and creativity, alongside Online Distributors that cultivate expert curation and technological innovation to deliver the highest standards of service. Richemont’s ambition is to nurture its Maisons and businesses and enable them to grow and prosper in a responsible, sustainable manner over the long term.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Department, supports the Group in the execution of key corporate development projects, including, among others, joint ventures, equity transactions, acquisitions, mergers and disposals, as well as related post-merger integration processes.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual to fill a 6-month internship position with start date 04.01.2027.

In line with this, your responsibilities would include:

• Support the M&A team in the review of potential investment opportunities: preparation of company profiles as well as investment memos to inform go/no-go decisions
• Assist the M&A team in financial and valuation analysis depending on deal type and stage of target’s development
• Assist in the management of key M&A and integration projects (organisation of key meetings, preparation of related materials and analysis, etc.)
• Contribute to the consolidation and management of the proprietary intelligence resources, including regular updates of transaction and trading comparable multiples
• Monitor relevant M&A news, market insights or competitors updates in the luxury goods space, preparing relevant alerts and updates for the management
• Attend relevant meetings, take minutes and ensure that follow-up actions are completed

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• You are a Master’s student in a Business school or university, with a specialisation in Finance, Business Administration or Management (minimum GPA 3.65/4 or equivalent)
• You have strong analytical and numerical skills, including some knowledge of corporate finance and valuation
• You are highly motivated and proactive with excellent communication skills
• You are a team player
• You are rigorous, reliable and pay attention to details
• You have some knowledge and a strong interest in the luxury goods industry
• You are proficient in Microsoft office programs
• You are fluent in English
• Previous internship experience in finance to be considered a strong plus
• Highly discreet - absolute trust and confidentiality required
• Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133524

Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

A Richemont, costruiamo il futuro. Il nostro portafoglio unico comprende prestigiose Maisons contraddistinte dalla loro artigianalità e creatività, insieme a Distributori Online che coltivano la cura esperta e l'innovazione tecnologica per offrire i più elevati standard di servizio. L’ambizione di Richemont è quella di coltivare le sue Maison e le sue imprese e permettere loro di crescere e prosperare in modo responsabile e sostenibile nel lungo periodo.

RISPOSTE DI LAVORO

Il Dipartimento Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) supporta il Gruppo nell'esecuzione di progetti chiave di sviluppo aziendale, tra cui, tra l'altro, joint venture, operazioni di equity, acquisizioni, fusioni e cessioni, nonché relativi processi di integrazione post-merger.

Stiamo cercando un individuo altamente motivato per riempire una posizione di stage di 6 mesi con data di inizio 04.01.2027.

In linea con questo, le vostre responsabilità includono:

• Sostenere il team M&A nella revisione delle potenziali opportunità di investimento: preparazione dei profili aziendali e memo d'investimento per informare le decisioni go/no-go
• Assistere il team M&A nell’analisi finanziaria e valutazione a seconda del tipo di offerta e dello stadio di sviluppo del target
• Assistere nella gestione dei progetti chiave di M&A e integrazione (organizzazione di incontri chiave, preparazione di materiali e analisi correlate, ecc.)
• Contribuisci al consolidamento e alla gestione delle risorse di intelligence proprietarie, compresi gli aggiornamenti regolari delle transazioni e dei multipli comparabili di trading
• Monitorare le pertinenti notizie M&A, le intuizioni di mercato o gli aggiornamenti dei concorrenti nello spazio dei beni di lusso, preparando avvisi e aggiornamenti rilevanti per la gestione
• Partecipare a riunioni pertinenti, prendere minuti e garantire che le azioni di follow-up siano completate

SKILLS E ESPERIENZA

• Sei uno studente di Master in una scuola aziendale o università, con una specializzazione in finanza, Business Administration o Management (minimo GPA 3.65/4 o equivalente)
• Hai forti competenze analitiche e numeriche, tra cui alcune conoscenze di finanza aziendale e valutazione
• Sei altamente motivato e proattivo con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione
• Sei un giocatore di squadra
• Siete rigorosi, affidabili e attenti ai dettagli
• Hai una certa conoscenza e un forte interesse per l'industria dei beni di lusso
• Sei esperto in programmi di ufficio Microsoft
• Sei fluente in inglese
• Esperienza di stage precedente in finanza per essere considerato un forte plus
• Altamente discreto - assoluta fiducia e riservatezza richiesto
• Accordo di stage con la tua scuola/università obbligatorio

Il tuo matrimonio con noi:

Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, arriveremo a breve per una chiamata introduttiva. Nell'ambito del processo di intervista, garantiamo sempre una completa comprensione e trasparenza, vale a dire, avrete la possibilità di incontrare le persone che saranno cruciali per il vostro futuro successo nel ruolo.

L'ambition de Richemont est de nourrir ses Maisons et ses entreprises et de leur permettre de croître et de prospérer de manière responsable et durable à long terme.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Le Département des fusions et acquisitions (M&A) appuie le Groupe dans l'exécution de grands projets de développement de l'entreprise, notamment les coentreprises, les opérations de capitaux propres, les acquisitions, les fusions et les cessions, ainsi que les processus connexes d'intégration après fusion.

Nous recherchons une personne très motivée pour combler un poste de stage de 6 mois avec date de début 04.01.2027.

En conséquence, vos responsabilités comprennent :

• Appuyer l'équipe de M&A dans l'examen des possibilités d'investissement : établissement de profils d'entreprises ainsi que de notes d'investissement pour éclairer les décisions d'aller-retour
• Aider l'équipe de S et A à analyser les finances et les évaluations en fonction du type d'opération et de l'étape de l'élaboration de la cible.
• Aider à la gestion des principaux projets de fusion-acquisition et d'intégration (organisation de réunions clés, préparation de documents et d'analyses connexes, etc.)
• Contribuer au regroupement et à la gestion des ressources de renseignements propriétaires, y compris les mises à jour régulières des multiples de transactions et de transactions comparables
• Surveiller les nouvelles pertinentes de M&A, les perspectives du marché ou les mises à jour des concurrents dans l'espace des biens de luxe, préparer les alertes pertinentes et les mises à jour pour la direction
• Assister aux réunions pertinentes, prendre des procès-verbaux et veiller à ce que les mesures de suivi soient prises

COMPÉTENCES ET EXPÉRIENCE

• Vous êtes un étudiant de master dans une école ou une université de commerce, avec une spécialisation en Finance, Administration d'entreprise ou de gestion (GPA minimum 3.65/4 ou équivalent)
• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et numériques, y compris une certaine connaissance du financement d'entreprise et de l'évaluation
• Vous êtes très motivé et proactif avec d'excellentes compétences en communication
• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe
• Vous êtes rigoureux, fiable et prêtez attention aux détails
• Vous avez quelques connaissances et un fort intérêt pour l'industrie des produits de luxe
• Vous êtes compétent dans les programmes de bureau Microsoft
• Vous parlez couramment l'anglais
• Expérience antérieure de stage en finance pour être considéré comme un fort plus
• Très discret - confiance absolue et confidentialité requise
• Accord de stage avec votre école/université obligatoire

Votre journée avec nous :

Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous contacterons sous peu pour un appel d'introduction. Dans le cadre du processus d'entrevue, nous garantissons toujours une compréhension et une transparence complètes, à savoir que vous aurez la chance de rencontrer les personnes qui seront cruciales pour votre réussite future dans le rôle.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

• Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs.
• Proposer des solutions simples et adaptées au terrain.
• Présenter les analyses et résultats de manière claire et synthétique.
• Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’appropriation des nouveaux outils.

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur, vous avez développé de l'expérience et des connaissances dans les domaines de la Qualité mais également la gestion de projets. Vous avez une appétence forte pour la Data au service de la performance industrielle.
