jobs.title: Group International Mobility Manager

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile della Mobilità Internazionale del Gruppo
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la mobilité internationale du groupe

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133558

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Richemont is seeking a highly skilled Group International Mobility Manager to support the execution of our international mobility practice. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and compliant relocation of employees across international borders, enhancing operational excellence and the overall experience for our mobile population and Group entities.

You will manage all aspects of the international assignment lifecycle, adhering to company policies, legal requirements, and best practices. Reporting to the Head of Global Mobility, you will support the translation of strategic framework designs into seamless, day-to-day processes, reinforcing governance and consistency, and expertly managing international assignments with a strong focus on policy application and compliance.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In this role, you will position International Mobility as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, mobility governance, and continuous improvement.

In Particular, You will:

• Own the end-to-end delivery of international mobility assignments (e.g., long-term assignments, short-term assignments), ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely execution.
• Provide expert guidance and support on international mobility policies, benefits, and processes to assignees, their families, and business stakeholders.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for our business stakeholders throughout the entire assignment lifecycle.
• Interpret Group International Mobility policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent and fair application across the organization.
• Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulations related to international mobility.
• Coordinate and manage relationships with external vendors, including tax advisors.
• Monitor vendor performance and ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met, guaranteeing efficient and effective service delivery.
• Stay abreast of global immigration, tax, and social security regulations relevant to international assignments.
• Collaborate closely with legal and tax departments to ensure compliance and proactively mitigate risks.
• Partner with HR Business Partners and Compensation & Benefits teams to prepare comprehensive assignment cost projections and compensation packages.
• Provide comprehensive support to assignees and their families, addressing queries and concerns related to relocation, cultural adjustment, and integration, fostering a positive employee experience.
• Maintain accurate records and data within international mobility management systems.
• Prepare insightful reports and analyses on assignment costs, trends, and compliance metrics to support decision-making.
• Act as a subject matter expert, providing expert advice, training, and support to HR Teams and business on international mobility topics.
• Contribute to and support the continuous improvement, optimization, simplification, and automation of international mobility processes, tools, and guidelines to enhance scalability, efficiency and sustainable delivery across teams.
• Leverage project management methodologies and Agile principles to drive the delivery of mobility enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution.
• Promote effective communication and understanding of international mobility policies and processes.
• Actively participate in and contribute to international mobility projects and strategic initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, International Relations, Law, or a related field (Master's a plus).
• 5+ years of solid experience in international mobility management, with a strong understanding of various assignment types, policies, and compliance (tax, social security, immigration) in a complex international environment.
• A solid grasp of international mobility trends, best practices, and regulatory frameworks.
• In-depth expertise in international tax implications for assignees and the company, including tax equalization, hypothetical tax, gross-up, social security agreements, and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions.
• Understanding employment law, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and other legal aspects relevant to international assignments
• Excellent client focus, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and cultures.
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and proven adaptability in a dynamic environment.
• Demonstrated capability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with international assignments.
• Proven project management skills, able to lead or significantly contribute to international mobility projects.
• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, Workday) and international mobility management software, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
• Fluent in English; French is an asset.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value collegiality, courage, curiosity, empathy, humility, and integrity.

- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call.

As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133558 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Richemont sta cercando un Group International Mobility Manager altamente qualificato per sostenere l'esecuzione della nostra pratica di mobilità internazionale. In questo ruolo, vi assicurerete il trasferimento regolare e conforme dei dipendenti attraverso i confini internazionali, migliorando l'eccellenza operativa e l'esperienza complessiva per la nostra popolazione mobile e entità di Gruppo. Potrai gestire tutti gli aspetti del ciclo di vita di assegnazione internazionale, aderendo alle politiche aziendali, requisiti legali e best practice. Segnalando al Capo della Mobilità Globale, sosterrai la traduzione dei progetti strategici in processi senza soluzione di continuità, di giorno in giorno, rafforzando la governance e la coerenza e gestendo sapientemente le assegnazioni internazionali con una forte attenzione all'applicazione e alla conformità delle politiche. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In questo ruolo, si posiziona la mobilità internazionale come una forte capacità operativa e business-abilitativa per le risorse umane, combinando l'eccellenza della consegna, il partenariato stakeholder, la governance della mobilità e il miglioramento continuo. In particolare, Lei sarà: Possedere la consegna end-to-end di incarichi di mobilità internazionale (ad esempio, assegnazioni a lungo termine, assegnazioni a breve termine), assicurando l'esecuzione accurata, coerente e tempestiva. Fornisci una guida esperta e un supporto alle politiche, ai benefici e ai processi di mobilità internazionale per assegnare, le loro famiglie e gli stakeholder aziendali. Servire come punto di contatto principale per i nostri stakeholder aziendali durante l'intero ciclo di vita di assegnazione. Interpret Group International Mobility policy e linee guida, garantendo un'applicazione coerente e corretta in tutta l'organizzazione. Assicurare un rigoroso rispetto delle politiche interne e delle normative esterne relative alla mobilità internazionale. Coordinare e gestire le relazioni con i fornitori esterni, compresi i consulenti fiscali. Monitorare le prestazioni del fornitore e garantire il livello di servizio Accordi (SLA) sono soddisfatti, garantendo la consegna efficiente ed efficace del servizio. Rimani al passo con le normative internazionali in materia di immigrazione, tasse e sicurezza sociale. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i servizi legali e fiscali per garantire la conformità e mitigare proattivamente i rischi. Collabora con i team HR Business Partners e Compensation & Benefits per preparare proiezioni complete di costi di assegnazione e pacchetti di compensazione. Fornire un supporto completo agli assegnatori e alle loro famiglie, rivolgendo domande e preoccupazioni relative al trasferimento, alla regolazione culturale e all'integrazione, favorendo un'esperienza positiva dei dipendenti. Mantenere registri e dati accurati all'interno di sistemi di gestione della mobilità internazionale. Prepara report e analisi approfondite sui costi di assegnazione, le tendenze e le metriche di conformità per supportare il processo decisionale. Agire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire consigli esperti, formazione, e il supporto ai team di risorse umane e business su temi di mobilità internazionale. Contribuisci e supporta il miglioramento continuo, l'ottimizzazione, la semplificazione e l'automazione dei processi di mobilità internazionale, strumenti e linee guida per migliorare scalabilità, efficienza e consegna sostenibile in team. Leverage metodologie di gestione del progetto e principi Agile per guidare la consegna dei miglioramenti della mobilità, garantendo l'allineamento tra priorità aziendali, capacità ed esecuzione. Reference code: JR133558

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Richemont is seeking a highly skilled Group International Mobility Manager to support the execution of our international mobility practice. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and compliant relocation of employees across international borders, enhancing operational excellence and the overall experience for our mobile population and Group entities.

You will manage all aspects of the international assignment lifecycle, adhering to company policies, legal requirements, and best practices. Reporting to the Head of Global Mobility, you will support the translation of strategic framework designs into seamless, day-to-day processes, reinforcing governance and consistency, and expertly managing international assignments with a strong focus on policy application and compliance.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In this role, you will position International Mobility as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, mobility governance, and continuous improvement.

In Particular, You will:

• Own the end-to-end delivery of international mobility assignments (e.g., long-term assignments, short-term assignments), ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely execution.
• Provide expert guidance and support on international mobility policies, benefits, and processes to assignees, their families, and business stakeholders.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for our business stakeholders throughout the entire assignment lifecycle.
• Interpret Group International Mobility policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent and fair application across the organization.
• Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulations related to international mobility.
• Coordinate and manage relationships with external vendors, including tax advisors.
• Monitor vendor performance and ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met, guaranteeing efficient and effective service delivery.
• Stay abreast of global immigration, tax, and social security regulations relevant to international assignments.
• Collaborate closely with legal and tax departments to ensure compliance and proactively mitigate risks.
• Partner with HR Business Partners and Compensation & Benefits teams to prepare comprehensive assignment cost projections and compensation packages.
• Provide comprehensive support to assignees and their families, addressing queries and concerns related to relocation, cultural adjustment, and integration, fostering a positive employee experience.
• Maintain accurate records and data within international mobility management systems.
• Prepare insightful reports and analyses on assignment costs, trends, and compliance metrics to support decision-making.
• Act as a subject matter expert, providing expert advice, training, and support to HR Teams and business on international mobility topics.
• Contribute to and support the continuous improvement, optimization, simplification, and automation of international mobility processes, tools, and guidelines to enhance scalability, efficiency and sustainable delivery across teams.
• Leverage project management methodologies and Agile principles to drive the delivery of mobility enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution.
• Promote effective communication and understanding of international mobility policies and processes.
• Actively participate in and contribute to international mobility projects and strategic initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, International Relations, Law, or a related field (Master's a plus).
• 5+ years of solid experience in international mobility management, with a strong understanding of various assignment types, policies, and compliance (tax, social security, immigration) in a complex international environment.
• A solid grasp of international mobility trends, best practices, and regulatory frameworks.
• In-depth expertise in international tax implications for assignees and the company, including tax equalization, hypothetical tax, gross-up, social security agreements, and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions.
• Understanding employment law, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and other legal aspects relevant to international assignments
• Excellent client focus, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and cultures.
• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and proven adaptability in a dynamic environment.
• Demonstrated capability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with international assignments.
• Proven project management skills, able to lead or significantly contribute to international mobility projects.
• Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, Workday) and international mobility management software, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
• Fluent in English; French is an asset.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value collegiality, courage, curiosity, empathy, humility, and integrity.

- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call.

As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role

jobs.title: Retail Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133589
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join, for one year, our International Retail Solutions department, as Retail Operations Coordinator.

The Retail Operations Coordinator, based in Couvet, supports the STAGE Manager in overseeing daily operations at STAGE, Cartier’s experiential space and mock-up boutique dedicated to retail experimentation and training.

In this multi-task role, the coordinator helps ensure smooth running of activities such as testing, training, role play, filming, and product demonstrations, while securing all necessary resources and requirements.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

RETAIL OPERATIONS & AREA MAINTENANCE

• Run monthly inventories, deliver reports, and process SAP receipts/returns.
• Manage quarterly stock updates (returns and novelty orders).
• Oversee STAGE equipment supply and coordinate shipping (packaging, customs).
• Maintain hardware/software for IT testing and manage broadcasting systems.
• Align VM with global campaigns and coordinate general maintenance.
• Partner with the Retail Solutions Team to test and integrate prototypes.
• Visit boutiques regularly to identify and suggest operational improvements.
• Exchange best practices and network with global Retail Ops peers.

VISITS PREPARATION & MANAGEMENT

• Prepare the STAGE area for visitors alongside the Hospitality & Event coordinator.
• Operate the STAGE broadcasting system.
• Lead engaging group tours (FR/EN) focusing on retail innovation and boutique operations.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• You have 5 years of experience in Retail Operations or Retail Logistics.
• Youa are proficient in Office 365 and digital tools; knowledge of SAP (stock management) is a strong plus.
• You are highly organized, proactive, autonomous, agile, and a strong communicator.
• You are flexible and at ease in a fast-changing environment.
• You are fluent in English and French
• On-site presence required (maximum 20% remote work, depending on operational needs).

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances.
• We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments.
• We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to further discuss the opportunity, and next steps. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the the hiring manager and the HR Partner.

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133589 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. Vorremmo parlare con voi dell'opportunità di unire, per un anno, il nostro dipartimento International Retail Solutions, come Coordinatore delle operazioni al dettaglio. Il Coordinatore delle Operazioni al dettaglio, con sede a Couvet, supporta lo STAGE Manager nella supervisione delle operazioni giornaliere presso STAGE, lo spazio esperienziale di Cartier e la boutique dedicata alla sperimentazione e alla formazione al dettaglio. In questo ruolo multi-task, il coordinatore aiuta a garantire un funzionamento regolare di attività come test, formazione, gioco di ruolo, film e dimostrazioni di prodotto, garantendo al tempo stesso tutte le risorse e i requisiti necessari. Come fai a fare un'infezione? OPERALI DI RETAIL & AREA MAINTENANCE Eseguire gli inventari mensili, fornire report e elaborare le ricevute/ritorni SAP. Gestisci aggiornamenti trimestrali (ritorni e ordini di novità). Superare la fornitura di attrezzature STAGE e coordinare la spedizione (imballaggio, dogana). Mantenere hardware/software per testare e gestire i sistemi di trasmissione. Allineare VM con campagne globali e coordinare la manutenzione generale. Partner del Retail Solutions Team per testare e integrare i prototipi. Visitare le boutique regolarmente per identificare e suggerire miglioramenti operativi. Scambi le migliori pratiche e la rete con i coetanei di Retail Ops globali. PREPARAZIONE E GESTIONE Preparare l'area STAGE per i visitatori insieme al coordinatore Hospitality & Event. Operare il sistema di trasmissione STAGE. Lead coinvolgenti tour di gruppo (FR/EN) che si concentrano sull'innovazione al dettaglio e sulle operazioni di boutique. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Hai 5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni al dettaglio o nella logistica al dettaglio. Youa è competente in Office 365 e strumenti digitali; la conoscenza di SAP (stock management) è un vantaggio forte. Sei altamente organizzato, proattivo, autonomo, agile e un forte comunicatore. Sei flessibile e a tuo agio in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Siete fluenti in inglese e francese Presenza in loco necessaria (massimo 20% di lavoro remoto, a seconda delle esigenze operative). Che cosa facciamo? Creiamo un ambiente positivo ed evidenziamo le prestazioni personali e di squadra. Siamo completamente trasparenti e condividiamo con voi: strategie di Maison, informazioni chiave, esigenze di altri dipartimenti aziendali. Vi istruiamo costantemente con: il savoir-faire di Cartier, il paesaggio competitivo, le notizie del settore, le migliori pratiche di esperienza del cliente. TUA GIORNATA CON NOI Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, vi daremo una chiamata introduttiva per discutere ulteriormente l'opportunità, e i prossimi passi. Se le cose vanno bene su entrambe le estremità, avrete la possibilità di incontrare il gestore di assunzione e il partner HR. Nous aimerions vous parler de l'occasion de nous joindre, pendant un an, à notre service des solutions de vente internationale, en tant que coordonnateur des opérations de vente au détail. Gérer les mises à jour trimestrielles des stocks (retours et commandes de nouveauté). Surveiller la fourniture de matériel STAGE et coordonner l'expédition (emballage, douanes). Maintenir le matériel/logiciel pour les tests informatiques et gérer les systèmes de radiodiffusion. Aligner VM avec les campagnes mondiales et coordonner l'entretien général. Partenaire avec l'équipe Solutions Retail pour tester et intégrer des prototypes. Visitez régulièrement les boutiques pour identifier et suggérer des améliorations opérationnelles. Échanger les meilleures pratiques et le réseau avec les pairs mondiaux des opérations de vente au détail. PRÉPARATION ET GESTION DES VISITES Préparer la zone STAGE pour les visiteurs aux côtés du coordonnateur Hospitality & Event. Fonctionnement du système de radiodiffusion STAGE. Diriger les visites de groupe (FR/EN) axées sur l'innovation au détail et les activités de boutique. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Vous avez 5 ans d'expérience en opérations de détail ou en logistique de détail. Youa est compétent en Office 365 et outils numériques; la connaissance de SAP (gestion des stocks) est un plus fort. Nous sommes pleinement transparents et nous partageons avec vous: Stratégies de Maison, informations clés, besoins des autres départements ministériels. jobs.title: Team Leader Pick & Pack
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133646

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXTE

Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Pick & Pack. Vous aurez la responsabilité de garantir la bonne exécution et la conformité des opérations Pick & Pack selon les réglementations et directives ainsi que le management opérationnel de l’équipe.

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ?

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

•

Grâce à votre relationnel constructif et votre orientation résultats, vous savez créer les bonnes conditions pour emmener votre équipe d’opérateurs logistiques à atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et sécurité.

Vous les soutenez au quotidien dans la réalisation de leur activité par le coaching et l’animation de la performance.

Par votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité d’analyse, vous veillez, avec vos collègues, à développer continuellement la performance de votre secteur.

De plus, nous pouvons compter sur vous pour faire l’extra mile qui satisfera nos clients à 100%.

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ?

Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (HEG, Université ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion d’équipe et de projet.

Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans le domaine de la logistique et de la Supply Chain.

Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au cœur des activités, dans un environnement dynamique et challengeant et êtes disposé à travailler en équipe d’après-midi (13h-22h).

Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution.

Excellent communicateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous vous démarquez par votre force de proposition et votre capacité à fédérer.

Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. La maîtrise de SAP ainsi que de POWER BI (ou autre outil d’analyse de datas) sont un atout.

Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français (C2) ainsi qu’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer aisément (min. B2).

QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ?

Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités.

- Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité.

- Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité.

- Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons.

VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique.

Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133646

Richemont possiede alcune del mondo, leader di beni di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza in gioielli, orologi raffinati e accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

CONTESTO

Richemont International Distribution recluta per il suo centro di distribuzione a Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Pick & Pack. Sarai responsabile della corretta esecuzione e conformità delle operazioni Pick & Pack in base alle normative e alle direttive, nonché della gestione operativa del team.

Come hai intenzione di avere un'infezione?

I vostri compiti principali saranno:

•

Grazie alla vostra relazione costruttiva e all'orientamento dei risultati, potete creare le condizioni giuste per portare il vostro team di operatori logistici a raggiungere gli obiettivi di qualità, costo, ritardo e sicurezza.

Li supporti ogni giorno nella realizzazione della loro attività allenando e animando le prestazioni.

Con il vostro spirito di squadra e la capacità analitica, voi e i vostri colleghi state costantemente sviluppando le prestazioni del vostro settore.

Inoltre, possiamo contare su di voi per rendere il miglio supplementare che soddisferà i nostri clienti al 100%.

Come fai ad essere usato con noi?

Per beneficiare di un'istruzione superiore (HEG, Università o equivalente), si giustifica un'esperienza comprovata nella gestione di team e progetti.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133614
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 4 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité de Polymécanicien·ne. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de la mécanique, en fonction des activités et des opportunités de formation.

Pendant cette formation, vous apprendrez à fabriquer des pièces précises, uniques ou en prototype. Vous utiliserez des machines conventionnelles et des machines CNC (à commandes numériques). Vous développerez des compétences en programmation de ces machines, et la maîtrise de différentes techniques (exemple : d'érosion à fil ou par plongée).

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des assemblages mécaniques complets
• Réaliser des opérations d’usinage sur machines conventionnelles et CNC
• Programmer et utiliser des machines CNC
• Contrôler la qualité des pièces produites
• Identifier et analyser les éventuels défauts
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de production
• Collaborer avec les différents métiers et départements

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Bon niveau de français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle
• Bonnes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt, curiosité et motivation pour la mécanique de précision, la technique et l'horlogerie (une expérience de stage dans ce domaine serait un atout)
• Dextérité manuelle, minutie et souci du détail
• Autonomie, rigueur et proactivité
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous avons hâte de découvrir votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera étudié par nos équipes recrutement et formation. Par la suite, vous aurez un entretien individuel avec un membre de notre équipe RH et le Responsable de la formation et réaliserez des tests théoriques et pratiques.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133644

Richemont possiede alcune del mondo, leader di beni di lusso Maisons, con particolare forza in gioielli, orologi raffinati e accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività.

CONTESTO

Richemont International Distribution sta reclutando per il suo centro di distribuzione a Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Process Operations. Sarete responsabili della gestione e del coordinamento del Team of Process Operations Specialists, la cui missione è di facilitare l'identificazione delle derive di processo e risolvere i problemi operativi.

Come hai intenzione di avere un'infezione?

I vostri compiti principali saranno:

• Grazie al vostro rapporto costruttivo e al vostro orientamento dei risultati, è possibile creare le condizioni giuste per prendere il vostro team di Specialist Proces per raggiungere gli obiettivi di qualità, costo, ritardo e sicurezza.
• Li supporti ogni giorno nella realizzazione della loro attività allenando e animando le prestazioni.
• Con il vostro spirito di squadra e la capacità analitica, voi e i vostri colleghi state costantemente sviluppando le prestazioni del vostro settore.
• Inoltre, possiamo contare su di voi per rendere il miglio supplementare che soddisferà i nostri clienti al 100%.

Come fai ad essere usato con noi?

Per beneficiare di un'istruzione superiore (HEG, Università o equivalente), si giustifica un'esperienza comprovata in team, project and quality management.

Hai una buona conoscenza in logistica e Supply Chain.

Rigoury, organizzato e autonomo, si ha una buona resistenza allo stress e sono in grado di capire / prevenire problemi e vedere un impatto o una soluzione.

Ottimo comunicatore, si garantisce una comunicazione efficiente con tutti gli stakeholder e si distingue dalla vostra forza proposta e la capacità di federazione.

Sei perfettamente a tuo agio con i soliti strumenti informatici. La masterizzazione di SAP e gli strumenti di analisi dei dati è una risorsa.

Hai un comando perfetto del francese (C2) e un livello inglese che ti permette di comunicare facilmente (min. B2).

Che significa il nostro gruppo?

La nostra vera forza non è nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e abilità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di incoraggiare i potenziali non catturati.

- Valiamo la libertà, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà.

- Incoraggiamo empatia, curiosità, coraggio, umiltà e integrità.

- Ci prendiamo cura del mondo in cui viviamo.

Il tuo viaggio con noi

Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, il team HR vi contatterà per un primo scambio telefonico.

Poi verrà pianificato un colloquio con il direttore diretto.

#Richemont # WeCraftTheFuture #

Reference code: JR133644

Richemont owns some of the world, leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strength in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison representatives a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seems to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXT

Richemont International Distribution is recruiting for its distribution centre at Villars-sur-Glâne, a Team Leader Process Operations. You will be responsible for managing and coordinating the Team of Process Operations Specialists, whose mission is to facilitate the identification of process drifts and resolve operational problems.

HOW ARE YOU GOING TO HAVE A IMPACT?

Your main tasks will be:

• Thanks to your constructive relationship and your results orientation, you can create the right conditions to take your team of Specialist Proces to achieve the goals of quality, cost, delay and safety.
• You support them daily in the realization of their activity by coaching and animation of performance.
• With your team spirit and analytical capacity, you and your colleagues are constantly developing the performance of your sector.
• In addition, we can count on you to make the extra mile that will satisfy our customers 100%.

HOW ARE YOU TO BE USED WITH US?

To benefit from a higher education (HEG, University or equivalent), you justify a proven experience in team, project and quality management.

You have good knowledge in logistics and Supply Chain.

Rigoury, organized and autonomous, you have good stress resistance and are able to understand/anticipate problems and view an impact or solution.

Excellent communicator, you ensure efficient communication with all stakeholders and you stand out by your proposal strength and ability to federate.

You are perfectly comfortable with the usual computer tools. Mastering SAP and data analysis tools is an asset.

You have a perfect command of French (C2) as well as an English level allowing you to communicate easily (min. B2).

WHAT DISTINGUES OUR GROUP?

Our true strength lies not in our similarities, but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures and human skills, as well as in our specific ability to encourage untapped potentials.

- We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty and solidarity.

- We encourage empathy, curiosity, courage, humility and integrity.

- We take care of the world we live in.

YOUR TRAVEL WITH US

If your application is selected, the HR team will contact you for a first telephone exchange.

Then an interview with the direct manager will be planned.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR133644

Richemont besitzt einige der Welt, führende Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderer Stärke in Schmuck, feine Uhren und Premium-Zubehör. Jede Maison vertritt eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont scheint das Erbe und die Identität jeder ihrer Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig sind wir der Innovation und dem Design neuer Produkte verpflichtet, die unseren Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität.

KONTEXT

Richemont International Distribution rekrutiert sein Distributionszentrum bei Villars-sur-Glâne, einem Team Leader Process Operations. Sie sind für die Verwaltung und Koordination des Teams von Prozessbetriebsspezialisten verantwortlich, dessen Aufgabe es ist, die Identifizierung von Prozessverläufen zu erleichtern und betriebliche Probleme zu lösen.

WIE WERDEN SIE AUSWIRKUNGEN HABEN?

Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein:

• Dank Ihrer konstruktiven Beziehung und Ihrer Ergebnisorientierung können Sie die richtigen Bedingungen schaffen, um Ihr Team von Specialist Proces dazu zu bringen, die Ziele Qualität, Kosten, Verzögerung und Sicherheit zu erreichen.
• Sie unterstützen sie täglich bei der Realisierung ihrer Aktivität durch Coaching und Animation von Performance.
• Mit Ihrem Teamgeist und Ihrer analytischen Fähigkeit entwickeln Sie und Ihre Kollegen die Leistung Ihrer Branche ständig weiter.
• Darüber hinaus können wir uns darauf verlassen, dass Sie die zusätzliche Meile machen, die unsere Kunden zu 100% zufrieden stellt.

Wie sollst du mit uns benutzt werden?

Um von einer Hochschulbildung (HEG, Universität oder gleichwertig) zu profitieren, rechtfertigen Sie eine nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Team-, Projekt- und Qualitätsmanagement.

Sie haben gute Kenntnisse in Logistik und Supply Chain.

Strenge, organisiert und autonom, Sie haben eine gute Stressresistenz und sind in der Lage, Probleme zu verstehen / zu antizipieren und eine Wirkung oder Lösung zu sehen.

Ausgezeichneter Kommunikator, Sie sorgen für eine effiziente Kommunikation mit allen Stakeholdern und heben sich durch Ihre Vorschlagsstärke und -fähigkeit ab.

Sie sind absolut bequem mit den üblichen Computer-Tools. Die Beherrschung von SAP- und Datenanalyse-Tools ist ein Gewinn.

Sie haben eine perfekte Beherrschung von Französisch (C2) sowie ein Englischniveau, so dass Sie leicht kommunizieren können (min. B2).

Welche Unterschiede gibt es in unserer Gruppe?

Unsere wahre Stärke liegt nicht in unseren Gemeinsamkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer spezifischen Fähigkeit, ungenutzte Potenziale zu fördern.

- Wir schätzen Freiheit, Kollegialität, Loyalität und Solidarität.

- Wir fördern Empathie, Neugier, Mut, Demut und Integrität.

- Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben.

Deine Reise mit uns

Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt ist, wird das HR-Team Sie für einen ersten Telefonaustausch kontaktieren.

Dann wird ein Interview mit dem direkten Manager geplant.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Reference code: JR133670
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT

Mission

Au sein du Département Ressources Humaines du site de Villars-sur-Glâne, vous soutenez l’équipe dans la partie administrative de l’ensemble du cycle de vie du collaborateur, en interaction avec l’ensemble de notre personnel et nos collègues RH des autres sites.

Responsabilités

•

Etablissement de correspondances liées au cycle de vie entier du personnel (entrées, mutations et sorties)

Suivi des dossiers électroniques des collaborateurs

Participation au processus administratif de recrutement (accueil et intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs …)

Permanences à l’accueil RH pour répondre aux questions RH de nos collaborateurs

Participation à l’organisation d’événements internes

Traitement des candidatures spontanées

Soutien à l'équipe RH en place dans diverses correspondances et tâches administratives

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Dans le cadre de votre formation commerciale avec maturité professionnelle (MP 3+1), vous recherchez une place de stage. Vous maîtrisez le français à l’oral et à l’écrit.

A l’aise avec la Suite Microsoft Office (Word, Excel et PowerPoint), vous disposez de bonnes compétences relationnelles et vous appréciez particulièrement les contacts humains ainsi que la confidentialité.

En outre, vous avez un attrait particulier pour la polyvalence et le travail au sein d’une équipe dans un environnement dynamique en plein développement.

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature (dossier complet : CV + Lettre de motivation + Bulletins scolaires) correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable RH.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133446

Roger Dubuis has been at the forefront of contemporary Haute Horlogerie since 1995. Its expressive timepieces house the finest watchmaking mechanisms, created in its integrated manufacture in Geneva and certified by the Poinçon de Genève.

The quest for excellence, the long search for the right gesture, the development of unique skills are all constants of Roger Dubuis. We are crafting a vibrant work environment where collaboration is celebrated, audacity is encouraged, and pleasure in what we do creates truly enriching experiences. We are looking for unique, audacious and creative individuals who are eager to take part in the Roger Dubuis adventure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Achieve business targets, KPI’s and sales in accordance with the brand retail strategy
• Demonstrate leadership and set performance targets for the team in a timely manner
• Identify business opportunities. Develop and implement activities to discover new clientele and grow the client database
• Maintain uncompromising standards of boutique presentation and ensure Timepieces are properly maintained and always secured
• Ensure exceptional levels of client service and after-sales experience
• Build long-term sustainable relationships with new and existing clientele to maximize sales opportunities and promote brand loyalty and familiarity.
• Lead, manage and develop the sales team to ensure consistent performance and high levels of morale

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND SALES

• Exceed boutique budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy
• Analyze business data, propose and implement sales strategies to improve KPI’s
• Plan and implement weekly meetings and actions
• Implement regular in-store and local events as per the retail activation calendar to drive sales for existing clients, generate new business and grow client base
• Build and develop external networks with business partners on behalf of the brand e.g. hotels, embassies, media, celebrities, etc.
• Communicate directly with Regional HQ (based in Switzerland) in regards to KPI, CRM, Sales, Inventory, and other relevant topics to maximize business operations.

CLIENTELING

• Demonstrate leadership by playing an active role inside and outside the boutique through hosting clients, and ensure best personalized client experience is provided
• Promote a culture of service excellency within the boutique
• Create unique, memorable and awe-inspiring experiences for clients to keep them engaged with the brand
• Deliver meaningful, one-to-one personalized service by anticipating clients’ needs and preferences
• Identify, recruit and convert new prospects by leveraging digital and physical tools

PEOPLE MANAGEMENT & DEVELOPMENT

• Create a positive, collaborative, engaging and high-performing environment for the sales team
• Inspire a client-centric mindset
• Promote a culture of learning within the team by ensuring regular skills coaching, brand education, product knowledge and competitor awareness
• Develop strategies to improve individual and team performance
• Identify high-potential Sales Ambassadors and develop them for career evolutions within the brand

FINANCIAL CONTROL & REPORTING

• Ensure timely qualitative and quantitative business reports
• Constantly monitor KPIs and define and implement action plans to achieve targets
• Manage the staff incentive and commission reports
• Ensure inventory is properly maintained, secured and accounted for via regular stock-take and product maintenance
• Compliance with procedures and with legal, fiscal and customs regulations

STORE MANAGEMENT AND OPERATIONS

• Responsible for maintaining a high level of display, visual merchandising, and Boutique condition and environment, in coherence with Brand guidelines.
• Act as the “face” of the Boutique and as Brand Ambassador in and outside of Boutique. Build Brand and Boutique awareness and equity. Demonstrate brand ambassadorial skills, at any given time, with partners, prospects and clients
• Maintain professional and respectful relationships with service suppliers or boutique neighbors.
• Comply with Group and Brand procedures
• Oversee store stock

EXPERIENCE & BACKGROUND

• Minimum 5 years’ experience working in a luxury environment at management level (Experience in store management is a strong plus)
• Background in sales, luxury retail, banking, automotive, high-end hospitality industries (experience within luxury watches and high-end jewelry industries highly desirable)
• Languages: French and English, any additional language would be a plus

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

• Strong knowledge of the luxury industry and our competitors
• Demonstrate the ability and willingness to make a difference and challenge the status quo
• Entrepreneurial mindset with proactive business acumen
• You are agile and adaptable in an ever-changing environment
• You know how to create loyal clients and easily create personal relationships, ideally you already have a network of local clients in Geneva/Switzerland
• You love creating memorable experiences for customers and are ready to go the extra mile for the client
• Ability to communicate effectively and positively to a range of different business stakeholders

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR133446

Roger Dubuis è all'avanguardia dell'Alta Orologeria contemporanea dal 1995. I suoi orologi espressivi ospitano i migliori meccanismi di orologeria, creati nella sua produzione integrata a Ginevra e certificati dal Poinçon de Genève.

La ricerca di eccellenza, la lunga ricerca del giusto gesto, lo sviluppo di competenze uniche sono tutte costanti di Roger Dubuis. Stiamo realizzando un ambiente di lavoro vibrante dove si celebra la collaborazione, l'audacia è incoraggiata, e il piacere in ciò che facciamo crea esperienze davvero arricchenti. Siamo alla ricerca di individui unici, audaci e creativi che sono desiderosi di partecipare all'avventura Roger Dubuis.

RISPOSTE DI LAVORO

• Ottenere obiettivi di business, KPI e vendite in conformità con la strategia di vendita al dettaglio del marchio
• Dimostrare leadership e impostare obiettivi di performance per il team in modo tempestivo
• Identificare le opportunità di business. Sviluppare e implementare attività per scoprire nuove clientela e crescere il database dei clienti
• Mantenere standard senza compromessi di presentazione boutique e garantire Timepieces sono adeguatamente mantenuto e sempre assicurato
• Assicurare livelli eccezionali di servizio clienti e esperienza post-vendita
• Costruire relazioni sostenibili a lungo termine con una clientela nuova e esistente per massimizzare le opportunità di vendita e promuovere la fedeltà e la familiarità del marchio.
• Guidare, gestire e sviluppare il team di vendita per garantire prestazioni costanti e alti livelli di morale

SVILUPPO E SVILUPPO

• Bilanci esclusivi della boutique secondo la strategia di vendita al dettaglio del marchio
• Analizzare i dati aziendali, proporre e implementare strategie di vendita per migliorare KPI
• Pianificare e attuare riunioni e azioni settimanali
• Attuazione regolare in-store e eventi locali secondo il calendario di attivazione al dettaglio per guidare le vendite per i clienti esistenti, generare nuova business e crescere la base clienti
• Costruire e sviluppare reti esterne con partner commerciali per conto del marchio come alberghi, ambasciate, media, celebrità, ecc.
• Comunicare direttamente con il quartier generale regionale (basato in Svizzera) per quanto riguarda KPI, CRM, Vendite, Inventario e altri argomenti rilevanti per massimizzare le operazioni aziendali.

CLIENTELAMENTO

• Dimostrare la leadership giocando un ruolo attivo all'interno e all'esterno della boutique attraverso l'hosting dei clienti, e garantire la migliore esperienza personalizzata del cliente è fornito
• Promuovere una cultura di servizio eccellenza all'interno della boutique
• Crea esperienze uniche, memorabili e stimolanti per i clienti per tenerli impegnati con il marchio
• Fornire un servizio personalizzato significativo, unico, anticipando le esigenze e le preferenze dei clienti
• Identificare, reclutare e convertire nuove prospettive sfruttando strumenti digitali e fisici

GESTIONE E SVILUPPO

• Crea un ambiente positivo, collaborativo, coinvolgente e performante per il team di vendita
• Ispirare una mentalità client-centric
• Promuovere una cultura dell'apprendimento all'interno del team assicurando competenze regolari coaching, formazione del marchio, conoscenza del prodotto e la consapevolezza dei concorrenti
• Sviluppare strategie per migliorare le prestazioni individuali e di squadra
• Identificare gli ambasciatori di vendite ad alto potenziale e svilupparli per le evoluzioni di carriera all'interno del marchio

CONTROLLO FINANZIARIO & RELAZIONE

• Assicurare rapporti commerciali tempestivi e quantitativi
• Monitorare costantemente i KPI e definire e implementare piani di azione per raggiungere gli obiettivi
• Gestire i rapporti di incentivazione e commissioni del personale
• Assicurarsi che l'inventario sia correttamente mantenuto, protetto e tenuto conto per via regolare stoccaggio e manutenzione del prodotto
• Rispetto delle procedure e dei regolamenti legali, fiscali e doganali

GESTIONE E OPERAZIONI

• Responsabile per il mantenimento di un alto livello di visualizzazione, merchandising visivo e condizioni e ambiente Boutique, in coerenza con le linee guida di Brand.
• Agire come “faccia” della Boutique e come Brand Ambassador in e fuori della Boutique. Costruisci la consapevolezza e l'equità di Brand e Boutique. Dimostrare competenze ambasciatoriali del marchio, in qualsiasi momento, con partner, prospettive e clienti
• Mantenere relazioni professionali e rispettose con fornitori di servizi o vicini boutique.
• Complimenti alle procedure di Gruppo e Marca
• Oversee magazzino

ESPERIENZA E BACKGROUND

• Esperienza minima di 5 anni che lavora in un ambiente di lusso a livello di gestione (L'esperienza nella gestione dei negozi è un vantaggio forte)
• Sfondo in vendite, vendita al dettaglio di lusso, bancario, automobilistico, alta gamma di industrie di ospitalità (esperienza all'interno di orologi di lusso e di alta gamma di industrie di gioielli altamente desiderabili)
• Lingue: francese e inglese, qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva sarebbe un plus

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

• Forte conoscenza dell'industria del lusso e dei nostri concorrenti
• Dimostrare la capacità e la volontà di fare la differenza e sfidare lo status quo
• Mindset imprenditoriale con acume proattivo business
• Sei agile e adattabile in un ambiente in continua evoluzione
• Sai come creare clienti leali e creare facilmente relazioni personali, idealmente hai già una rete di clienti locali a Ginevra / Svizzera
• Ti piace creare esperienze memorabili per i clienti e sono pronti a andare il miglio extra per il cliente
• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente e positivamente a una gamma di diversi stakeholder aziendali

Bezugscode: JR133446

Roger Dubuis steht seit 1995 an der Spitze der zeitgenössischen Haute Horlogerie. Seine ausdrucksstarken Uhren beherbergen die besten Uhrmachermechanismen, die in seiner integrierten Fertigung in Genf hergestellt und vom Poinçon de Genève zertifiziert wurden.

Das Streben nach Exzellenz, die lange Suche nach der richtigen Geste, die Entwicklung einzigartiger Fähigkeiten sind Konstanten von Roger Dubuis. Wir schaffen ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit gefeiert wird, Kühnheit gefördert wird und Freude an dem, was wir tun, wirklich bereichernde Erfahrungen schafft. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einzigartigen, mutigen und kreativen Personen, die gerne am Roger Dubuis-Abenteuer teilnehmen möchten.

WICHTIGKEITEN

• Erreichen von Geschäftszielen, KPIs und Verkäufen gemäß der Marken-Retail-Strategie
• Demonstrieren Sie die Führung und setzen Sie zeitnah Leistungsziele für das Team
• Identifizieren Sie Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Entwicklung und Implementierung von Aktivitäten, um neue Kunden zu entdecken und die Kundendatenbank zu erweitern
• Behalten Sie kompromisslose Standards der Boutique-Präsentation bei und stellen Sie sicher, dass Uhren ordnungsgemäß gepflegt und immer gesichert sind
• Stellen Sie ein außergewöhnliches Maß an Kundenservice und After-Sales-Erfahrung sicher
• Aufbau langfristiger nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden, um die Verkaufschancen zu maximieren und die Markenloyalität und -bekanntheit zu fördern.
• Führen, verwalten und entwickeln Sie das Verkaufsteam, um eine konsistente Leistung und ein hohes Maß an Moral zu gewährleisten

ENTWICKLUNG UND VERKÄUF

• Exceed Boutique-Budgets gemäß Marken-Retail-Strategie
• Analysieren Sie Geschäftsdaten, schlagen Sie Vertriebsstrategien vor und implementieren Sie diese, um KPIs zu verbessern
• Planung und Durchführung wöchentlicher Treffen und Aktionen
• Implementieren Sie regelmäßige In-Store- und lokale Veranstaltungen gemäß dem Aktivierungskalender für den Einzelhandel, um den Umsatz für bestehende Kunden zu steigern, neue Geschäfte zu generieren und die Kundenbasis zu vergrößern
• Aufbau und Entwicklung externer Netzwerke mit Geschäftspartnern im Auftrag der Marke z.B. Hotels, Botschaften, Medien, Prominente, etc.
• Kommunizieren Sie direkt mit dem regionalen Hauptsitz (mit Sitz in der Schweiz) in Bezug auf KPI, CRM, Vertrieb, Inventar und andere relevante Themen, um den Geschäftsbetrieb zu maximieren.

CLIENTEL

• Demonstrieren Sie Führung durch eine aktive Rolle innerhalb und außerhalb der Boutique durch das Hosting von Kunden und stellen Sie sicher, dass die beste personalisierte Kundenerfahrung bereitgestellt wird
• Förderung einer Kultur der Service-Exzellenz innerhalb der Boutique
• Erstellen Sie einzigartige, unvergessliche und beeindruckende Erlebnisse für Kunden, um sie mit der Marke in Kontakt zu halten
• Liefern Sie einen sinnvollen, persönlichen Service, indem Sie die Bedürfnisse und Präferenzen der Kunden antizipieren
• Identifizieren, rekrutieren und konvertieren Sie neue Perspektiven durch die Nutzung digitaler und physischer Tools

MENSCHENMANAGEMENT UND ENTWICKLUNG

• Erstellen Sie eine positive, kooperative, ansprechende und leistungsstarke Umgebung für das Verkaufsteam
• Inspirieren Sie eine kundenzentrierte Denkweise
• Förderung einer Lernkultur im Team durch regelmäßiges Skills Coaching, Markenbildung, Produktwissen und Konkurrenzbewusstsein
• Entwicklung von Strategien zur Verbesserung der individuellen und Teamleistung
• Identifizieren Sie Vertriebsbotschafter mit hohem Potenzial und entwickeln Sie sie für Karriereentwicklungen innerhalb der Marke

FINANZKONTROLLE UND Berichterstattung

• Stellen Sie rechtzeitige qualitative und quantitative Geschäftsberichte sicher
• Kontinuierliche Überwachung der KPIs und Festlegung und Umsetzung von Aktionsplänen zur Erreichung der Ziele
• Verwalten Sie die Mitarbeiteranreize und Kommissionsberichte
• Sicherstellen, dass das Inventar ordnungsgemäß gepflegt, gesichert und über regelmäßige Bestandsaufnahmen und Produktwartungen abgerechnet wird
• Einhaltung der Verfahren und der Rechts-, Steuer- und Zollvorschriften

STORE MANAGEMENT UND BETRIEB

• Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung eines hohen Display-, Visual-Merchandising- und Boutique-Zustands und -Umgebung in Übereinstimmung mit den Markenrichtlinien.
• Handeln Sie als "Gesicht" der Boutique und als Markenbotschafter in und außerhalb der Boutique. Bauen Sie Marken- und Boutiquenbewusstsein und Gerechtigkeit auf. Demonstrieren Sie jederzeit Markenbotschafterkenntnisse mit Partnern, Interessenten und Kunden
• Pflegen Sie professionelle und respektvolle Beziehungen zu Dienstleistern oder Boutique-Nachbarn.
• Einhaltung der Gruppen- und Markenverfahren
• Überseelagerbestände

ERFAHRUNG UND HINTERGRUND

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einem luxuriösen Umfeld auf Managementebene (Erfahrung im Ladenmanagement ist ein starkes Plus)
• Hintergrund in Vertrieb, Luxus-Einzelhandel, Banking, Automotive, High-End-Gastgewerbe (Erfahrung in Luxus-Uhren und High-End-Schmuckindustrie sehr wünschenswert)
• Sprachen: Französisch und Englisch, jede zusätzliche Sprache wäre ein Plus

KENNTNIS UND FÄHIGKEITEN

• Starke Kenntnisse der Luxusbranche und unserer Wettbewerber
• Demonstrieren Sie die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, einen Unterschied zu machen und den Status Quo herauszufordern
• Unternehmerische Denkweise mit proaktivem Geschäftssinn
• Sie sind agil und anpassungsfähig in einer sich ständig verändernden Umgebung
• Sie wissen, wie man treue Kunden und leicht persönliche Beziehungen zu schaffen, idealerweise haben Sie bereits ein Netzwerk von lokalen Kunden in Genf / Schweiz

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Code de référence: JR133446

Roger Dubuis est à l'avant-garde de la Haute Horlogerie contemporaine depuis 1995. Ses garde-temps expressifs abritent les meilleurs mécanismes horlogers, créés dans sa fabrication intégrée à Genève et certifiés par le Poinçon de Genève.

La quête de l'excellence, la longue recherche du bon geste, le développement de compétences uniques sont des constantes de Roger Dubuis. Nous élaborons un environnement de travail dynamique où la collaboration est célébrée, l'audace est encouragée et le plaisir dans ce que nous faisons crée des expériences vraiment enrichissantes. Nous recherchons des personnes uniques, audacieuses et créatives qui sont impatientes de participer à l'aventure Roger Dubuis.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

• Atteindre les objectifs commerciaux, les KPI et les ventes conformément à la stratégie de la marque
• Démontrer le leadership et fixer des objectifs de rendement pour l'équipe en temps opportun
• Identifier les occasions d'affaires. Développer et mettre en œuvre des activités pour découvrir une nouvelle clientèle et développer la base de données client
• Maintenir des normes sans compromis de présentation de boutique et veiller à ce que les garde-temps soient correctement entretenus et toujours sécurisés
• Assurer des niveaux exceptionnels de service à la clientèle et d'expérience après-vente
• Établir des relations durables à long terme avec la clientèle nouvelle et existante afin de maximiser les possibilités de vente et de promouvoir la fidélité et la familiarité de la marque.
• Diriger, gérer et développer l'équipe de vente pour assurer une performance cohérente et des niveaux élevés de moral

DÉVELOPPEMENT DES ENTREPRISES ET VENTES

• Dépassé les budgets des boutiques conformément à la stratégie de la marque de détail
• Analyser les données commerciales, proposer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de vente pour améliorer les KPI
• Planifier et mettre en oeuvre des réunions et des mesures hebdomadaires
• Mettre en place des événements réguliers en magasin et locaux conformément au calendrier d'activation du commerce de détail pour stimuler les ventes pour les clients existants, générer de nouvelles affaires et développer la clientèle
• Construire et développer des réseaux externes avec des partenaires commerciaux pour le compte de la marque, par exemple hôtels, ambassades, médias, célébrités, etc.
• Communiquer directement avec le QG régional (basé en Suisse) en ce qui concerne l'ICP, le CRM, les ventes, l'inventaire et d'autres sujets pertinents afin de maximiser les opérations commerciales.

CLIENTS

• Démontrer le leadership en jouant un rôle actif à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la boutique en accueillant des clients, et assurer la meilleure expérience client personnalisée est fournie
• Promouvoir une culture de service au sein de la boutique
• Créer des expériences uniques, mémorables et inspirantes pour les clients afin de les maintenir en contact avec la marque
• Offrir un service personnalisé significatif en anticipant les besoins et les préférences des clients
• Identifier, recruter et convertir de nouvelles perspectives en tirant parti des outils numériques et physiques

GESTION DES PERSONNES ET DÉVELOPPEMENT

• Créer un environnement positif, collaboratif, engageant et performant pour l'équipe de vente
• Inspirer une mentalité centrée sur le client
• Promouvoir une culture d'apprentissage au sein de l'équipe en assurant un encadrement régulier des compétences, une éducation à la marque, des connaissances sur les produits et une sensibilisation aux concurrents
• Élaborer des stratégies pour améliorer le rendement individuel et en équipe
• Identifier les ambassadeurs de vente à haut potentiel et les développer pour les évolutions de carrière au sein de la marque

CONTRÔLE FINANCIER ET DÉCLARATION

• Veiller à ce que les rapports d ' activité qualitatifs et quantitatifs soient établis en temps voulu
• Surveiller constamment les ICR et définir et mettre en œuvre des plans d'action pour atteindre les objectifs
• Gérer les rapports d'incitation et de commission du personnel
• Veiller à ce que l'inventaire soit correctement entretenu, sécurisé et comptabilisé par le biais d'une prise de stock régulière et de l'entretien des produits
• Respect des procédures et des règlements juridiques, fiscaux et douaniers

GESTION ET OPÉRATIONS DE STORE

• Responsable du maintien d'un haut niveau d'affichage, de merchandising visuel et de l'état et de l'environnement de la Boutique, en cohérence avec les lignes directrices de la marque.
• Agissez comme le visage de la Boutique et comme ambassadeur de marque à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la Boutique. Construisez la notoriété et l'équité de la marque et de la boutique. Démontrer des compétences d'ambassadeur de marque, à tout moment, avec des partenaires, des perspectives et des clients
• Maintenir des relations professionnelles et respectueuses avec les fournisseurs de services ou les voisins de boutiques.
• Se conformer aux procédures de groupe et de marque
• Stock de magasin supérieur

EXPÉRIENCE ET CONTEXTE

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement de luxe au niveau de la gestion (Expérience dans la gestion des magasins est un plus fort)
• Contexte dans les secteurs des ventes, du commerce de détail de luxe, de la banque, de l'automobile, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme (l'expérience au sein des montres de luxe et des industries de bijoux haut de gamme est hautement souhaitable)
• Langues: français et anglais, toute autre langue serait un plus

CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES

• Forte connaissance de l'industrie du luxe et de nos concurrents
• Démontrer la capacité et la volonté de faire la différence et de remettre en question le statu quo
• L'esprit d'entreprise avec un sens des affaires proactif
• Vous êtes agile et adaptable dans un environnement en constante évolution
• Vous savez comment créer des clients fidèles et créer facilement des relations personnelles, idéalement vous avez déjà un réseau de clients locaux à Genève/Suisse
• Vous aimez créer des expériences mémorables pour les clients et êtes prêt à aller le mile supplémentaire pour le client
• Capacité de communiquer efficacement et positivement avec un éventail d'intervenants professionnels

jobs.title: Compliance intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133753

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Join our dynamic Group Legal team at Richemont and gain invaluable experience in a vibrant multinational environment. As a compliance intern, you will support the central compliance function by contributing to a broad range of compliance projects and initiatives. This includes exposure to areas such as regulatory risk management, regulatory watch and legal developments monitoring, competition law, anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions compliance, anti-corruption, and conflicts of interest. The role provides hands-on experience with compliance processes and activities, offering valuable insight into the operation of a global compliance program.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?
The key responsibilities for this role will be:
• Assist in reviewing and enhancing AML, sanctions, and anti-corruption compliance procedures and controls.
• Conduct research on competition (antitrust) law topics and contribute to the preparation of guidelines, FAQs, and training materials.
• Contribute to the deployment of various compliance disclosure and approval tools.
• Contribute to the development and roll-out of compliance training programs and awareness campaigns.
• Assist in the preparation of compliance reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
• Participate in in and contribute to departmental meetings and projects.
• Work collaboratively in a multicultural and multilingual environment.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Currently enrolled in a full-time law degree or Bar Exam preparation.
• Previous experience as an intern in an international company or law firm is preferable
• Demonstrate robust legal skills with excellent drafting and communication capabilities.
• Personality is key: positive energy, with a strong team spirit, capable of adapting to an international and fast-paced setting
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in French and/or German is a strong plus
• An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory.
• You can commit to a 6-months internship with a starting date on or before 1 December 2026

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?
Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.
• We value collegiality, humility, and integrity.
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage.
• We care for the world we live in

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

titleByLocale.fr: Groupe Talent Gestion des collectivités Directeur

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133757

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As the Group Talent Communities Management Director, reporting to the HQ Group Talent Director, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Richemont's talent landscape. Your mission will be to define, develop, and animate our internal talent communities across all Maisons, Regions, and Functions. You will foster the growth, engagement, and retention of our diverse talents, ensuring alignment with our commercial ambitions, particularly within our retail business globally. This involves driving the strategic vision for talent management and ensuring consistent development paths across the Group.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Strategic planning: Define and implement the long-term vision and strategic axes for Talent Communities Management, including specific strategies for creative, marketing/merchandising, and retail talent management. You will contribute to overall

capability development through targeted community animation and specific learning paths, while integrating external insights on market trends and innovations.

Talent Management 360: You will ensure a global 360-degree view of talent management within communities, ensuring optimal talent pools are secured in close collaboration with HRDs and Talent Acquisition. This includes defining clear and consistent career paths, ensuring consistency in job catalogues and titles working closely with Group Rewards. You will also lead continuous management of assessment and career development tools, including Talent management process in Workday.

Talent Assessment & Community Engagement: You will collaborate closely with Learning & Development teams to support the continuous upskilling and employability of our talents and structure the implementation of consistent and progressive career paths. You will also drive the development of robust succession plans and centralize internal mobility strategies. You will also build & monitor specific talent pools across Maisons’ HQ and Regions, with strong succession plans for senior management roles across all Maisons supporting their career development plans. You will contribute to the design and manage the operational implementation of international development programs for international retail sales experts and high-potential talents in the Group.

Stakeholder Collaboration: You will animate the HR Talent Management community across Maisons and Divisions, organizing regular meetings on common priorities and projects and involve HR and partner departments in sharing the strategic vision and operational components. You will align with Maison HRDs, Regional teams, L&D, and

Commercial/Marketing Directors to ensure a cohesive approach to talent management,

actively participating in global talent meetings.

Project Management & Communication: You will lead and ensure the proper execution of strategic talent projects, defining and monitoring key performance indicators for talent communities, and managing annual assessments for retail boutique managers and sales communities. Furthermore, you will develop and implement impactful communication strategies for key talent initiatives, ensuring effective communication of our talent strategy across all levels and to top management.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

You are a passionate and experienced HR professional with:

• A proven experience within the luxury fashion and accessories industry, with a strong understanding of: creative/design and studio functions as well as marketing, communication organizations with Maisons and regions.
• A minimum of 15-20 years of international HR and/or people management experience, ideally within a large, complex international group.
• Significant expertise in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Development, and HR Business Partnering, with exposure to talent community management.
